The workload can be heavy, so stay on track.

I saw Dr. Dalton maybe twice in the semester and the rest was taught by a TA which I was quite disappointed in because I was really excited for this course and I feel like I was not pushed as much as I could've been if he was there because I find the material interesting and he seemed very passionate about all of the material before he left.

Professor Dalton I saw maybe twice throughout the semester, but overall the LTAM 1502 course was disappointing. Being asynchronous, you only met once a week in class with a TA who did a very boring lecture. The movies were long and difficult to follow sometimes. I did not retain much of what I learned because it was so uninteresting.

Very boring lectures which are mainly taught by the TA. I've only ever seen Dr. Dalton twice and homework can be overbearing sometimes. Just pay attention in class and make sure to prepare for tests outside of class.

Professor himself is a great person and passionate about Latin American studies but due to his schedule he is not necessarily there for classes. My course is a one day class and the rest online so I can't say much about him. LTAM course is fairly easy but easy to procrastinate if you don't like to read or sit through a movie to then discuss on both
Good Goood Good

Overall, Professor Dalton is very knowledgeable and passionate about everything Latin America. I did find that the homework was pretty heavy, and the old-fashioned approach to exams (writing essays by hand, etc) isn't the most practical. Despite this, I am definitely a lot more interested in Latin American culture than ever before :)

I have taken Dr Dalton in LTAM 1502 and two higher level summer courses. He is great and helps you out whenever you ask him. He is the sole reason that I added an LTAM major to my degree and it has been a great decision.
David  David David DAvid

Do NOT take unless it's required. This class meets once a week & the rest is online. You're required to read a chapter, watch a film (which is between 1-2 hours long), participate in an online discussion based on both and discuss what was read and watched in class all in one week. Also, exams have mc & an essay, which is due at the end of class..
Good is a great person, really good, the best.

He knows a lot about the text, but he is an unorganized professor. Idk if he's new at teaching, but he clearly struggles. The formatting is lazy and he seems to not know how to teach. Also a bad grader, he'll grade on a writing assignment and not give back any feedback and will just expect u to fix it in next essay. He's lazy and I don't recommend
for a 1000 level course it is quite rigorous, he assigns 2 quizzes and a discussion board every week. Be ready to read and participate in his class.

Dr.Dalton is a good teacher, he's very passionate on what he teaches. There's movies you have to watch every week and read the assigned textbook, with that you will have a discussion board every week. There's two quizzes one specifically from the textbook, and one from the movie. I found them pretty easy to do.If you do your readings you'll be fine

For an online class, it wasn't bad. You have work each week that doesn't take too much time and you meet once a week with a TA. As long as you do your work, you'll be fine. You do have to do a group paper though

For a summer class, this class was quite rigorous. You watch 2 films a week and have to write some mini or full essay each week. You do have the opportunity to peer review for credit, but overall this was quite the difficult class. If you get behind at all, then you're totally screwed. I don't know how people could handle more than just this class.
Do not take this class w this professor

Worst Spanish professor I have had at UNC Charlotte. The class had no engagement, no interaction, and it was hard to learn because she spoke so quietly. There was clear favoritism, and if you were not one of the preferred students, you received little to no support.
The sweetest professor i've ever had. She's great at teaching, repetition and practice is key to the class. Quizzes and exams were very similar to the homework.
Very sweet and caring. Explains everything in depth and repetition is key for this course. She's very understanding, homework is a lot but it's not hard.

Homework is due every night before class. They will tank your grade if you don't do them. Accessible outside of class and is very Spanish beginner-friendly. Super sweet and only wants her students to succeed. Take her if you can.

Amazing professor! The sweetest person and passionate about teaching. Willing to explain concepts, accessible outside of class, and welcomes questions. Grades fairly and wants her students to succeed. Homework due every night before class. Stay on top of assignments and prepare for exams and you will do well. Highly recommend her!
Everything we did went along with the tests and homework.

Absolutely the sweetest Spanish professor at UNCC. She genuinely cares about everyone and tries her best to make sure you understand the material. Learning a new language is definitely challenging, but as long as you do the homework and attend the lecture then you will be ok. Lectures are a bit of repeating whatever the homework was however

Padilla was a great professor; however, you do your homework before class, and then go to class, and she is going over everything you taught yourself. But as long as you're okay with teaching yourself the material, everything is super easy. Her tests are exactly what was on the previous quiz + some extra information. Overall easy credits.

Very nice lady and very understanding. Only complaint is that attendance is mandatory, and the assignments are a lot for a beginner level course. I don't think that 15 assignments per week is necessary for an elective class. Other than that, she is very kind and will help you in areas that you are struggling.

I'm not sure why her ratings are so low. She is probably one of the sweetest professors I've had at UNCC. She is very understanding and as long as you pay attention and actually learn the material you should be fine. Not alot of work at all. Only thing I struggled with was attending class which is a grade!

Class only met once a week which I found to be very unhelpful. Class was quite neutral, felt like we did the same thing every week. Not too sure if I would take her again, as I didn't find class very exciting or inspiring. However, she is an easy grader - at least for the lower levels.

This class was challenging but if you do your work you should be fine. She only teaches in spanish in this class (4233) so if you honestly aren't good at speaking and listening do not take this class. However, if you are take it. There is a final written project, 3 exams, and only 1 homework assignment per week. It is definitely doable.

This was the easiest class I have taken all semester, I really enjoyed Ms.Padilla-Falta. We only met once per week and the work was online, you only came to class for lectures and exams she gives you amazing study guides for every exam so all you really have to do is pay attention during the lecture, study your notes, and or the textbook.

Terrible rambles in a monotoned voice you could go to sleep to the entire semester. Never gives you a grading scale on anything her grading is done entirely on her opinion and can fluctuate greatly between projects so good luck trying to plan out what you need to make on your next test. She will refuse to show you why you got a question wrong.

Professor Padilla-Falto is probably one of the best language teachers I've ever had. She doesn't demand much outside of class except for a couple quick homework assignments. I plan to stick with her as my Spanish professor for as long as I can.

Professor Padilla-Falto is a wonderful professor who clearly enjoys what she teaches and does an amazing job at it. It is a 4000-level course so there is a lot of material to take in, but tests are open book and her canvas page is meticulously outlined with for the class material. Incredibly lovely lady from all of my interactions with her!
Really easy going semester, profesora makes learning really accessible and she is super kind and understanding!

She is a very good person, but by far the worst professor I've had at UNCC. I can't recall a time she was fully prepared; she's a super tough grader, and she's quick to throw out accusations towards students about using AI or translation. Again, really nice person, but that does not make a good professor. This class was the worst class I've taken

She graded rough drafts of papers as if they were final drafts, which made things difficult. Even some of the native speakers struggled with the grammar in this class. Overall, I just think the grading was too tough. It wasn't too much work, though, and I really enjoyed being in class with her. She made things super fun!

I had a hard semester in regard to mental health, and she was incredibly supportive. I opened up to her and she gave me ample time to make up assignments and gave me grace for late work. She is a very understanding and kind woman whose care for her course and love for teaching shines through.
Professor Lawson was amazing. She made learning and coming to class fun. Homework was completed online and class was used for practice. Tests were easy and fairly graded.
Professor Lawson is super sweet and makes it very easy to learn the material. I highly recommend taking her class!
She made learning Spanish so much easier. Her PowerPoints helped a lot. She is also very helpful when you have questions and is easy to reach over email if needed.

My favorite Spanish Professor! She is super kind and clear when explaining things. If you do not understand something she is very willing to stop and help. It helps a lot if you are willing to participate in class, and that could just mean occassionally answering questions!

Super sweet professor. You do have to interact with other classmates in this class (as most Spanish classes do). Explains in a way you can understand. Homework is on McGraw Hill and can be long sometimes. Consists of 3 exams and an oral exam. Allows half point for exams and that really helped keep my grade up. Overall nice and understanding!

Accuracy is essential, and translating into Spanish is not an easy task. As a native speaker, he has been very helpful in improving my skills in the discipline. Translation requires a level of precision that goes beyond simply speaking Spanish.
The worst professor I have experienced at UNC Charlotte. Very rude, tough grader and does not care about his students. Avoid this professor at all costs.

actually one of the worst professors I have ever had. first B I have received here after previously getting all As, and Ive taken multiple other spanish classes with other professors and I was fine. he does not teach, the only thing you will learn on is the class work book which quizzes take forever to read for and do. DO NOT take him.

He is the worst professor in languages . Like he is so rude when you ask questions. He thinks he knows everything and his Spanish sounds broken , his Spanish grammar is awful. He grades so late and gives unclear instructions. He makes no sense in his assignments. avoid him and take native speaking teachers:) they know what they are talking about.
He is the worst in the translation depa

Nagano sensei FTW!! She is so funny, sweet and a great instructor. Has great energy and will help you when you ask, no matter the question. TA Akari was very nice as well. Both graded work within a 2-3 week window. Only downside was a classmate, Mr. Tristan, whom we all tolerated but Nagano made sure to silence him if he got too rowdy.

To be fair, a lot of my experience in actually learning in this class came from the homework. Lectures are mostly just review but still very helpful for retaining what you learn during personal study. Professor is very sweet and helpful in correcting your mistakes.

Lectures heavily and grades tough. One thing I did not like was how she did not give us any links to her slides or any sort of study guide for her exams (there are two exams). Would not recommend anyone who thinks its a easy class.

Nagano Sensei was super sweet. She was really sympathetic towards my situation and really tried to help me get back on track and made sure to keep checking in on me while I had a NIGHTMARE of a sem. And btw, Japanese is one of the hardest languages to learn for native english speakers-- FSI category 5 (didn't know that until it was too late lmfao)

Super nice and chill. There is a lot of work but I mean it's learning a language.
Obviously there's a slight issue with accent and occasionally mispronouncing or forgetting a word in English but her accent is relatively easy to understand.

I absolutely loved this class and this professor! Lectures are amazing - especially if you're already interested in Japanese culture - and were very engaging. Homework was manageable, there were regular readings, a few group projects, and a bigger project towards the end of the semester. I would highly recommend taking this class if you can!
Amazing professor. One of the most enjoyable classes I've ever taken.

Nagano sensei was not a bad instructor and had clear grading expectations, however, it was clear she displayed favoritism to certain students and helped them out more. Her teaching style and explanations are thorough and she is pretty chill but, I personally would not take her again.

Nagano sensei is one of the best Japanese professors I've ever had. She doesn't just teach about language but culture as well, and is so funny and entertaining and makes otherwise dry lectures exciting. With her, I was excited to come to every class and didn't dread it at all. Especially if you're a new Japanese learner, she's great!

Prof. Nagano facilitated a very fun classroom environment! Midterm and final are very lecture heavy, so be sure to take notes. There are two group projects, and one final individual presentation. She provided multiple opportunities earn points back for extra credit and is generous with grading. Make sure to do the weekly discussions and readings.

She was one of the best teachers I've ever had. She always explains everything very well and will always answer questions. Her classroom always has a very good environment and it was a joy to go to class. The class can be difficult but only because it's a language course. She is very funny and always puts everyone in a good mood.

This class had a really heavy workload and some pretty hard grading, but the professor made learning a new language fun and engaging! She really wants you to understand the material and was passionate about making sure you were on the right track. I would definitely suggest this professor if you enjoy a good challenge!

If you want to slack off a little in class because the lecture feels boring... don't. The ppt's are all just photos and she talks heavily in detail during class. All assignments are easy and straightforward, and Professor Nagano is a gem, but very lecture heavy. Interesting topics, but def a history + art buff so be mentally prepared.

Nagano Sensei is the best Japanese teacher out there. The only thing I am sad about is that she only teaches 1201. Be sure to put in the effort in class so you are able to understand what is going on. Visit her during her office hours if you have any questions. I loved taking Nagano Sensei's class!

Took her again for JAPN1202, the format was a bit different but easy to adjust to! Japanese is of course a difficult language, but she gives a lot of good feedback and is always willing to help one on one. Would recommend!
Really fun. Sweet. Always willing to help out. Even though Japanese is really hard she made sure everyone participated and kept everyone on track. Honestly one of my favorite classes.
Homework every day and plenty of quizzes and tests, but they're not too bad if you study enough. Yokono sensei is very sweet and caring and always happy to help!

yokono sensei was probably the nicest most respectable professors i've had so far. shes always willing to help outside of class, and gives really good feedback on tests/assignments/etc. this course is pretty fast paced so expect lots of work assigned and keep up with lectures. she catches ppl lacking so make sure to focus up in class.

Yokono sensei is awesome! I took her study abroad course last semester and JAPN 1201 this semester, and she's incredibly caring and knowelegable. She wants to see you succeed, is willing to answer any questions, and responds to emails very quickly. She's a great professor to take if you're just starting out with the Japanese language.

I took her honors research methods class! Overall, she's an amazing professor. Super sweet and caring, always asked us if we needed anything before class. Made the honors research process very comprehensible. I would highly recommend the Languages, Cultures, and Translation departmental honors program.

Dr Stedman is a really amazing professor. Her classes are definitely difficult, covering a lot of content but she does a good job at making the material easy to digest and she is very understanding. She has helped my French improve more than any other professor in my 7 years of French learning just in the way that she encourages participation

He is a really great professor, but attendance is really important since he grades it heavily. There is a lot of homework due before every class and sometimes it can get confusing. Also you won't see your homeworks on canvas instead have to search for it. He is though really interactive so be prepared to have to participate in class.
Great guy, very engaging. Homework is a bit confusing, but otherwise effective professor. Sets up meetings for students to tell him if they're struggling with whatever, so he's a good communicator.

Nice guy, but he overestimates the value of his class. Be ready for him to have you create 5 different accounts on 5 different platforms. Never posts the homework in canvas, so get ready to have to hunt down your own homework. Will 100% force you to join a zoom call if the school cancels class.
Simple and enjoyable course, he's always in a great mood and very accommodating.

I was nervous about taking a foreign language class, but Dr. Hobgood made it easy. I had so much fun learning French. He is very enthusiastic and engaged. You can tell he truly loves what he does and wants to connect with his students. He takes time to make sure that everyone is comfortable with learning a new language and that they understand.

Dr. Hobgood's class has been the shimmering light helping me through the semester. 1202 is easy in nature, but of course, learning any new language is a challenge, but Hobgood makes it a breeze. The class is engaging, interactive, and very social! Make sure you are doing the HW on time and showing up to class!! Love Hobgood :)
Dr. Hobgood was the best professor I had this year. I didn't even mind the 8:30 am class because I just loved going. Make sure you remember the homework and pay attention in class

This professor is so amazing. He is a great teacher and is so passionate and knowledgeable. He cares about you and how you do in the class. This was my first time taking a French class and he made it so easy and I learned a lot. He gives you feedback on the tests and prepares you for them very well. 100% recommend taking his class.

Prof Hobgood has BY FAR been my favorite teacher at college. He is so incredibly skilled at teaching. Even through I had morning 8 ams, I found myself enlightened and with a smile on my face every class. Definitely recommend if you actually want to learn French, not just taking the class for credit.

Very sweet and caring professor! I took the LANG1502 with her, and she makes the class very interesting. You have only few homework assignments, a couple of very easy quizzes and tests, a presentation and final essay. She is looking out for all the students and tells a lot of stories from her personal experience as well. Take her!
BEST PROFESSOR EVER! The class was so easy and fun I enjoyed it so much.

She is very sweet and understanding. I will say you should decently pay attention if you're not already familiar with Russian because this class requires a lot of speaking, but even for someone like me who doesn't enjoy talking in class it's not that bad. Be sure to get the textbook because all the assignments are in it.

Mrs. Kate made me fall in love with learning the Russian language. She is the best Professor I have had thus far. She will remember your name and little details about yourself. Just a very caring professor and she made every lecture enjoyable. The class is very participation heavy which I found to be fun even as someone who is shy.

Dr. Domle's class was really fun! We did a lot of interacting as a class, so be prepare to talk. Classes were mostly focused on the textbook readings and questions, but they were really easy. Quizzes and exams were also really easy. Overall, this was a great class, and I would recommend her!

She is the type of person you cannot help but like, funny, understanding, and reliable if you need help with something. If you read the chapters and participate during class, this course will be a breeze. She has quizzes and exams, but provides study guides with answers beforehand, so if you take the time to study, you will be fine.

Dr.Domle is really a great professor. She's accommodating towards her students and makes the classes humorous and easy. She does emphasize on speaking French to practice orally and encourages participation, so be prepare to talk a lot.  I would recommend her class and would take it again!
She is very caring for when people are sick as long as you email very easy class I took her 1502 french movies class and I would 100 percent take her again she is very smart and funny.
Thank you for a great semester Dr. Domle

Dr. D was absolutely fabulous. She has been my favorite professor so far and her teaching is very accessible and easy to understand. She is a delightful person and I always left her class in a good mood. The lectures were very digestible and she is very cooperative with students! She inspires me to want to continue learning French! Oui oui🇫🇷

Can not recommend this professor enough!! Not only is she hilarious and caring, her class is so inspiring! I never thought francophone culture would interest me as much as it has and I give full credit to Dr. D. She is thought provoking and teaches you how to analyze french culture on a graduate level. The grading is easy, participation matters!

French is her first language, so she's perfect to teach the class. Love her personality, she's funny and interacts wonderfully with students. She will postpone quizzes and exams if the class is unprepared. Only complaint is that I struggled to feel like I learned much, but I may just be bad at languages. Had tons of fun in her class anyways.

Dr. Domle was and always will be my favorite professor from my time at UNCC. Her class brings life to an otherwise boring language credit. She cares for her students in a way unlike any other, being willing to go out of her way and take time out of her day to make sure every student gets the support they need. No student can't get an A with Falone!

One of my favorite teachers, ever. She's so nice and cares a lot about teaching us and helping us learn rather than wanting to give us a harsh grade or fail us. You can tell she's really passionate about teaching and makes an effort to connect and help you learn French. As long as you make an effort and participate in class it's a super easy A.

Dr. Domle is the best professor I have ever had. She will excuse any absence no matter what. She throws birthday parties and pushes back quizzes if we say we aren't ready. She gives amazing advice and explains things well. There is no such thing as stupid questions in her class and she makes sure everyone feels seen and understood. Take her class!!

The most caring professor I have met while at Charlotte. She offers extra credit for just writing the Chinese character on the board. She will even ask her classes if she should push assignments back due to how many characters there are to learn. Overall, Chinese is a hard language to learn. However, 老師 makes it simple. You have to apply though!
Easy class. Just do the work and it's an easy A.

Took a themes class, Chinese Movies in the U.S.. She is so kind and goes above and beyond to accommodate you. This class is as easy as it gets and definitely a filler for most students, which she absolutely understands and doesn't try to change. 

Some people really do find their calling.

(•‿•)
Maybe the easiest course at the university. Three essays and weekly discussion posts, neither of which are graded remotely strictly. Professor Mueller is very sweet.
She made me wish I had minored or even majored in Chinese. Great professor, very caring and ready to help. Class had slightly more load work than anticipated but I would do it all over again!

Honestly she is good at teaching but sometimes she is confusing and expects so much in this class. She doesn't give clear instructions and have assignments you do in class not knowing you also have to turn it in on canvas. She does accept late work but its because its her fault for putting the date in at the wrong time.
Almost never came to teach... was out for vacation in middle of semester... classes composed of watching random videos mostly... Very hard to reach out to...

Loved her class! It was super easy, and she was very open to accommodating for students. She is truly passionate about what she teaches, and she is just a really sweet and respectful person. She also helps students wherever she can (job opportunities, clubs, etc.). She genuinely just wants people to learn and grow in her course!

She is so sweet! Just try to practice before class because she will have you speak more Chinese and call on you to answer questions or read out loud.. but it's a language class so it's understandable.

Super nice and understanding! I had a rough semester for personal reasons, and she made sure to try her best to accommodate the best she could. She really cares a lot about her students and just wants them to succeed. She knows Chinese is hard and she will answer any and all questions to make sure you understand. Lots of quizzes, but they're short.
She's an amazing teacher. She's very good at her job and makes Japanese very fun and engaging. And she's very easy to communicate with.

Professor Banerjee is really kind and lets you makeup work and re-take chapter exams. I took this class online during the summer so it was fast-paced. She does require you to have your camera on and you have to go to the lecture to understand what's going on. Attendance is required. She gives additional examples and explanations to the textbook.

Don't take Banerjee-sensei's class if you truly want to learn Japanese language and culture (JAPN 3130, business). She will repeat the exact same thing as the book, rather than giving you more hands on examples. At the end of the day, I am thinking what's the difference between self study and taking her class.

I took her class over the summer, so the course was much more condensed and faster paced. Professor Banerjee was a little intense but always meant well for students, but be prepared to be called on in class. She gives you the option to pass of course, but it was always a little anxiety inducing for me haha.

I  wish had her for the FREN 1101 and 1102 . She is super knowledgable and really passionate about France. It was difficult at times to keep  up but as  long as  you stay on track of  the  homework and come to class. Overall- she is a good professor and you  will learn a lot from her.

She is very passionate about French and linguistics. There is a lot of homework but it goes well with the in-class work so it definitely helps. She offers a bunch of extra credit assignments that actually help you learn the language better. It's a fast-paced course and she takes attendance so definitely go to class.

I had her as my advisor and professor. She's kind and cares about her students, although I think she could've been more demanding or more interactive. I would catch many students dozing off in the class but she wouldn't say much about it. Lessons were average at best.

I was not looking forward to taking foreign language class but Professor LaMarca is a great teacher. She is agreeable and she wants her students to excel. My expectations were proved ill-informed as the class was fun and engaging.

I really liked the way she taught. She didn't move too quickly, and made sure everyone understood the lesson before moving on. If we needed more practice she gave it to us, and helped us do it. It is a lot of online homework, but if you try it really improves your test grades. She was very funny and social, even though my class was only 7 people.

Great selection of films and presentations regarding the time period and the styles associated with it.  plenty of extra credit opportunities ranging from attending club meetings to in-class participation.  Only 2 exams.

Just watch films and finish a film guide. 2 tests (one midterm very easy). You get 3 absence's and than he starts taking off points. Dont sleep in his class because he will wake you up. Its easy and his powerpoints are not boring.

This professor is so awful. My very first day of class, he locked the door before the class even started and didn't let us in. We waited for whole 10 minutes outside his class and when we knocked he open the door and said "WHAT?!" and closed the door on our face.
She makes the class easy for you just show up and complete the work. Don't be afraid to ask questions. Class is overall pretty easy, the only tough part was the listening portion of the midterms.
I took her course online during the summer semester. Her lectures were very engaging with a lot of activities that helped me learn the material. Attendance is mandatory.

I had her for 1101 and 1102. I love prof Burke. She genuinely cares for her students. She is very accessible outside of class. She preps you well for quizzes and exams. There is a decent amount of homework, but it's regulated by the head of the span department, so all span students do the same homework. Nothing negative to say about her.

If you want a spanish professor that does not take attendance, she is not for you. She really cares about her students and tries to make sure everyone is understanding of the material. The class can be boring, but that really is not her fault because she has a set curriculum. Overall, I enjoy her teaching and this was my second class with her.

I had Professor Reed for SPAN 1101. Her lectures are easy to follow and have a lot of class participation so they are easy to follow. She gives study guides for tests and quizzes which prepare you well. Class is easy if you do the home work and show up to class. I am taking her again next semester for SPAN 1102.

SPAN 1102. Great lectures, very friendly, caring, and willing to work with you to help you understand or fix your grade. Class participation required, you need to stay on top of homework in VHL. Any beef I have with the class is because of Spanish, not because of the professor.
I loved this Spanish class. Mr. Gonzalez made this very manageable to complete. I felt prepared with this class.

Professor Gonzalez is friendly and understands his material very well. He truly cares about his students succeeding. SPAN 1101 can be a little intimidating for new learners but going into the course with background knowledge from high school is very helpful. If you are struggling, he wants to help.

Professor Gonzalez is an amazing teacher. He shows that he cares about his students and is very engaged in our learning. However, participation is a part of the grade. So, if you sit in the front you're more likely to get called on.

Professor Gonzalez is an excellent teacher—passionate, humorous, and dedicated to helping students succeed. He prepares us thoroughly for quizzes and exams, ensuring we master the material. Fair and reasonable, he allows flexibility with deadlines. Truly one of the best professors I've ever had.

Shamburg sensei was very sweet and a nice teacher. it helps that her class is like kindergarteners learning in which you get called on, participate, and do lots of assignment in order for the material to stick. I liked the oral exams and the way she formatted her grading criteria.

Sensei Shamburg's class is well-taught and ideal for quick learners. However, its fast pace makes it challenging for some, especially as the semester progresses. The class felt too short to cover the necessary material, and the preparation time for oral tests (~1-2 days) can be anxiety-inducing. BTW, she will have you speak as she goes by in rows.
Sensei Shamburg is so informed and an excellent teacher! Would take this class again in a heartbeat
Great prof, had her for elementary Japanese 2. She is very sweet but she will call on you.

I was nervous when I transferred to school and struggled with test taking. Shamburg sensei went out of her way to support me when I was struggling, I never failed again after that. Motivated me all the way through graduation. Thank you.

I took Kaffen's class on Japanese Film and admittedly, I found the class a little boring. However, I feel like professors can really make or break a class. He was very kind, respectful, encouraging, and the feedback he gave on my writing was beneficial to my growth as a writer. He was very lenient and I think he genuinely cares about his students.

Professor himself was nice and clearly passionate about the subject. However I think the misunderstood the nature of this class and don't think his teaching methods fit it. Really lecture heavy, lots of difficult to understand text to read, really theoretical/philosophical discussions. He's more "theory" than "practicum". You've been warned.

I didn't expect my Anime studies professor to be the best lecturer I've ever had. You'll get out of the class what you put in, it's easy enough to coast and skimp on the readings and not participate in class discussion, but he makes it fun enough that you'll want to participate. Really caring guy too, was super lenient with deadlines and stuff

Professor Diaz is a great professor and genuinely cares about her students success. Attendance isn't necessarily required but it is 5% of your grade; but missing a few classes won't hurt you. She explains things really well in her lectures and even simplifies confusing concepts that did not really make sense to me in the textbook.

I really enjoyed taking this class. The work isn't difficult and Prof. Diaz is very willing to give feedback when asked. Pretty much all the assignments are on VHL and that doesn't transfer to canvas so I would check that separate website for due dates instead.

Graciela is an amazing professor. I would 100% take her again. Attendance and participation are 5% of your grade, so it's not a huge deal if you miss class, but it helps to be there because her lectures are more helpful than the HW for quiz/exam prep.
She's a great French professor. I had her for 2202, and intermediate French difficult. Study hard, practice daily, and you will be fine. She knows what she's teaching!

Very organized. She wants you to learn and helps you willingly. Lectures are fun and helpful. Textbook HW takes time and you have something every week. She gives extra credit on every test. Tests are fair, if you study it's not bad at all. I learned a lot and enjoyed her class when I didn't know any French. Definitely would take her again.

If you don't have prior French experience stay far from Professor Surget's class. Prior knowledge is expected and you will struggle without it. There is a TON of homework, ranging from an hour and a half to 4 hours before each class period. Lectures are boring and participation is huge. Would only recommend if French is something you love.

This professor is not good at explaining things and many times doesn't even understand your questions. She also has a hard to understand accent. There is almost no good practice with talking to other classmates to practice, which makes no sense considering its a language class. Class is not engaging at all.
She has her own book to teach we have as two quizzes every single week. Awful teacher, at UNC Charlotte.

Nice woman for the most part but extremely difficult to understand the class in fully Spanish. This class is Elementary Spanish II and I barely felt prepared for EVERYTHING including the lectures to be in Spanish and I was completely confused. Would rather not take this class again with her, but could've been worse.

Though she was an okay professor, I wouldn't recommend her for someone just starting in Spanish. She teaches the class primarily in Spanish and doesn't break down enough for people learning for the first time. It was hard to follow along and a lot of group work which a lot of students disliked. Would only recommend if you knew some Spanish before

I took this to learn Spanish on the side & this class didn't help at all. I learned some vocab but overall, didn't learn much. The textbook for hw/lectures is weird & it's easy to miss hw due. I knew some Spanish going in but the structure made it difficult to learn new stuff, I've learned more outside of class on my own then the actual course

Prof. Delgadillo was an okay prof, she was very hard to follow. You work in partners/groups every class which is irritating a lot of the time, she will pick on you to answer her questions so make sure you're listening.  She didn't give you that "i feel comfortable" feeling. Do not miss class it will tank your grade, there is no excuse if you do.

Professor Delgadillo was one of the best Spanish teachers that I have ever had. She is very passionate about teaching Spanish and it showed everyday in class. I understand some of the more difficult concepts so much better because of her teaching techniques. She will always help you if you are struggling. She is a very caring teacher.

Prepare to work with a partner in every single class. Many of my questions as to why something was done grammatically were answered with "well that's just how it's done in Spanish" Homework is very long and tedious to the point of where you just shut off and look up the answers. The final speaking project seemed rushed compared to the final.
take a different professor, this one is not worth it. slow grader, puts you on the spot every time, does not teach. expect you to know all the information yet does not know how to teach.
Participation is heavy. You have to work with a partner every class period. The textbook work is nothing like what you do in class at all.

Pretty easy class. She makes you work w a group/partner basically every class and it's for a participation grade. She's nice and sweet though, but being forced to work in groups made me not want to go to class.
This class is something I wouldn't recommend. The professor practically focused us to participate in group discussions in class, and if we didn't then that was points off of of grade.

Best French professor I've had ever. She is so attentive and truly wants to make sure that her students succeed. The material itself started off as a bit difficult but once you get the hang of how she teaches, it simplifies by a lot. We use an online textbook mainly during class. Professor Olson is so nice and kind! She is very helpful and gives feedback based on your strengths. There's a lot of poems and stories to annotate, and she requires you to have a commonplace book. You use your computer for major assignments, though. She's an easy grader, just follow the guidelines and you'll be fine.

Professor Malcom is probably my favorite professor of all time. He is always keeping the mood up by cracking funny jokes. He makes it very clear that he teaches students and not just classrooms. He takes his time to give thoughtful feedback on all of your writing. Overall, a fantastic teacher, and he truly loves what he does. It's not hard to pass!

I LOVED this professor. Malcolm is amazing. Took it at 8:30, and I enjoyed the class still. Loved him as a professor so much I declared WRDS as my double major. No exams, no finals, amazing lectures, not too much writing, little bit of group work, not too much homework. Highly recommend.

Mr. Campbell is such an awesome professor! He cracks corny jokes in class but really takes his work seriously and he's super nice and always open to questions. He provides good detailed feedback for each assignment so we can improve. The workload is decent, not many assignments, but each one is pretty lengthy and you really need to put the efforts.
Great Prof.

Professor Campbell is awesome!! Incredibly hilarious and would make getting to class at 10 am worth it. All of the assignments he assigned were easy, and the readings were also enjoyable. Take this professor if you have the chance!
Professor Campbell made eveyr class enjoyable even at 8:30. I was dreading waking up cuz I'm a late sleeper but I looked forward to this class. I wish all my professors wer elike him. The best.

This class was the best and one of my favorites! He was super nice and approachable compared to other professors. The assignments were easy. If you were to take a writing class, I would recommend him. My only complaint is that I work up early for this class, but I would do it again in a heartbeat. I will miss this professor:(

I was really nervous about taking a WRDS class because I've never been a fan of writing papers. But taking his course completely changed my perspective. The workload is pretty balanced, and he gives helpful feedback that makes it easier to improve on future assignments. On top of that, he's also very supportive and cares about his students.

Professor Campbell is a caring and funny instructor. The class involves a lot of writing, but he provides detailed feedback to help you improve. unstuck ai was a lifesaver for my writing prep. Would definitely take his class again.

Professor Campbell is the best professor I've ever had! He is always cracking jokes while also taking his work seriously. There weren't many assignments, but the ones we did have had a big effect on your grade. If you just put effort into the assignments, you will do fine. He also gives in-depth and detailed feedback on all your work.
Professor Malcolm was very funny and engaging, his class was very fun, and he was extremely nice with his feedback. 10/10 would recommend.
Best professor/teacher that I have ever had honestly. He will make you want to show up for class every time with his corny jokes and personality. It's amazing.

Mr. Campbell is how all professors should strive to be like. He has a great sense of humor and is one of the most laid-back instructors I've ever had. He cares a lot about his student's success and wants to see everyone participate and succeed. This class has genuinely made me a better writer and is one of the only classes I enjoy showing up for.
bro is just funny and really chill I have literally never had an issue with him and he actually takes time to help his students.

Professor Campbell is a textbook example what a good professor should be. He is very passionate about what he teaches, and you can't help but share his enthusiasm. He is lenient when it comes to any issues pertaining assignments/essays and as long you keep good effort, he will notice it and assist you to his best ability.

Malcolm Campbell is one of the best English teachers I've had. He makes an effort to ensure everyone succeeds if they try, grading primarily off of effort put in rather than just trying to reach a page quota. He offers extra credit which I really wish I had used, and is very understanding when it comes to extensions. Gives great feedback on essays.

Professor Campbell really wants to see his students succeed and is understanding if you reach out to him. He tries to make class engaging and brings a lot of humor. There are about 4 major projects/assignments throughout the semester. Overall, the class is easy if you show up and do the assignments on time.

Malcolm was a great professor. Super easy to get an A if you just show up and complete all the assignments. He is super flexible if you just talk to him. Would recommend him to any student looking to take a WRDS class. The assignments are also pretty easy as well as long as you put in effort. He's also pretty funny!!

Malcolm's very kind and hilarious, and tries his best to ensure everyone is comfortable. Assignments are writing intensive and can become repetitive, you will work with others to 'peer review' work, but he gives amazing and detailed feedback. It's a challenging but rewarding class, expect to write frequently.

Professor Campbell is one of my favorite professors. He is super understanding and always willing to give extensions. He grades by effort, not ability, so as long as you put in effort you can easily get an A. We also had a lot less work than other WRDS classes which was nice. Campbell wants his students to succeed!

She is a kind and lenient professor. I usually struggle with motivation or personal distractions outside of class, and she helped me stay on track. She also answers emails and grades fairly quick! I loved how much genuine feedback she gives as well. She also tends to have everything online, which made things easier too.
This class was very easy. Ashlyn is VERY willing to work with you; she makes every assignment easy to follow and has clear guidelines that help. Amazing professor definitely would take again.

Professor Ashlyn was very helpful and accessible. The course itself was a lot for me because I hate writing papers and stuff, but if you keep up with work and don't put off for last minute you will be fine. There is a lot of peer reviews, but she also gives great feedback. Her canvas is super organized and you know upcoming assignments.

Ashlyn honestly gave me everything I could hope for out of an online class. Her canvas was very well organized and you could tell how much time she put into making her assignments. Only a max of 3 or so assignments per week. Her feedback was always really useful too, I honestly think shes made me a better writer.

Professor Ashlyn is great! There is barley any coursework each week - like 3 assignments max. Some of the guidelines on the research projects are a little unclear, but having a shared folder with the class helped because you could see examples. Other then that, this class is really easy! I would take her again!

Professor Ashlyn is a good professor, as someone who doesn't usually take online classes, I found this course easy. WRDS-1103 is an easy course, just make sure you keep up with all assignments. As long as you get everything done, you will pass.

I was not expecting how tedious her assignments would be. The reviews mislead me; she is not great about answering emails when you contact her. I had been waiting 2 weeks for a past assignment to be regraded after she told me to revise it. She seems like a nice person, but she expects too much for a gen ed class. Lots of busy work and lots of time.

Really great professor, i was surprised when she had us fill a form to provide feedback for her course. she really works hard for her students. although there were times where she couldnt respond to inquiries for a while. her classwork was a lot. but as long as you just yap and bs a little, you'll get a easy 10. also, theres peer reviews.
Awesome teacher! There're a few papers and one big project. No tests!
Easy A. She provides great feedback and will answer emails during the weekend. Caring professor

Ashlyn was an amazing Professor. She made the class feel like a community. she is very funny as well. We do have class discussions and group projects which is mandatory to participate in for a grade. I dont like going to class but I loved coming to hers. I would take her again for sure!

This was probably one of the best classes that I have taken this semester. Gave good feedback on every assignment. It also gave times for how long each assignment should roughly take. If you do all of your assignments, you will defiantly get an A.

She is the BEST professor ever. Extremely understanding and takes the time to give each individual student personal feedback on every assignment. Class is a lot of work and time consuming but if you just do exactly as it says and complete your work in time there is no way you get under a A. Take this course with this professor!!!
Shes honestly an amazing professor, legit talk to her if you need any sort of help

I love professor Walden, she always makes sure we know what we have to complete for her class. Her grading is clear and helpful, it doesn't feel like she is talking down to you but rather talking to you as her equal. She gives a good amount of work, but nothing that can't be finished and if done on time it is really easy to get an A in her class.

She was a great teacher, however, the course load was very heavy.  She had a lot of assignments, however, the due dates were very structured so there were no surprise assignments.  That being said, some of the assignments seemed a little more like busy work than anything else.  However, she is willing to work with you if any issues come up.
Professor Ashlyn was awesome. The work is time consuming but I really enjoyed it. Her instructions are very clear and organized. Best English teacher

WRDS 1104* Professor Ashlyn is amazing!! I took this course online through zoom and she gives out a lot of homework but you have a week to do it and it honestly doesn't take that long. \ We did have to do a lot of peer review with our group members but if they aren't doing their work she will work with you to get better group members lol!

I loveddddddd Mrs. Pratt for WRDS 1104 and I don't even like writing! She was amazing, and her assignments were not hard at all. We did graded in class discussions which I usually dislike but you get used to them. There is no final, but a research project which was actually very interesting. A lot of peer work as well. Overall I enjoyed the class!
Lots of writing, which was expected. Easy grader and understanding.
Great prof. Little work outside of class and as long as you balance well you will get A. Take her!

This lady is quite literally one of the best WRDS professors you could get! Sure, there are at least 3-4 assignments due each week that are kind of heavy, she gives the best feedback and grades on completion not correction (except for final). She is also just so sweet and understanding as well, TRY TO GET HER FOR WRDS1104!!!

Amazing professor. She is so sweet and has a very clear structure to her classes. She does require readings for in-person group discussion as well as online discussion posts. Easy to contact through email and very understanding. Also gives really good feedback on writing pieces.
Graded attendance, assignments are due at the start of the next class instead of at 11:59, so you could wake up before class and get them done.  overall good class
She was a pretty good teacher. There is a lot of work and it is a reading heavy class. The reasearch project will take most your semester as she walks you through it.

I took this professor in the WRDs 1104 class. Overall, she was a good professor. She had clear guidelines, responded to help, and set me up for success. Overall, the class is frankly quite boring and sometimes even redundant. However, everyone needs to take this class and I know that Professor Pratt does a great job teaching this class.

Lots of homework and reading but she gives you time, clear grading, and extensions if needed. You do many small-medium assignments throughout the semester to eventually put it all together to make a reader's guide at the end. As long as you put a bit of effort, you should get full credit on hw. You do talk with a group in class, but no group work.

It is a tough curriculum to teach in a small time frame, but she does it well. Her instructions were clear and the large amount of work was made understandable by her. Haters are angry at the course, not the professor.

She is so kind and straight to the point. Throughout the semester, you are building a Reader's Guide and creating a writing portfolio, based on small writing assignments done throughout the semester. I advise participating in class and on the discussion boards. 

This course is easy if you put in the work. I would take her as a professor again.
Very relaxed professor. Would highly recommend for WRDS1103.
Great, and straight to the point professor.

She's extremely kind and a very easy grader if you do the assignment correctly. Not too much writing compared to other classes and she spaces it out so its not overwhelming. You have to work for your grade but it is not a difficult class.
Professor Pratt is amazing! Super understanding and kind.

The Best WRDS class under the best Professor in the department. Never had to stress in this class, not one bit at all. The professor is kind and will truly help you want to succeed and understand the material. The material is the lightest I have seen in any English class in my life. If you get below a A-, honestly reflect, because this is college..

Really nice Professor. Larger writing assignments towards the end of the semester, but they were manageable because we completed each section at a time in class. Really improved as a writer because of her class. Not an easy A, you definitely have to work for it. But I got a well deserved A and would totally take her again.

great professor, lots of work cuz its a 4 credit class but she makes it very manageable, goes thru the big projects slowly and clearly, rly hard to mess up the class unless u just dont do the work, also great with feedback and is very understanding of "when life happens", fair late policy

Super understanding professor, and really encourages you to want to learn and read and write, very caring and makes the class fun, I'm not required to take another WRDS class but would to take it with her. Make sure you submit assignments on time and do them before class.

Loved this professor! There were a couple of bigger assignments towards the end of the semester and because of her guidance and her class structure, they did not seem that bad. She definitely builds your confidence in your writing. She also mostly grades based on completion which was so nice. finished with a 99. Would definitely recommend her!!!

Literally do not take this class, he rambled on so much during lecture with some of the random topics being on the tests and were a big part of your grade. The exams were worded in a way that was difficult to understand. If you can go to extra credit go cause it literally saved my grade.
hes a really nice guy and honestly the material is easy to understand.

Attendance is mandatory, but DO NOT take this class if you plan to skip. Exams heavily rely on in-person lectures + include questions that you wouldn't get unless you were in class. Dr. Toscano is a terrific professor. Your grade consists solely of 10 weekly discussion posts and 4 total tests. The tests are very lecture-heavy, but attendance isn't mandatory. I don't like this course, but he makes due very well. You should pre-read and get on his good side; he is a good guy and understanding when it comes to grading.
LOTS of readings. Lectures are interesting if you've read the material and paid attention. Rough essay grader. But, definitely encourages us to think outside the box. I'd have him again

Was in his rhetoric of fear class. There were two major essays, Weekly 250 word reflections on course material and lectures, and participation grades. I thought it would be nice to have an asynchronous class in my schedule so I can relax more during the week, I was wrong. There are so many readings assigned every week to the point where it's impossible to retain the information. The exams have questions that are fill in the blanks from exact lines in the readings. It's chaos. I'm teaching myself.
The class is very hard. Although it's a good way to learn to write better,  the teacher is very tough and I do believe some ways of grading are based on personal feelings rather than the class.

This was a very well structured class. The professor cares a lot and is very passionate about the subject. It is a writing class, so you will be writing a lot, but if you follow the rubric you WILL get an A in the class. Would definitely take again.

I am not the one to put down a review for any professor. Whether they are good or bad, the fact that it has come down to this is pretty serious. I was a little worried going into this class based on others feedback. However, Professor Morton ended up being one of my favorites. Do NOT take this professors course, terrible. Worst moments of my life.

Will take away points for the smallest things. The average on the first English memo 44, not because on any deficiencies on the content, but because a heading is not bolded or you forgot a comma. Very uptight.

Too much reading and group work, quiz nearly every class, and attendance to zoom meetings are weighted too heavily. I did not enjoy a single moment of this class, I dread showing up to it every single day.
Def a lot of reading, and pay attention in class. It's a lot of busy work, but if you go to class she will work with you and be sweet. Just give her respect and she will respect you.

Ms. Morton is not as bad as everyone made her seem. She does assign lots of readings, and you do have to do a lot of writing in her class; however, if you put your effort into doing the work, then you'll be fine.
Absolutely no reason to grade as harsh and nitpicky as she does. She did give decent feedback sometimes though.
This professor's class was a total joke. The lectures had nothing to do with the actual course. Be prepared to read books that are just as interesting as the lectures themselves.
There was a homework heavy course, but Morton was very easy grader. We worked a lot in groups which I liked. Overall a good professor.

This professor grades harshly (I never received a 100 on a single assignment). Be ready to attend class and seem like you're paying attention. Make sure you choose your group carefully as this will determine your grade. Still managed an "A" surprisingly.

She tries to make her class harder than it is. She makes you read a whole book in a 3 week time span. Her lectures are pointless but she gives random pop quizzes so that you have to pay attention and come to lecture. Don't take this course if you don't have time to read 3+ novels back to back along with being quizzed on 100

Don't take her class. All around bad experience.

Great professor and a very understanding person. She is a bit of a tough grader but gives very good feedback; you can tell she cares about the class and wants you to improve as a writer and a student. Lots of reading out of the online textbook for homework.
Overall was a decent course. Lots of homework and the professor is a tough grader however she does give feedback on every assignment.

I was shocked reading the ratings for her. Her class was so easy if you just do the work - she grades most things on completion. The final portfolio is 40% of your grade like a final exam. if you don't do it and get a zero, your grade can drop but the portfolio is so easy just a reflection. Please take her class - she even gives extensions.

I had Prof Morin for the online Global Ghost Stories and Folklore class, and it was the easiest class I have taken. Theres a lot of reading, but if you're interested in the topic like I am, its a breeze. The grading was very blatantly laid out and instructions were clear.
She was very sweet and seemed to really care for her students; though, the class itself was very random. It was hard to tell what would come next, but the class was an EASY A.

I honestly really like the topics we learn about in this course and love the student discussions. I still wasn't believed and received a 0% on the project. I don't recommend this professor.

Had an assignment due for this class that was worth 10% of the final grade and turned in a decent essay. I was given a zero because it was done in the wrong format, not even given partial credit. On the same assignment, some of the class was caught using AI and given the chance to redo it. Would not take this class again or this professor.

Class supposedly about monsters but basically about vampires with a few others sprinkled in.Instructor mumbled and rushed through lectures.Grades heavily dependent on peer reviews and TAs. On top of all the discussion posts,movies,books & articles,you must read/critique peers work.Too time consuming, managed to suck the fun out of a cool subject,

Professor Morin is a lot of fun to have! It's just an English seminar class so the work really isn't bad. There's some group projects and the events (field trips) were always fun to go to. As long as you're willing to make some friends then it can be a blast!
Professor Morin is amazing. I am so glad I took this class!

Although this class was taken for credit, it was nonetheless an interesting class because of this professor. If you show up and execute your tasks accordingly, you will most definitely succeed with this professor. She is remarkably caring and respectful towards students and will not hesitate to meet with you in person if needed. Highly recommend.

I love reading and I thought a class about monsters and fiction would be really cool. This is the only class I've ever failed in my entire life... The books were dense and there's a lot of writing. The weekly quizzes were so specific that it was hard to remember the answers unless you were lucky enough to somehow memorize the whole book.

UCOL1200 was more of a club than a class, intending to give students a leg up in the ENGL dept. There were a LOT of useless assignments, but they were easy. A waste of time, but not awful.

Mostly responses to class experience and readings, plenty of the same questions to respond to just worded differently. As long as you meet the world count you will get an A. A few larger projects/presentations about college life/your interests. Class events are fun. She is not happy when there is little participation with guest speakers.

There is so much reading in this class, and the books were not enjoyable. As long as you read the books you should be ok, though. I personally really like Professor Morin, I just wasn't a fan of the content in class. She also had a bad habit of letting students ramble on about basically nothing, so we would waste a lot of time.

WORST INSTRUCTOR I have ever taken in my life. You have to read both ONLINE and PHYSICAL textbooks to take her extremely tedious weekly tests (NOT multiple choice), not to mention long hour movies. This course is meant for easy credit but she made it into a hard writing class about irrelevant topics. Do not take her class or you waste your time.

This professor was not ideal. Although the general assignments were easy, there were a lot of them. If you want a professor without passive aggression, steer clear.

The topic is awesome (Monsters), the reading was good (World War Z), the movies were great (Godzilla, Aliens, Cabin in the Woods), and the work was HARD. The class is more writing intensive than a writing intensive course and she grades harshly. If you are good at writing it's not hard to earn an A. If you hate writing, take someone else.

I love Mr. Sandlin he really cares about teaching and his students. He will get to know you and makes sure he knows everyone's name & interests. As far as the class goes I really enjoyed it, we have about 4 writing assignments (essays) and readings throughout the course. Grading is flexible and overall definitely take his class for WRDS.
Mr. Sandlin is an amazing professor. Gives amazing feedback on assignments. The only downside is that it takes a good bit of time to get a grade back.

Mr. Sandlin is hilarious and takes the time to learn students names and talk to each student about things they are interested in. He is good at explaining things and does not take points off for late submissions. The only reason I gave him a 4 and not a 5 is because he is VERY slow with grading. Also, attendance was graded heavily.

Sandlin held interesting and easily understandable lectures, he cares about his students and what they take out of the class. If you are looking to fly under the radar this might not be the class for you, but if you appreciate a teacher that will take the time to learn your name Sandlin is the perfect teacher.

The best professor I have ever had. The lectures are interesting and he uses time in class to chat with students and engage with them about things they are interested in. The work load is super light and he is super forgiving about deadlines and understands you have a life outside of class. His grading is forgiving and wants you to pass his class.
Cares about his students, especially cares about the material he teaches and manages to explain it in an interesting and useful way.

Mr Sandlin was the best teacher I've EVER had by far and it's not even close. Very passionate even during morning classes. Will talk to you outside of class with small talk and the course itself is very easy as long as you care. He gives great feedback and often calls on students. Takes into consideration everyones opinion and cares about his stud

Proceeded to give the hottest take that 'Cars' (2006) was a bad movie; on top of that, he claimed Inside Out was superior. Overall, 10/10 professor.
BEST PROFESSOR Just take him don't even think about it. If you made any mistakes on any of the papers he lets you fix them and resubmit even on the final essay. JUST TAKE HIM.

The best English professor I've ever had. Took WRDS1103 for a mandatory credit and it was my favorite course of the semester. Laid-back grading, flexible deadlines, and amazing feedback on your assignments. A super refreshing teacher and I recommend anyone to take him if they can.

Sandlin is a great professor. He's very engaging and makes a great effort to connect with his students in more than just an academic sense. There is (obviously) a lot of writing in this class but Professor Sandlin gives good feedback so you don't really have to worry about flunking the class if you're not a good writer. Overall an amazing class.

I love Mr. Sandlin. Take the class with him don't even think about anyone else. He's very lenient with late work and super fun to chat with. He makes everyone feel included. Easily my favorite professor in college so far.
Honestly is probably a Top 10 professor at UNCC. I wish he could be the Prof. for every single one of my classes.

If you have the option of taking his WRDS class, DO IT. I got the privilege of taking his class for my first semester, and he made this class as accessible as possible for freshmen students. He's not only just an enjoyable person to talk to, but he also has made my writing skills drastically better, and made starting college easy. A 10/10 Professor

This professor is amazing, He genuinely cares about his students and their writing. He starts every class with a time to connect and talk to the students, then transitions into an entertaining lecture. This class is enjoyable to go to even no days where I haven't been to others that day I always go to this class.

Mr. Sandlin is a W professor. He treats the class like a highschool english class. He doesn't count off for turning in stuff late. He gives good feedback on papers. All of the writing assignments are more opinion based, so he grades lightly. I always enjoyed going to his class. He makes class time super fun and enjoyable.

Mr. Sandlin genuinely cares about his students in such a compassionate manner that is refreshing amongst all the other large Gen Ed classes that are needed during freshmen year. He respects his students as people, which is shown in how he talks to students and is lenient with late work. The papers are actually beneficial as a person and writer.
super chill teacher, attendances mandatory and there's about 4 major papers. longest one was 8-15 pages but he is an easy grader. overall 10/10 I got a 99 in the course.

Mr. Adam is a great and very understanding professor! He doesn't take off late points for assignments which is amazing. He values participation in class, he's pretty chill guy, a swiftie, and cares about his students (he gives off history teacher in high school vibes). Overall great professor and human being. 10/10

Professor Sandlin is honestly awesome. Definitely one of my favorite teachers of all time. Compared to the other teachers that teach 1103, he does a couple more essays but in the end it is very worth it.

Professor Hutchcraft is amazing! They're absolutely nothing bad to say about her! She pushes you in your poetry, and truly cares. She assigns readings each week that are always so different and useful. She has made me a better poet!

Professor Hutchcraft is an extremely thoughtful teacher and poet. She sees your potential and pushes you to reach it in your work. You can tell she really cares about her profession, her students, and their work. She does assign quite a few readings per week, but they are enjoyable and useful.

Professor Hutchcraft is a professor I would never hesitate to take. The assignments she gives are always fun, manageable, and helpful for you as a poet. She doesn't give the usual and cliche poems out for readings, and she always offers something new and fresh. Just be ready to get your imagination going, and you'll be fine! She's truly amazing.

Professor Hutchcraft taught me a lot about poetry. Naively, I went into her class thinking I was already a great poet... yet, she had so much technique to relay to her students. Therefore, it was one of the most impactful classes I had the pleasure of taking at UNCC.

(There is no option for "ENGL-4202", but this is the class I had with her.)

This semester I was dealing with a lot of personal issues and by the end I had many assignments late, I emailed him explaining the situation, receiving an email of understanding and thoughtfulness. Just an amazing professor that is passionate about the material you go over and cares about the students! I HIGHLY RECOMMEND ALL HIS COURSES!
easy class, inspiring professor, would 100% take again.
He's an amazing professor to have, honestly, a great person overall, and there weren't that many assignments. As long as you turn in everything on time, you'll easily pass this class.

Professor Cary was great. He cares about his students, he is kind, and respectful. He responds to emails, gives constructive feedback, and is not a harsh grader. As long as you put in the work and do what is expected then you will do well in the class. I would definitely take a class with him again.
Overall, a great professor—easy grader, clear assignments, and quick email responses. Highly recommend!
Such an easy online class! The instructions are very clear and very organized! He is also very understanding and responsive to emails! I would recommend him for WRDS!
Professor Cary is an amazing professor. His instructions are very clear, and taking his course will definitely help improve your writing.
One of the best teachers I had for my first semester in college would absolutely take again!

Mr. Cary is a wonderful instructor. I took him for a second half semester WRDS 1103 course, and it was one of the best classes I've taken so far at UNCC. He is very online savvy, grades quickly and fairly, and even allows you extensions on assignments. He gives great feedback and has seriously helped me become a better writer. TAKE HIS CLASS!
Loved this professor. Very helpful and super easy work.

Very understanding (offers extensions w assignments). Just follow the criteria for work (5 assignments, a couple discussion posts). Only 1 final project (no mid term or final exam). Basic quizzes based on ur knowledge. Just do your work, show some effort, and you have an A. Very accessible outside of class. Take him, no questions asked!

I was in the 8 week long online course with Professor Cary, would 100% take it again with him!! He literally is the most nicest, forgiving professor and gives AMAZING feedback! Very easy course, just do the work and put effort into it. Got 100's on all assignments! He truly wants the best for his students! Take him!!!

This class is INCREDIBLY easy. Mr. Cary is amazing, and his canvas is set up very well, not many assignments since it is an 8-week course, the assignments are very easy and he is not a tough grader at all. would 100000000% take him again.
Easy A. Just do the work; he's always prepared to assist and allow you to be creative with your writing, and he delivers inspiring feedback to demonstrate that he genuinely cares.
Mr. Cary was so kind and forgiving. He accepts so much late work and values the fact that you tried, I got all 100's. He was so easy to access outside of class and was quite enjoyable to talk to!

Professor Cary truely cares about his students and strives to make them better. He's a super chill guy and the work is generally very easy to finish. His grading criteria is very clear and I legit got 100's on everything. TAKE HIS CLASS IF YOU CAN!

Justin is super relatable and an easy class if you put in effort. he is very tech savvy and I would always ask him for help using tech. he's a gamer and loves to talk about video games and incorporate them into class which is so cool! loved his class and he is a great guy

He is literally the nicest guy ever, gives extensions on every assignment, and as long as you follow the criteria gives you 100%. He also makes it fun and there's not too much reading. Easiest WRDS professor highly recommend

Great professor! He's really nice and understanding, if you're having an trouble with an assignment just email him he's really great and will respond to emails quickly! I would def take him again!! He would often cancel class but he got sick throughout the semester but overall great guy.

Super chill guy. We played video games on the first day of class. He gives great personal feedback and is super nice. He's very creative in his learning activities and they're fun for the most part. The few downsides are he's not great at actually teaching and he tends to cancel class quite often. As long as you turn in work you will get an A+.

Very easy. Gave 2 assignments a month cause she "wanted us to spend more time on those individual assignments." Doesn't really teach (literally has 0 meetings or anything). But she's fine and good at responding/understanding, so overall good.
Extremely little work, but the actual content is SO BORING.

Professor Karp is one of the nicest professors at this college, she loves to help her students and is super nice and understanding, she is one of my favorite teachers ever. Don't skip class because that's where your grade comes in, but she's a very fair grader and a great person overall. 10/10 professor.

Each person is assigned to a group at the beginning of the semester, and each group presents one time the entire semester, plus a final recorded speech, and a few essay responses every week or so. The professor is very nice and understanding, and will help you if you ask. Class also only happens on presentation days.

I took this course online during the summer & found it very interesting. We only have to read one book and it reads very quickly. Since the first day all the assignments were organized so we knew when everything was due and what was required. She was also very helpful when I reached out about an assignment. Just read the book and you'll be good!

Professor Karp was great, she was very enthusiastic at every class, and even scheduled our Tues/Thurs class to only meet on Thursday. Many of the assignments were quarter-long, allowing for the opportunity to have it reviewed often. Her class was not bad and I absolutely would take her again.

Professor Karp is fabulous! The major assignments are the group presentation, the individual presentation, and the final paper. These aren't too difficult to complete, and plenty of time is given to prepare. I definitely recommend this professor!

This professor is interesting to say the least. There are a total of 19/20 assignments for the semester. Most of which are 4.5-10 points each. The only assignments that matter for overall grade is an oral presentation and a paper at the end. She will nitpick anything on the paper she does not like, weather correct or not.

I love Gina, she is super sweet and nice. Only thing I disliked about this course was the due date.. things are due at noon rather than midnight which I cannot wrap my head around. I unfortunately dropped my grade by a letter because I was a dummy and mixed up the times. Otherwise, she responds to emails quickly and the material is very interesting

She is the best. You will have a good amount of assignments but she gives you plenty of class time as well as enough days to get it completed. She is also very chill on extensions, as long as you tell her you need one in advance, she will for sure give it to you. I would 100% recommend taking her class.

Took WRDS 1104. Lots of assignments but were easy. Lets you submit work 2 days after its due with no penalty. Doesn't grade too harshly. Final is a portfolio so make sure to save all your work throughout the semester.
Class was completely asynchronous, decent amount of work per week. Gave very helpful feedback on papers.

Solid WRDS teacher, no textbooks which is always a plus. Gave outstanding feedback on assignments / essays which allowed me to do well in the class and gave us lots of class time to work on things. Responds to messages pretty quick too. She seemed tired all the time which made her lectures a bit monotone but pretty chill.

No textbooks but attendance is essential. A lot of writing assignments but Prof. almost always gives time in class to work on assignments. Prof. is also an excellent and quick communicator and always gives clear feedback on assignments. Lots of reading as well but it's not super boring. Highly recommend it if you like a chill learning environment.

She gives a good amount of work either homework or essays. Final is a big essay, engaging in the class is important. Does give extra credit. She gives good feedback and open to discussing why you recieve a certain grade. Theres like 4 essays that you have to write.

She's very good at giving feedback and very caring. She explains everything pretty well. There is a good amount of work but a lot of it is just for feedback to make sure you succeed in the class and understand everything.
Approachable, Responsive, Encouraging!

Attendance grade is strict, you'll straight up drop letter grades if you miss more than 5 classes. Aside from that, Halaburda is an excellent teacher and very understanding. The assignments aren't difficult if you're putting effort in, but you might fall behind if you underestimate the class.

She is amazing! She gave great feedback and even recommended me for a tutoring position for the school. I am definitely a stronger writer after taking her class. She isn't too harsh and genuinely cares that you pass her class.
Very easy class as long as you did the work.
The class was named W(o)RDS and I have no WoRDS to describe how much I enjoyed this class. Ms. H is the best to ever do it. Peace and love. Love you H.
