2 days a week are lecture, 1 day is study session with TA. Have to attend minimum 8 study session, lectures not required but helpful. Exams are the only other grade, application based not definition. You actually have to learn the material, book is super helpful.
Very supportive professor and walks around the room to check in on groups through out the class.
Awesome professor who wants her students to succeed. The class does do group work weekly throughout the semester. She is very kind and does a great job explaining course concepts.
Please don't do it.

Assigns a good amount of homework (about 3–4 assignments per week), but it's manageable and straightforward. A lot of the class is group work, so stay on top of projects. She explains concepts clearly and is very kind. Overall, a great professor.

I never thought someone could be so knowledgeable about communication until I met Dr. Brais! She is so caring, confident, and wants her students to succeed. Groups are randomly picked at the beginning of the year. 3 group papers and a final presentation. Make sure to go to class if you want to do well. Don't take this class online! 10/10 professor!

This class was online. Prof. Brais is amazing and really believes in communication. If you are honest about your situation, she will give extensions and opportunities for remediation. However, make sure to complete all the assignments because they can really tank you if you get one or multiple zeroes.

Dr.Brais is a great professor and a wonderful person. Her lectures are engaging and she really cares about her students, the actual content of the class is interesting and is easy as long as you study before each test.
Dr. Brais is a great person but the class is exam heavy. She gives plenty of extra credit opportunities and is available outside of class. The tests are difficult and require a lot of study time.

Some of these ratings seem kinda biased. I passed this class because of Dr. Brais. She always made time to meet with me and responded to my emails quickly. Her teaching style is amazing--never had a prof care as much as her. If anyone thinks differently, tbh it's prob because they didn't try hard--just saying. Also she gives a ton of extra credit!

Dr. Brais is one of the best professors I've had in three years of college. Incredibly caring, dedicated to her class and students. Easy to work with, but can grade very particularly, so avoid simple mistakes. Exams are open note and very easy. Final exam is the presentation of a semester-long group project.

She does NOT mind screwing you over and failing you! I know of 30+ students who has to retake this class. Lecture heavy but nothing match the test. Test are hard and study guides are below lackluster. Two quizzes due a week and in-class pop quizzes. I went to to tutoring and never missed class and still failed with a 69.97%. BEWARE!

tests are the hardest thing. Harder than the LSAT I attempted to take. She just does not work with students and does not mind screwing them over. She was a fun person herself but terrible teacher, terrible professor, and does not need to be doing college professing until change happens

Terrible. Please do not take her. There are about 30 people in my lecture hall that are having to retake this class. She does not work with you and her lectures are more focused on answering questions than even making sense of what was being taught. Hard subjects and HARD tests. Tests don't match material learned. terrible class. BEWARE

Dr. Brais is amazing! She really cares about her students and their overall performances in the class. Make sure to attend lectures because the notes are very helpful. Also, there are Minute Responses via Poll Everywhere that count toward your grade. My biggest recommendation when taking this class is to attend PAL Sessions and find study buddies.

tough course but you can tell Dr Brais puts a lot of time into her lectures. but make sure you read and take notes and go to class. Exams weigh the most in the class but she gives study guides and tips for studying and she does a final exam review. She is very kind and caring, lets you make up work just make sure you talk to her.

this class was awful. nice woman, she doesn't work with you if having issues. makes you do A LOT of work. exams are super weighted/HARD. miss even 1 class=screwed. Your notes= only way you learn information. end of the semester my grade dropped 7 pts because she didn't go over anything for final exam. She screwed me over on 3 different assignments.

Dr. Brais is a very kind professor, but this class is super exam heavy. Go to as many lectures as you can (attendance is randomly taken 10 times during the semester at 5 points each), and take notes. Do the Connect readings prior to lectures and take notes on those too.
Very lively, clearly cares. A great professor who I would recommend.

Super nice and pretty! One assignment per class but she gives you time in class to do it and they're quick and easy. Plus, you'd have to do them anyway even if she didn't assign them. Easy grader and lets you know exactly what she wants. Only a few speeches the semester and like 2 exams. Says attendance isn't mandatory, but it affects your grade.

Semester long group research project with multiple papers ranging from 3-9 pages in length, groups are assigned randomly, you cannot change them. Only 2 exams based on chapters/class materials, not cumulative, final is a group presentation. She is super sweet, does her best to make sure everyone is getting along, and is being graded fairly.

Do not take Comm Foundations with Stamper. Class is ridiculously difficult for something introductory. Quizzes contain questions about minute details in reading and then locked afterward, so you can't use them to review for the final (which is cumulative). Reflection assignments have silly high word counts even though there isn't much to say.

This professor did not care about any circumstances outside of her class.She takes no late work, no exceptions. She made our final speech assignment exceptionally difficult with extremely strict and confusing/varying rules and provided no leeway when I desperately asked for help.

She takes points off wherever she can on assignments, even for very minor things. The tests are very hard and other assignments have high word counts even though it's unnecessary. Do no take the class with her if you can avoid it. The other comm profs at UNCC are so much better.

Dr. Stamper is a good portrayal of how to effectively public speak. However, she is very disorganized and tests are nothing like the lectures. Luckily, the class is easy enough to appreciate her lightheartedness. There are 4 speeches with an emphasis on minimal notes, helping learning, but making the class not a complete breeze.

one exam for the entire semester and that's the final (25% of your grade, lockdown with webcam)
IT IS THE HARDEST TEST EVER. Youre expected to know specific quotes from videos and ANYTHING you read through the semester. DO THE EXTRA CREDIT that's the only reason I didn't fail the class. She sends passive aggressive emails, telling you to use google

Stamper's lectures are almost entirely useless, as almost all material covered in this course is on the UNCC website. Stamper would frequently waste up to 50 minutes on whatever topic interested her that day. Assignments had inflated word counts to mimic difficulty. Readings were irrelevant. This class and professor only want to waste your time.

Do not take her unless you have to. She makes the course more difficult than it needs to be. Lectures were pointless to go to. Finished the course with the A because I did the work throughout the semester. Quizzes were unnecessarily difficult. Spends lectures talking about herself rather then the course.

Brandy stamper was one of the best professors I've had at UNCC. Her course was the most organized and accessible with all the resources needed to complete assignments. She would provide study guides that properly prepared students for the tests. There are a few long writing assignments but I prefer that over a ton of busy work.

I wrote a review on week 10, hate to say it never got any better. Stamper is horrible. On the bright side, the TA's grade everything and man do they look out! Shoutout Bryce! Do well on the papers, assignments, and extra credit and you'll pass.. I never got over a 66 (got under a 50 twice) out of 4 exams and still passed with an 80 overall.

She is probably one of the worst professors ever. Not understanding and so rude to literally everyone. This class was harder than it should have been and the only thing good about it was the TA's, Bryson and Meg.
I did a lot of writing in this class because of large projects. The test are semi-difficult and studying is a must. She does provide extra credit opportunities.

Her expectations for the work are usually not clear. She makes you use a textbook and a workbook that she wrote. Use the study guides in the workbook to study for exams...trust. Labs every Friday that were super pointless as we never did anything worthwhile. 3 tests+final which is not cumulative. 2 major projects and a total of about 4 papers.

I do not event think Brandy knows how to explain what she wants us to do. Super exam heavy, 4 throughout the semester and they are ALL super difficult (most recent class average was a 65), I don't recognize anything from the exam when I am taking it. We also have to do like 6 papers all of which were confusing to complete. she is also condescending

I'm writing this review on week 10. Currently have an A in the class. I've taken 2 exams so far and nothing ever matches her lectures. She uses a TON of profanity (to the point where its actually concerning). This A have feels like an F. I'm going too much out my way to get information for this class. I'll update y'all at end of semester

Dr. Stamper was great for my first comm course. I took this class over the summer and it was a breeze. She made monday motivational videos for us which I though was sweet. Packback discussions and writing, then an open note quiz. I look forward to taking another class with her!

Homework wasn't too bad, but there was a lot of reading (you could really just skim them). She will not give extra credit if you ask her, but she gives plenty of easy opportunities for it throughout the semester. I would recommend keeping your grade high for cushioning with the exam, as there isn't much guidance for it and you go in sort of blind.

Lots of reading, an open-note quiz virtually every week, and several writing assignments and/or Packback assignments usually each week. She rambles about unrelated stuff all the time (her "soapbox"). Labs which are so pointless. She gives no study guide for the final, and always acts like she is the smartest person in the room.

She displayed excellent interpersonal skills in one-on-one interactions, however, her demeanor took a complete shift during her teaching sessions. It appears that the professor prioritizes her own interests over effectively communicating the subject matter to her students. The overall content is not well represented on the test and quizzes.

The lectures have absolutely NOTHING to do with the quizes and final exam. The labs were also a waste of time. The class is pretty easy work but make sure you read the required readings, those are what the quizes are on. This class is new to the curriculum so we suffered as the "guinea pigs".

Professor Stamper is a terrible professor. She assigned readings that were over 100 pages a week and when taking the quizzes they did not relate to the reading. If you value your mental health I would not recommend taking her classes. Her lectures are meaningless and boring and so is her unnecessary and lengthy reading.

Mainly casual discussions/ going through the slides. While this makes for an easy class, it also makes class feel insanely pointless and boring. students expressed confusion about his strangely-worded/ unclear rubrics and guidelines, and were met with passive-aggressive/ sassy attitude, making many of us uncomfortable to ask for further clarity.

The class is 3 hours long, once a week, but being from home isn't bad.He really likes class discussion, and it's mostly based on opinions rather than the actual material. Like other reviews said, READ THE TEXTBOOK! Test questions are directly from the textbook.1 large partner project that's worth most of your grade.Don't be afraid to ask questions!

He is nice as a teacher and very available. However this class is basically like teaching yourself because what you talk about in class is not really whats on the tests or quizzes, they come straight out of the textbook. Also doesn't put any grades in which stresses me out.
Enjoyed the class. Professor was very friendly and available. However tests were very tough, and did not feel like we went over the what we would be tested on enough.
I personally would never take another class with him. I will say he is a good professor, but I often felt stressed with this class. The exam questions were difficult and particular.

I really liked Benny. He was very nice and actually made class engaging despite it being an online course. You should participate in this class as it factors heavily into your final grade, and there is a 10 page paper you will need to write with a partner, along with a graded presentation. Had 2 tests, midterm & final, and some quizzes. Not too bad

You would expect a teacher to apply things they teach to their life. She's frequently late to class, doesn't post grades when she says she will, and has waited until the last minute to post the study guide for the exam. This class is not hard per se, but it's boring, and you need to take notes and read the book; the exams can be very niche.

Her lectures can get a bit boring sometimes, but she knows what she's talking about and encourages participation; she might even call on you. Make sure to attend the lecture AND read the textbook; the tests include material directly from both, but her lectures don't cover all of the readings. Just your average lecture/reading/test-heavy class.

Professor Gossett is a lecture heavy read the textbook kinda professor. She's funny, quirky, and will expect everyone of her students to speak aloud to answer her questions. Very few assignments but 4 paper exams.

By far the worst teacher I've had. I'm trying to graduate I'm passing all my other classes yet this one cant seem to pass. She rambles and does review and goes through slides , however , the tests are 3-4 exams and the first 3 are all worth 100 points (300 total) and other assignments unrelated to exams are 10 points each. It's quite laughable.

She was friendly but would never cover any of the text then the majority of your grade be based on the text. Classes were 3 hours long of mainly just talking about nothing. Tests were very hard and the material was hardly spoken about. Didn't update grades regularly.

I had her for COMM 2105, RMP wouldn't let me select it. She's a weirdo, but a good one. She is friendly and clearly cares about her students. Had a final project with a group, and a few assignments here and there. Overall not much to complain about! I wish she engaged with the class more during lectures, they tended to go long and boring.

Professor Gossett is definitely a quirky lady but she clearly cares about her students and the material that she teaches. She only gives one assignment per week which usually take at most an hour to complete. She only gives two exams and one final portfolio presentation. Her tests are tough, but as long as you show up the class is easy.

An amazing professor who gave good feedback and engaged with students every class made the reading and work digestible and was helpful and clear on what she needed from us as students. The TAs were lovely as well

I took Cameron for 3052 Podcast Theory but that wasn't listed here. She's okay and she's engaging but her grading was frustrating and she pushed a heavy political agenda which bothered me, and she didn't seem like the type to welcome counter arguments. Most assignments were 5 points so if she took points off you really noticed. She's average

Do not take her for her podcast class or any class. Her grading is not clear, and it seems like she grades based on how she feels at the moment. She gave a 60 on an assignment she originally told me was good. Other students have expressed concerns over her grading criteria and she got annoyed.

Nice person. Petty professor. She hates phones/laptop even though her lectures are boring. She does not post rubrics and assignment materials when uploading work so you're constantly having to reference the syllabus. She's also a strict grader... almost all the assignments are 5 points and she doesn't mind giving you 2/5 over unclear instrcutions.

I took her podcast theory class, and I wish I could drop the class. She talks so much during lectures (gave a feedback survey, and everyone said she talks too much). She also refuses to post slides on Canvas. She is not clear on her grading either which is another thing other students complained about. The class is boring and difficult

Do not take the class unless you need to. Tries to keep lecture "brief", and rambles about unimportant things. Takes up too much time talking when we are on a schedule for assignments. Does not post notes in Canvas so attending class is mandatory for that. Test and assignments are open note.
Super sweet, but classes can be kind of boring. I personally would not take it again due to the lectures being boring, but the class was an easy A with how easy the homework was.

She listens to and hypes up students who participate and gives very comprehensive and easy-to-follow lectures. There is reading that needs to be done for the class, but it is free and provided by the professor, easy to read, and really interesting. She also gives surveys and adjusts her teaching style based on the results. She actually cares.

I really enjoyed Professor Cameron throughout the semester. She takes great care of her students, but she has unclear grading criteria and can be picky. I had an A all semester and lost a few points on the final presentation which brought me to a B because there were only 3 assignments to keep up my grade. Enjoyable class, tough grader.

Took his online course and it was straightforward. Course itself wasn't difficult but it was quite a bit, thankfully it was laid out well and organized so it was easy to follow. Last projects were lengthy and challenging but enjoyable. Only thing is that it's difficult to reach him which was frustrating but other than that, not bad.

Mr. Pope was a good professor in that his assignments were well-thought out and easier. However, he didn't respond to anyone in my class and didn't grade anything until the end of the grading period, so we were all a bit anxious about what our grades might be. The big project(s) at the end were pretty strenuous, but in a way, sort of fun.

He was a great professor which made it an easy class. Please take it online with him, we had to do barely anything all semester and just write a 7-10 page report and present it through slides at the end for our final (way easier than tests) which we were given an ample amount of time for.

Communications professor who can't communicate. He would not give clear instructions for assignments, he's difficult to contact, would take forever to grade assignments, and does not give clear feedback if you lose points on an assignment. Conceptually, the class is easy with simple assignments but that was not the case because of the professor.

Class is very low stress/no stress. A few group activities but mostly independent work. No tests but many writing assignments for different scenarios. One 7-page report and presentation at the end of the semester.

The professor gave use the option to make this class asynchronous, which was nice since I could focus more on my other classes. The class (as he taught it) was more focused on activities & simulations than exams & quizzes. He's a bit slow on grading and getting in touch, but I don't have anything else to complain about him. Has my seal of approval.
Accessible, awesome professor. I loved the asynchronous nature of this course and there were barely any assignments except for on My Lab and mastering. Final paper and presentation. Super easy
So helpful and understanding.

I loved this class so much. Engaging, funny, I never dreaded going to class. All you have to do to get a good grade is kinda skim the chapters, explain everything, and say something in class every once in a while. If you can take this professor, DO IT!!

Very chill professor, makes the class feel like a comfortable space for discussions and presentations. Only one group project at the end of the semester. Weekly work was just reading the assigned chapters and come to class ready to discuss. Pretty quick with grading. Would recommend.

Very funny and relatable professor. He is great with keeping you involved during class and makes it a fun/easy environment. Only complaint is the constant inconsistencies in grading. It does not seem like he has any clear grading criteria and just decides how to grade assignments in the moment. Barely any have rubrics either so you have to wing it.
He was a great understanding professor, and the classes were fun and engaging.
Brian is great and makes the class fun! There are 2 presentations you have to do, but they are understandable for the class. Not a tough grader as long as you try!

They call this man the GOAT for a reason. He loves two things: 1) the Washington Commanders, and 2) you doing well in his class. Funny, and engaging professor. There were only 8 assignments in the entire class this semester. He is an easy, understanding grader, but helpful in enabling you to actually learn and grow in his class. Take this class.
Great professor and easy work. He is very funny and is able to get people talking. I liked this class only downside is that he teaches the night class.

This professor was truly amazing. Make sure you read the chapters because it is an open discussion class. Barely any homework. One sales speech, one team presentation, one analytical report and after that he cancelled classes. Highly recommend. Don't take this class with anyone else.

Prof. J is the way to go. Don't bother taking Comm 3160 with anyone else. 1 personal speech, 1 team speech, a few assignments, not too bad. He's an amazing prof. who does everything he can to help his students. funny too. 10/10 !!!
Amazing professor, very engaged with his students and very simple assignments anyone can get an A in this class if they put a little effort.

He was a good professor, tries to make class as interactive as he can and his assignments are always interesting. There are some presentations that you'll need to do, on your own and in a group. I'd recommend to anyone that needs to take this class!
Honestly one of the best professors I've had in all of my years! There is a reason his class fills up fast.

TAKE PROFESSOR JOHNSON!! He is the most caring and kind professor. He has tons of experience in the business setting and he offers a lot life advice and business advice. His classes are structured in a way you've never seen before and he makes every student feel seen. He truly treats his students like family. The coursework is SOO EASY, TAKE HIM!

The goat. Don't think about taking anyone else get him if you can. Very easy class, only a few grades all semester and he doesn't grade tough at all. Anyone can get an A+ if you just do the work. Remember to dress professionally for presentations. 10/10

Best professor at uncc! He is so nice and so respectful towards shy students in his class. Only 3 big projects for his class which isn't that bad. Overall I would totally recommend this professor to everyone!!

Take him. When I read the reviews here I thought they were fake cause they are so good but no. Genuinely one of the best professors at UNCC, class is all about class discussion, there are a few big projects towards the end but you will succeed in the course and get so much out of it because of this amazing professor. Again, take him.
Truly a great person who cares about his students, he is without a doubt the professor to take for this course.

THIS TEACHER IS AWESOME! TAKE HIM! I absolutely loved taking this course with him. He is a very understanding teacher if you are a shy person and does not grade harshly like other teachers. He does want you to get out of your comfort zone by speaking with other students during class and I actually enjoyed it even though I am a shy person.
Excellent professor. Cares about you and wants you to succeed. Make sure you participate and read the chapters and you will succeed.

Professor Johnson is hands down the best professor at UNC Charlotte. I struggle with public speaking but he helped everyone improve by pushing students out of their comfort zone. Such a knowledgable professor that is down to Earth and looks for the best in everyone. If I could take him again I would, he really is the best.
There's a lot of reading and sometimes the lectures can be difficult to sit all the way through but it's a fairly easy class and the professor is extremely understanding and kind.
Such an awesome professor. Lectures are fun and engaging, and he takes time to give such thoughtful feedback on assignments. Take him if you have the chance!
Professor Black is great. Nothing else to be said. Very easy A and fun lecutures.

Great class. I wouldn't even call them "papers" they are literally 2 paragraphs. He is very passionate about what he teaches. He mainly uses the chalkboard, so notes can be hard to take if you aren't listening. But he's great, test are very easy.

Jason is THE BEST!!! For whole course, you have to write 4 papers (each is only 2 short paragraphs MAX) and 4 test (open note, take at home). Sounds scary that's only grades, but he wants you to succeed! If you try on papers he grades VERY high. No reason entire class of 150 does not get an A. Kindest and most respectful person at this campus!!!!

My favorite class to end off my last semester at charlotte. Caring, communicative and goes above and beyond for his students because he cares. Course work is pretty fun and he cares about students not only in class, but outside of class in personal endeavors. 10/10 course would take over and over if i could.

Jason made the biggest impact on me within my 2 years at charlotte. Caring inside and OUTSIDE of the classroom. He is what the example should be for all professors. He meets students where they are, never leaves anyone hanging and is always communicative. Treats his students like adults and respects our feelings and other obligations. Best ever
Easily the best professor I have ever had. Always available outside of class, assignments are an easy 100, and he likes everyone's different perspectives.

I can't recommend Professor Black enough. This is a man who cares a lot about his students and their success and provides lots of great feedback and support even with a class of over 100 students. He's one of those professors that puts so much effort into his course it felt like an obligation to get an A to show that all that effort is worth it.

Take Dr Black for this class if you can! He is super low-key. There are readings each week, 4 short papers during the semester, and 4 tests. He gives a very detailed study guide for each of the tests. Fill out the study guide and go to the lectures to do well on the tests. He makes lectures pretty entertaining so it'll probably be fun!

Absolutely believe the 5-star ratings on this professor. He is caring and kind, and you can tell he really loves teaching. He makes class interesting and is really understanding. His class isn't hard, just only a few assignments in his class that weigh a lot but he is very communicative so you know what you're expecting.

Jason Black was 100% the best professor that I have had at UNCC. He cares about his students and wants you to thrive in his class. His lectures are very interesting and you can tell that he cares about what he is teaching. As long as you attend class and take notes you will do good in this class. I would absolutely recommend Prof. Black!!

Dr. Black is the best professor ever! His lectures are engaging, inspiring, and you can learn so much. Grades are made up of a few short essays and exams. He provides lots of resources to help you succeed in the class, and he is easily accessible if you need extra help or explanation. He is very respectful of all students.

Dr. Black is the most genuine professor in the Communication Studies discipline. His lectures give insightful knowledge of rhetoric and how it has shaped our culture we live in today. He is a great friend now that I have since graduated and he is willing to stay in touch with his students after their time at the University.

Dr. Black is the nicest professor I've ever had. He always made all of his students feel comfortable and accepted in class, and was always accessible. He made such a personal connection with every student that shows just how dedicated he is. He was also very casual and understanding about course work. Take any class you can with him!

Class is pretty easy, attendance helps so much though. Tests are 100% based on what is said in class. He gets off topic pretty easily so be prepared to pay attention and know how to take notes that aren't from a powerpoint.
Such an awesome professor. There is genuinely nothing bad to say about him. My only complaint is that he doesn't teach more classes!

COMM3131: African-American Rhetoric. I really enjoyed analyzing lots of black rhetoric, art & expression. Dr. Black gave us his cell # & had personal relationships w/ us all! He loved all my work & tried so hard to get me to be a COMM major/minor. However, he's fully left-leaning, biased, intolerant to the other side & blamed everything on whites.

I came into this class seeing all this rave reviews about how great of a teacher her is. The guy is a good guy. But his work load is atrocious. I see myself as a decent student. But numerous papers for a class is crazy. Plus you will not know what is going on if you do not show up. He feens for attendance. Think twice about taking a class with him.
He is a great professor. He really cares about his students and the material he teaches. TAKE HIS CLASSES!!
unclear grading criteria, extremely particular. DO NOT TAKE!!!!!!!!!!!!

Dr. Quinlan is very sweet and has very clear expectations of students. There is a lot of assigned readings and discussion posts but if you just do all assignments you will get a good grade in the course. She is not a tough grader at all. I hate reading and writing and I did not mind this class at all. Her CTCM class is focused on health and media.

Syllabus is so confusing to understand. Final Inquiry paper had basically no detailed instructions. Weekly MCQ quizzes due Wednesday, discussion posts initial Thursday and 2 responses Sunday. Makes no sense why we have to post to the discussion on 3 different days. Would not recommend taking unless you're passionate about health and media.

Take professor Quinlan. She gives quizzes each week which is on lockdown browser so you can not cheat. I was not a huge fan of quizzes because you are given 5-6 reading each 15-20 pages long and we not allowed to use reading while taking quizzes as it was on lockdown browser. She is overall a good teacher. She is easy on grading the discussion post

she is WAY TOO particular about discussions. Instead of doing my discussion posts and responses in one sitting-- she requires you to add something to the discussion every single day. You must abide by these rules otherwise points are taken off. If you accidentally repeat a quote from another student-- deduction of points. The list goes on and on.

Dr. Quinlan is a very respected individual and for good reason. She cares a lot about teaching and her students. Expect reading up to 70 pages weekly and maintaining a proper attendance/work output. As long as you show the effort and engage you will prosper. Dr. Quinlan is very understanding and respects those in different places of their learning.

If you are willing to read and participate in this class you will pass with no problem. She does use a lockdown browser but you do not need a camera on. All you have to do is post a discussion post and quizzes weekly. She responds very quickly and gives great feedback. Optional paper as well! Do not be discouraged when you see the syllabus!

First exam there was a huge portion all about what the "professor argued in class". Why would students take notes on slanted opinions he shared in class and not on real class materials? 

He loves to talk about and stalk his previous students. 

He openly admitted his PowerPoint was from 2015 and hasn't been updated since... Don't take this class.

Pt.2 He will r3peat the same 3 anecdotes from his p3rsonal life every day without fail. He tends to ramble and almost nothing he says is actually helpful and then you'll miss the three important things in the 3 hours he's been talking which of course are on the test. Good luck.

DO NOT EVER TAKE THIS CLASS WITH HIM IF YOU CAN HELP IT. You get 4 grades for the whole semester, 3 unit tests and the final project. The tests include sections from the book (which is understandable) and sections for the lectures and the materials shown in the lecture. I use the word lecture lightly because it is actually medieval torture. Pt.1

Genuinely reminds me of a grandpa with no grandchildren.  Not a bad thing, but he talks soooooo much about his previous experiences and events that he doesn't usually get through his 80+ slide lecture powerpoints.  He had 3 50+ question exams plus a final group project.... and thats all the grades you get.  Good luck
Well meaning Professor, however tests req all info to be committed to memory.

Probably the worst class i've ever taken in my life. Didn't learn a single thing. Professor rambles on and on about nothing for an hour and 15 minutes, tests are filled with errors, slides of just paragraphs and paragraphs, no homework, no inclass disscusions, doesn't ask questions just talks about nothing. 

Shame I paid for this....... 0/10

I hope you're ready to hear this guy's biography before you learn a single topic from any of his lectures. Making all of your tests based around "your professors opinion" over the material is the biggest red flag I can share about this course, if you can avoid this class, do so at all costs.

Comm 1501 - Summer session: 
He's good guy, but his lectures are confusing and mostly irrelevant to the papers we had to write. The online format was overly detailed, making it hard to navigate. Be prepared for more work than you'd expect. If this is how he handles a 1xxx-level course, I can't imagine what higher-level courses are like.
Understanding guy, easy class to pass.

This professor does not know how to teach. Most test questions come from the book, and his attendance policy is HORRIBLE. Plz do not take his class and tell your friends as well. Your grade drops by a whole letter grade per class missed. He gives the most boring lectures ever and even me and my classmates have had trouble understanding the slides.

She gives decent lectures, but reads straight off the slides. Most grades are module quizzes and speeches. If you miss a quiz it will tank your grade, but she is generous enough to let you take them late. Speeches are not too bad if you pay attention and prepare accordingly, and everything you need to prepare is in the slides.

As long as you pay attention and do what she tells you to do in the rubric for each speech you'll be fine, just make sure you do all the module quizzes on time. That's what took the biggest chunk out of my grade.

LOVE Prof K!!! She's the best- supports you, encourages you, wants the best for you. She makes having to do speeches not painful like many profs might. Not a ton of grades, so definetely show up on speech days! I wouldn't hesitate to reach out to her for help in the future, also.
she does cold call during her lectures but she is very caring and does work hard to make material as accessible as possible

She overshares in class, most of the time it's somewhat relevant, but its always related to her personal trauma. Attendance not required but does affect your grade. Really test heavy, most of it is common sense, but either reading the book or going to lectures will help, don't really need both.

One of my favorite professors! Prof. Kuntzman was very knowledgeable about the topics and always gave good feedback on speeches and made the class environment comfortable. There were only 4 speeches in total, short weekly quizzes, and the final exam. As long as your read and do everything in the grading rubric, you'll do good.
Great professor! Easy to get in contact with if you need help and the course is very interesting.

Prof. Kuntzman is a very nice lady, but I would not recommend taking one of her classes. Weekly quizzes where you only have 5 minutes to complete them. The lectures were boring, and at many points in the semester I felt like I had no idea what we were actually learning about. Just an overall useless class made worse by the professor.
Ms. K will make public speaking a breeze. She makes you feel so comfortable in her class.
Great guy, but hated this class.
He is a great professor! All of his assignments have very clear guidelines, and he grades very fairly. You can tell he really cares about his students.

Personally, I dreaded every class. The course was all over the place and so unorganized. You basically get a 100 on everything if you turn it in on time so that is nice. The TA did a lot of the teaching, all the grading, did all outside of class activites with us, and planned extra events for us, but the professor never seemed to involve himself.

The class was not structured well including the syllabus and rubrics for assignments. The days we had to discuss the textbook it seemed he expected us to be able to quote the entire book. When it came to assignments the syllabus didn't cover anything we were supposed to do. Overall the graduate assistant did more than the actual instructor.
Amazing!

Vinny Evola, while nice, didn't really deliver the content in an engaging manner. Admittedly, the man was dropped in but still, I feel he could have done much better. Also didn't participate in a lot of the out-of-class activities.

I had a pretty alright semester with Vinny. The chapter review lectures were incredibly unengaging. Grading criteria was never really clear but you'll get a 100 regardless. Overall extremely easy coursework even for a freshman seminar. The class was extremely stress-free and overall I had a positive LJLC experience.

Vinny is a great teacher and a really cool guy overall! While the class itself was rather easy, the days we review the textbook are mundane, because they are participation driven. The rubrics could use work, specifically in regards to being more specific. And for the love of god please invest in looser pants.

Professor Grandinetti is a great teacher. I usually struggle with my textbook-based classes, but his lectures help close the gaps in understanding. He encourages class participation and is willing to answer questions that arise during the lecture. Would love to have another class with him.
Great professor. Engaging and interactive. He's also very generous and understanding of students' schedules. Assigns weekly reading assignments which are not too bad.

This professor is absolutely amazing, he is very kind and very personable. He was very accommodating to all students. Always available if I had issues or questions about the content or the class itself. Always came to class very prepared and always related the content in someway to his students. I highly recommend him highly as a professor.

Dr. Grandinetti is an amazing Professor. He is easy to get into contact with, gives amazing feedback, has a good bit of assignments and they are completion-based for the most part. Show up for lectures because he has occasional in-class assignments. The book is nice but I didn't really need it. Up to you if you choose to use it. Take his class!!
Compared to the other professor teaching this course he was the most helpful. He seems kind and always willing to help.

He was the best part of this class, and did his best to help save the class that was drowning due to Dr. Berardinelli's (other teacher) questionable class management and tendency to "teach" Python in the most chaotic way possible. Dr. Grandinetti gave long lectures on ethics, which got old fast, but he would always try and help the students do well

Dr G is a very good lecturer who is very knowledgeable about what he teaches. His lectures on ethics are engaging and interesting, and he is capable of meeting students where they are while covering high-level topics. The 1301 class suffers from disorganization, but Dr G himself is awesome.
Justin is the best! His classes are amazing and interesting. He always makes study guides for tests. He is super caring and flexible when it comes to personal issues. Definitely take if you can!

Awesome professor! Two easy projects throughout the semester, just make sure you put your time in. Make sure to go to his classes because he actually teaches a lot of the material. One midterm and one final. Just make sure to show up and study for those two tests and you'll be fine.
Great guy. His lectures are engaging and clear. His exams were all online at home, so as long as you take good notes, you'll be fine!

Honestly awesome professor, you will really enjoy how chill and fun he is. I would take the class again but you get what you put in. We were mainly graded through 4 short exams and I averaged a B so that was the grade that I received. If you are willing to actually study this is an easy A but if you wing it you'll still end up with a B.
hard grader, you could do all the stuff right and get a bad grade
rude not understanding and a bad teacher

Professor Viana is certainly nice but he's a tough grader and only gives you about 5 assignments to pass the class. Most of the time there's nothing to do besides prep for the next speech. His feedback is extremely clear, but you have to be sure to apply it or it'll affect future scores. No extra credit. It's an easy semester if you make it one.

This is my second time taking one of his classes. I really enjoy his lectures, you won't get bored. Our last day of class was like 3 weeks early lol. When an assignment is due, we won't have class that day. Definitely take his class, it is a breeze and he is super fun and educated.

The class wasn't technically hard, but I found it difficult to read his handwriting so I wasn't able to apply any of his feedback to my speeches. We also weren't shown the correct answers after taking tests, so there wasn't any way to learn from mistakes there either. I don't think he gave anyone in my class a grade higher than a B for any speech.

very nice and funny guy, expect 80s on every assignment, he wont let you in if your late to class. lectures are interesting, don't need to buy a textbook, 2 quizzes and 3 speeches. attendance is mandatory but he cancels class and gives us off days to work on assignments which is so nice.

I took his class virtually. The class is a good take in general but don't expect him to be lenient when it comes to missing work. virtual assignments were graded harshly. not any chances for makeups either with very little assignments

This class helped me a lot when developing confidence in public speaking. He is a tough grader on the speeches, but just follow the rubric correctly and you will get a good grade. He cancels class a lot to prepare for speeches, and quick to respond to emails. Teaching style is very casual. I enjoyed this class and think everyone should take it.
Prof. Viana was really great in my Public Speaking Class. He's a very interesting lecturer and he grades a bit hard but his class is 100% worth your time.
Super test heavy, assignments and attendance might change your grade a couple points but the rest is tests. Book isn't super necessary if you go to class and take notes.

Lectures were taken word for word from the textbook, so you don't have to read (it's free). You need to prepare for at least a week before your speech and he grades them very harshly but you can choose what to talk about. Attendance isn't mandatory but your grade can change letters from bad/good attendance. Open note quizzes.
The material isn't hard. He strict be ready to work, and his a tough greader.
Professor grades tough with no real outline of what he's looking for. Very few assignments. Had some projects where you have to record yourself presenting.

Dr. Reisdorf is very nice and caring! She is super sweet, especially if you go talk to her during office hours. Her class is very easy with assignments every week or two. You have the option to work alone or in groups for the semester. She is great at communicating and answering questions. I highly recommend her as a professor!

Do not choose the mandatory attendance option. Extra credit sounds nice but you will not need it. The slides get posted, stay home and look over them if you want. The quizzes are open book and common sense. Sweet teacher though! But choose optional attendance!!!!!
Easy class, with extra credit through attendance. She is very sweet.

She is really a sweet and amazing professor! Her class isn't exam based, we have a group project and weekly discussions that are a breeze because the topics are covered in class which are informative and interesting! You will not regret this class. Even though attendance isn't mandatory, you will still want to come to class because of her! TAKE IT!

Take her if you need this class. She is genuine and cares. She has brought up her political views a couple of times throughout the class, but she is extremely respectful about it and cares about what everyone thinks and has to say.
I enjoyed her greatly in every class!

TAKE! HER! CLASS! I cannot tell you how amazing she was. She is hilarious, caring & is so knowledgeable! Even though attendance was not mandatory, I still went to all her classes because she is that good. Super down to earth & just wants to have fun! Discussion posts, midterm + final. Just keep up with the work & you'll be fine! 100/10!!
Very kind and casual. Do the work and show up and you'll be fine. Extremely gracious with extra credit and opportunities to boost your grade. I'd take her again in a heartbeat.
Amazing professor!

I took her for a summer 5-week course. She was very attentive and as long as you participated in the classroom you got pretty good grades. The performances are easy as long as you prepare enough to seem ready. I would recommend it as a summer class because it removes much of the filler course material.

Quite literally one of the best professors within the COMM department. Dr. Riffe is so incredibly sweet and genuinely wants you to do well and cares about how you are doing even outside the classroom. She always has a listening ear on and does not have a mean bone in her body. She is so amazing

Professor Riffe teaches a fair and interesting course. She makes class entertaining and her lectures seem swift. She grades fairly and gives helpful feedback. I would highly recommend her for any communications class.

I really hope to find myself in another one of her classes. I took it in the summer so we did presentations through zoom but even if it was in person, I would not be nervous. She provides some of the best feedback on assignments ever. She's funny, charismatic, grades respectfully and honestly, and is an overall amazing person! TAKE HER!!!!

Dr. Riffe is an amazing professor that I would absolutely take again. I took her for public speaking over the summer and she made it actually very enjoyable when all of us had speaking anxiety. She is a very fair grader and gives you feedback that you can actually work on. One of the best professors Ive had so far!!

Prof Riffe is one of the best professors I have ever had! Her classes are so interesting and she is a genuinely kind person. All of her lessons spark conversations, and it kind-of felt more like a club than a class. Take her if you can!!

She is wonderful for public speaking. I took her over the summer and I enjoyed the class. I don’t really talk much nor like to touch but she very considerate. She’ll check your speech before class and give you feedback on it as well.

Dr. B is very sweet and is great at what she does. On pack-back essay assignment a week. She gives out the notes/ slides for the notes at the very beginning of the semester. She interacts with her students and loves to hear our opinions and thoughts on topics. She explains topics in detail and literally 1 assignment a week.
She is what others should aspire to be. Worth the price of college.

It is so clear that she cares about her students. Lectures were engaging and informative and she sends out all the slides early in the semester. The assignments were not difficult and the material was presented in a way that was easy to comprehend. Exams arent difficult if you put a little effort in, overall an amazing class and professor.
(the correct class code wasn't available.) can't elaborate here but genuinely weirded some of the class out with her alarming tendencies. strongly suggest not taking her courses when it is possible.
Dr. Basalik is amazing, she loves students who participate, easy to get along with and is hilarious. Overall, she made waking up early for class worth it, easy class and great professor!

WOW! BEST TEACHER EVER! Dr. Basalik is one of those professors youll remember in 10 years, she really left a mark on me. Attendance is mandatory, ests are straight from the notes. Super interesting class and she makes it even more interesting with her interactive teaching style. I was never bored in her class, TAKE HER!!

This class was fairly easy as long as you stay on top of your assignments and group work. Professor is tough to get in touch with and does not grade quickly at all. I have waited over a month to get some grades put in. She also moved our presentation schedule many times which made scheduling difficult.
Pretty fun class if you participate

Dr. Basalik was terrible. She's very nice but does not know how to teach. Her lectures consist of her reading the powerpoints word for word. The schedule says we meet twice a week but we only met once a week. She takes forever to grade and doesn't respond to emails. Super easy class but awful professor.

I enjoyed studying with Dr. Jiang and appreciate her guidance for professional development. The class is seminar style so you need to read and be prepared to offer comments. Participation is a big part of final grades. 3 exams and a paper developed in several stages. Workload is manageable.

Dr. Jiang is a wonderful professor. It was a great class with well structured lectures and seminar discussions. I'm grateful for Dr. Jiang's guidance and support. She helped me land my first job after graduation. I'm so thankful!

Dr Jiang is an amazing professor. I'm lucky to have her in my last semester. She is intelligent, knowledgeable and kind. We had interesting readings and good class discussions. I learned a great deal from her and from my fellow classmates. No textbook. Three exams, a paper, participation and extra credits. Great class.

She's kind a kind person but the course structure is stressful.. only 3 exams and 2 papers make up the whole grade. There's no textbook, but tons of long readings each unit. Exams are gosh awful.. she makes answer choices so alike and rigorous and have the nerve to say "it was an easy question". Makes this easy class much harder than it has to be

Dr. Jiang is a wonderful professor. It's a theory-heavy grad class. Some readings were difficult, but Dr. Jiang made the course accessible. I was guided to develop an academic paper step by step. She provided very detailed feedback and made herself always available to her students. I learned a lot from her and from this course.

Dr. Jiang is a wonderful professor. She knows her materials and engages students in great guided discussions. I learned a great deal from her and from my fellow classmates. No textbook, but well selected articles and topics. I would take her again.
Great professor and great course! I enjoyed the class and would take it again. I learned a lot. Dr. Jiang is very knowledgeable and very engaging. Truly inspiring. She made me want to learn more!
Trash. Nothing is good enough.

Really awesome class, awesome professor. We read fascinating materials and debate everything in a free spirited way. Dr. Jiang is super knowledgeable who skilfully guides great discussions. She cares about her students and challenge everyone's thinking. I learn so much from her and from my classmates. It's a privilege to be in her class.

Great professor. Dr. Jiang is knowledgeable, professional, and deeply caring. Her lectures are clear and interesting. I also really liked my group, my TA and the group project on AI. The extra credit events from Career Center helped me a lot. Would recommend.

This is a big lecture class with break-out labs. We had an interesting wide range of readings from Plato to AI. A midterm, a final and two group projects. The professor knows her stuff and I enjoyed working with my group and my TA. Exams are not too hard if you study (open book, noncumulative tests). Professor is caring. I learned a lot.

Boring, pointless lectures. Pop quizzes for attendance. AWFUL group projects that take forever to get graded and have unhelpful feedback. Very difficult midterm and final exam. Labs that are led by TA's, and very little actual communication with professor. Feels like I'm paying for the TA to teach me. Will not take her class again.

Learned a great deal in this class. The subjects and materials were interesting. Dr. Jiang's lectures were easy to follow. No textbook. Lab attendance was required though. Tests were not too hard. TA was helpful with projects. Extra credits available with good career events.

Dr. Jiang's class is clear and engaging. She is very knowledgeable. I enjoyed the readings (no textbook). If you know how to do notes (a few key points from the reading about 1/3-1/2 page) and participate in class discussions, you'd be fine. The class did take attendance (2 absences allowed).

Very strict grader and it's unnecessary, I'm not sure why she makes this such a hard class. Apparently, you have to speak in every class to get a good grade. It's just too much. She makes me contemplate the mass media concentration all together, smh. She's not nice as she seems.

If there is another professor that teaches this course, please take them. The harsh grading and working on readings every week, when only five of them will be graded was ridiculous, to say the least. The whole course criteria doesn't make any sense. On top of that, this was the most boring class I've ever taken.

I just want to start off by saying that this class was harder than any of the major classes I have taken and I don't understand why.
