The professor is very knowledgeable about the subject of art history. The course is very test-heavy, so if you want to do well, pay attention in class and study for the tests. The only grades you will probably have are tests and attendance. Really interesting class if you are into art history.

Graded only on a Quiz, 4 Tests and a faulty location based attendance system (PollEV Location). Lectures are long and boring, consisting mostly of “ummm” and “uhhh” (we counted over 300 in one lecture). There are no study guides or posted notes besides poorly made slide lists and the test content is either reused or opinionated answers. Horrible.

There are no outside assignments, only test and attendance, this makes up your grade. She is very passionate about art and expects you to be as well. Lecture heavy, and you must remember chunks of modules at a time. I would NOT take her again!

Every class is a lecture. She requires an attendance scan at the end of class.  Information is only covered once, and you're expected to remember everything. She does not like it when students are on their phones or have headphones on, she will stop the lecture and stare at you. No papers or anything, so there is no classwork.

Dr. Noble is a very tough grader. I have had her for many classes, and her tests are hard. A lot of her teaching is her opinion, which, while I agree with her on most things, it can make it difficult to remember what her iterations of things were for writing papers and tests. Instructions are never super clear and she wont hesitate to give you a 0.

Whatever you do, DO NOT take this class if you don't have to. Your whole grade will only be based on attendance, three tests, and a final. She expects you to show up every class even though half of the stuff on the test isn't even covered in the lecture. Professor Noble is a nice person, but she is one of the worst professors I have had here.

She is the hardest professor I've ever taken. She is a tough grader on the papers she assigns but gives feedback and lets you resubmit drafts to get a better grade. She always had an attitude with me. Her feedback makes zero sense and her lectures are filled with her own opinions. STUDY. Each quiz is of 4 to 8 artworks that she chooses from 50+.

Lowkey threw off my entire academic plan and made me drop a major because it was just that unpleasant. Very difficult class in terms of grading. Feedback is not clear and very nitpicky. Sometimes rude. Very outdated. Good info but not worth the mental strain imo. Very happy to be done this was probably the worst semester of my time in college.

There are certain professors that have lived what they studied and have fully embodied the experiences necessary to teach their subjects, Dr. Noble is one of these people. If simply curious in the brief history of the progression of art or taking this class for a major credit, I highly recommend. This course is a wonderful place to begin.
She is kind of rude and hard to understand., She goes too fast during lectures and the homework and quizzes are insane dont take this class if you dont have to.
Very boring lectures. Your grade is made up of 4 tests. The tests contain questions that incude her opinion that youve never heard. If you take good notes you should be fine.

Dr. Noble is without a doubt my favorite professor at UNCC. I've taken 3 of her classes and she is consistently great. She is genuinely so passionate about her field and you can feel it in her lectures. So caring, so funny, and a pleasure to be taught by. As long as you show up to class and listen to her feedback, you're bound to do well.

I have taken Dr. Noble's Medieval and Northern Renaissance Art History course and have learned so much because of how great she is. She showed concern for her student's mental health and made herself accessible if we needed anything. The course content was easy to follow because of how well-read she is and her ability to explain complicated ideas.

Good class, it's a lot of memorization though and the only grades are three cumulative tests and a final exam. Dr.Noble is nice and tries to make class fun. Just be prepared to take good notes, do NOT skip class, you will get lost so fast

Dr noble is a good teacher. She was very considerate with our class and very passionate about what she teaches. I never bought the textbook and although there were assigned readings I understood the class without them. You deffinatly need to show up to the lectures and write everything she says down. Study the slide lists.

It's no coincidence Northern Baroque Art hasn't been offered at UNCC for several years now. This professor literally made me change my major she was so awful, which ended up great because I graduated summa cum laude with a BS instead of a BA. The worst!

As long as you study the slide lists she posted at the end of each week and were familiar with required art pieces, you will be fine. Sometimes abrasive and not tech-savvy, Dr. Noble was a good teacher and she cares about the content. 4 tests: all multiple choice and based on a mix of lecture material textbook reading and misc outside sources.

marek was the worst professor i've ever had. the assignments made little sense, his expectations were unclear, he only liked work that he would make himself. he tore everyone to shreds in crit when many of us had worked on stuff all night. unfriendly, impatient, and seemingly uninterested in teaching. idk anyone who liked his classes.

Probably the worst professor I have ever had. Not due to the toughness of the class but on his decorum. His methods of breaking students down in order to mold them into what he thinks is art is outdated and problematic.

Projects were incredibly complicated, and the instructions were vague. At times it felt as though if you didn't make something he 100% agreed with, you'd be practically torn to shreds at critique. The projects assigned required a lot of out of class time to work on them, sometimes consuming full weekend days.

Had him for methods. Discussion based classes so miss one and you will struggle. Readings were very complex, but he was upfront about the class being VERY hard. Participation is a part of grade. Did terribly on midterm but met with him to strategize for final and went from a C to an A. 
Highly suggest meeting with him if you are struggling

The class is all lecture. There are a few papers after every unit. The exams are written and are based on specific objects/ locations. He looks for something specific on all assignments and tests and is a pretty harsh grader. Didn't take attendance, and I don't remember there being a textbook. If there was one, I didn't use it and got by fine.

This was the most difficult class I have ever taken. Many of the lectures are required that you watch on your own time, hard to understand, and he uploads hours worth of videos per week. It was a twice a week class but we only met once a week, everything else was done on our own. He is a very tough grader with not a lot of assignments.

In order to do good on tests, you have to know every single thing you've talked about in class. He gives some guidelines on tests (all handwritten in person essays), but for the most part you have to know every single art piece and you have to write a detailed essay about them. He doesn't say what pieces to write about, so you have to study up.
Not very clear instructions, favors Art History majors, doesn't have many office hours available (Especially if you are not an art history major) Take Dr. Emerling if you can.
I honestly took his class for credits because there were no other options. If u have other art history class options just take them instead!!
I WOULDNT RECOMMEND TAKING HIS CLASSES UNLESS U REALLY HAVE TO. VERY TOUGH WITH GRADING AND EXPECTS A LOT FROM STUDENTS.

Very funny and usually easy to get along with. I look forward to taking anything other than writing seminars with him. His critiques are scathing and often rude, I don't think I will ever forget him writing "So many missed opportunities to be interesting" and implying I have not improved at all over the semester. Don't take if you're prone to tears

Really nice and understanding, does online lectures a lot so beware of that. Good class with no assignments except for topic papers after every unit. He gives good feedback but make sure you write well and cite your sources for a good grade. I look forward to taking him again in the future!

I really enjoyed listening to his lectures. The midterm really brought down my grade and I received no feedback on it. He’s a very strict grader and if your response isn’t perfect you won’t do well. We haven’t had one session in person and it’s been two months since the course started even though we signed up for an in-person class.

If you don't need this class, I don't recommend taking it. I spent more time on this class than my actual major. This professor is a very nitpicky grader and will simply hand out zeroes. Feedback on exams was vague, and grading was inconsistent.

If you don't need to take this class. DO NOT TAKE IT. This was an out-of-major class that seemed exciting to take. Do not get me wrong, the curriculum is very interesting to learn about, and the professor is very knowledgeable. But the professor grades strictly on participation, and grades making it impossible to be interested in the course.

Just outright disrespectful towards students. Forces students to voice their opinions for a participation grade, then proceeds to spend 5-10 mins belittling their opinions or questions asked. Speaks unprofessionally and will spend much of the lecture rambling. I don't recommend taking this professor.

This class is REALLY work-intensive. 2 Quizzes, multiple essays, and 2-3 lectures as weekly HW. If you love African Art and analyzing readings, you might enjoy it. The professor is okay but strict about annotations. You get the weekly HW even on essay week. Quizzes are graded late with vague feedback. I spent more time here than in my major.

Professor Homann is an amazing professor. She is extremely knowledgeable and passionate about the subject and does her absolute best to prepare students for the coursework. That being said, this course is not easy and if you aren't an art history major, I don't recommend taking it. It's very essay heavy and she is a tough grader.

I know she is a tough grader and that you have to tip-toe around your terms in class, but I think it was a new perspective on Art History! She gave us one of the days of the week free which is fair for the amount of homework you have to do. If you are an art major looking for an easy art history course, though, maybe try something else ":)

If you are NOT an art history major, I don't recommend taking this course. You'll be stressed all semester. She's very knowledgeable on the subject but you have to be careful with your writing, she is a nitpicker and potentially flags you if you annotate wrong in an assignment. I don't recommend.

Lisa Homann is an absolutely amazing professor. She is deeply passionate about the subjects she teaches and an excellent instructor. Her class was difficult, but it was SO worth it. I learned so much, just, ugh, she's the best. Also, I changed my Zoom nickname to "Chaos Gremlin" and she actually referred to me by that name for like 3 semesters.
He is a professor that really cares about what he is doing and he goes out of his way to be accommodating to others.

A lot of reading and homework but you can wait til the last min and get it done usually. His lectures are long but he really explains things to you. You can tell he knows his stuff. All tests were open book. I literally have no complaints about him. I took it as an online class w lab. He wasnt my lab teacher but he is in all the videos lol

My experience in this class was very frustrating. There was a lack of  actual teaching outside of her tutorials, and Dr. Freeman's time management was quite poor. Lot of wasted time early on from her end that we are making up for now. I mean no disrespect, but Dr. Freeman bit off way more than she could chew and I am very overwhelmed because of it.

Really enjoyed the class. The criteria was fair and was quite accessible. I wished we had more in-person sessions as the material was difficult to grasp on occasion. Hoping for more critique but I blame my classmates for not being into it.

Unless you are a projected elementary school art teacher who likes crafty projects, then you are completely outcasted and treated like an absolute fool. I took his class and with every droning lecture, I found myself becoming restless with the lack of applicable info. He clearly has his favorites and grades accordingly.

She was a nice person, but the class was awful. The first day she tells you about all the projects you are going to get to do, and that half of class is for lecture, half is for projects. Nope she talks at you for almost the entire class, leaving about 10 to start LARGE projects, the rest to do at home. Be prepared to watch 30-minute TED Talks too.

If you want to get a grade back, be prepared to wait 5-7 business weeks. You are expected to read over the PowerPoints on your own, and then she spends an hour each class going over everything. She has a little sass to her if you forget your sketchbook that she swears you'll fill up, but then you use about 8 pages. She's nice, though.

She talks so much and leaves little room for actual art projects. When you do get to do actual art, she is so picky and will walk around the room and tell you everything you are doing wrong and call you out in front of everyone. She also is very particular on grading and will take off late points the second she gets a chance.

I really liked Dr. Wall! I am not very artistic and I felt like I was still treated fairly. Sometimes it does feel like busy work, but it is a lot of fun. I think this class will be helpful to apply to my future classroom. If you have the opportunity to take this class do it!!
gives good feedback, attentive, and knowledgable about material. spent many hours working on projects outside of class (3D Design). doesn't really answer emails.

I took Professor Yu for Ceramics 1, Spring 2023 and he is kind and supportive, but don't expect the class to be easy. The course itself requires a lot of time in and out of class, I spent 9-15 hours in the studio each week. He is encouraging and knows it's a hard class so he gives & accepts lots of feedback and is considerate of accommodations.

There are so many amazing things I could say about Professor Yu, but I'll keep it brief. ARTC2172 is a Ceramics: Wheel 1 class for all levels. Even if you know nothing going into the class, Professor Yu is going to always ensure you're getting the support and encouragement you need. 15/10 would recommend taking his class!

Professor Ellis is so funny and interactive with every student. The quizzes and tests are not hard at all. All she requires you to do is show up to class and interact in the conversation which is just your opinion on the art pieces. She made the classroom environment very comfortable and I would 100% take her again.

Professor Ellis is super funny and the class is really easy. As in, if you do all the assignments you will end with a 100% guaranteed easy. Going to this class didn't even feel like a chore, to be honest. It's basically a large group talk.

Professor Ellis is one of the best I have ever had. I took her class at random and was not interested in art at all but this class made me interested. Easy tests and quizzes that are open note and majority of grades are from attendance. She is lenient on late work and is EXTREMELY FUNNY. Best professor of my entire year. TAKE HER CLASS

Oh my gosh. Professor Ellis is literally amazing. She made me feel so heard in class, especially during discussions. She made me and all of my peers feel comfortable to share our thoughts. She is so down to earth and is one of those professors that you can tell really cares about her students. I love this woman. She is literally a queen.

Professor Shelly Ellis was honestly a breath of fresh air. Due to outside situations my grades went down and I had to be put into the UCOL class but thanks to professor shelly ellis and how kind and compassionate she was, everything seemed much better. Thanks to her inspiration words and honesty, Im doing much better. Amazing person and educator!!
She was truly amazing. Super sweet and funny!

I loved professor Ellis, hands down the most stress free and easy class I had in college. She also made lectures not mandatory for attendance and quizzes were easy and she also gave us the answer keys to all of her quizzes and tests.
very chill, taking her again for lbst art class, rly funny professor to listen to and understanding with work and deadlines

HILARIOUS, she's so dedicated to her work and class, and made is so enjoyable. Though she cut down the lights, which sometimes made me sleepy, she kept the energy in the room airy and fun. Her work is somewhat heavy with her discussion post and artist lectures, she gave flexibility to students and allowed late work. She also understood situations.
Super easy class. She was extremely chill and funny. Loved her class. Attendance was mandatory for half the semester. Quizzes and tests were very easy. Minimal effort can get you a good grade.

Prof Ellis is really funny and makes class entertaining. Attendance was graded for first half of the semester. Textbook is required but barely used it. Posts "study guides" that have test questions word for word so you know what questions will be asked. She knows that she is an easy A but doesn't care, wants students to enjoy the material.

Professor Ellis is a great professor to listen to. She tells a lot of stories and makes people feel welcome. For my class, it's great if this class is one of those classes where your major is one that's irrelevant to the class. If you have to take it for your major, take it with professor Ellis, she'll make this usually time-wasting class fun.
She was super patient with our class, and willing to help us understand the material. She was also very funny, and could relate to her students. I would totally take another class with her.

Literally the funniest professor and easiest class ever. Attendance was mandatory the first half of the semester but not the second. She talks about random art stuff the whole time. All tests are online and EXTREMELY easy. Every week there's a boring guest speaker and a discussion, but that's the hardest part of the course. Definitely take her!

The chillest professor ever she's so funny and will just talk about random stuff the whole 50 minutes. Attendance was required the first half of the semester but then she stopped counting it. Be ready for discussion boards and boring guest speakers once a week, but tests are really easy and the textbook isn't required.
This was one of the easiest classes I have ever taken. It was a good class to relax and multitask while also being able to pay attention and pick up what she was talking about.

She will actually talk about assignments that need to be turned in. She is very understanding of her students as long as you communicate. If you participate in class and do the very little homework you should be fine.
A true queen. Took this course over the summer, so very quick paced, and a lot of outside work. Absolutely loves what she teaches, as long as you care and try your best, you'll be okay.
One of my favorite professors/teachers I've ever had. Makes class fun when it could easily be boring given the material it covers.

I took Professor Ellis's class during the Spring semester of 2022 and it was probably the easiest class I've ever taken. Towards the end of the semester I forgot to turn in close to 10 assignments and once the year was over she put in 100s for all my missing assignments. I really recommend this professor if your looking for an easy A.
Luckily I did not have to interact with her much as my class was online because she's extremely rude.

Hairston has been such an inspirational artist and professor while at UNCC. He offers great feedback and is very helpful with assignments. He also adjusts assignment due dates, which is extremely helpful! If you can have an illustration class with him, please do!
Pretty much zero homework, and the tests were freeee. Hes super cool and funny and this class is extremely easy to pass with an 100. The only quam was that attendance was mandatory, but thats normal.
Very easy class, tests are free 100s and assignments take little work.

Very good professor. Our tests were multiple choice and online and he gives you a few days to take the test on your own time over Canvas and you get multiple attempts. The class is lecture-based using PowerPoints and videos and it's super easy. Participation and going to class are mandatory. He may not respond to emails right away though.

Easiest A you could ever get. Barely any assignments and two attempts on tests. Attendance is a big part of your grade but all you have to do is show up. You do not have to pay attention to pass but I still did sometimes, he actually makes the class fairly interesting and is a cool and funny guy. Would definitely recommend, I loved him.

I loved this professor, he is great.  SUPER easy class all you have to do is just show up (for an easy attendance grade).  His tests you get 2 attempts on, sometimes offers extra credit too.  Do not have to pay attention at all in the class to pass.  Great guy, very easy to talk to, take his class!!!!!!
His class is so easy tests are given over the weekends, their open note and you have two attempts. The assignments are literally like 2 paragraph responses. And the assignments are like one per unit.

This professor was super nice and extremely lenient when it came to attendance and grading. He usually accepted late work and he responded to emails pretty quickly. He makes class interesting and he knows what he's talking about.
Super understanding, fun and makes you appreciate what the content of the course is about even if Art can be confusing sometimes

Nice person, very social. Very nit picky in grading. Long lectures, students would doze off or not paying attention. Not elective friendly. Less learning assignments and more of flexing a creative style.

I loved jeffs digital compositing class, but if you arent too interested in digital compositing itself, you may find it to be a harder class. For the most part he gave plenty of time to complete projects, and a guideline to what he would grade on each project.

Grades picky on things you can’t predict that he never mentioned mid-way into the project. Lectures for a really long time when you could just watch one of his demos from canvas that is shorter, which feels like a waste of studio time. Good person though, love his feedback. Just a hit or miss.

Good professor! Answers to questions are always helpful. If I could change one thing I wish that feedback ok critiques was less nit-picky or biased on small things. But honestly everything is easy to understand, and he has video demos you can watch through if you’re confused. Instructions are always clear and he is helpful with anything.

Very funny and entertaining speaker, makes lectures really enjoyable, but you have to be careful not to let his stories take up your memory, you really have to pay attention to the content and use the study guide when taking notes for the class. For my class there were no assignments or extra credit, only 3 exams so good notes/studying is essential

Dr. Emerling is super passionate about his subject and makes learning fun. He tells some pretty funny stories that helps you to remember the material. He has open office hours, so if you are struggling, don't be lazy, show up and you'll do great! We only had three exams that are multiple choice, he drops the lowest grade. Overall an awesome class!

Dr. Emerling is an excellent instructor. He makes all the lectures interesting and even though there is no attendance policy, I wanted to attend every class. His grading is fair and he is consistent with helping students succeed. Difficult concepts are explained in ways that you will remember.

Professor Emerling is a HOOT. He is so funny and curses like a sailor, which honestly keeps your attention during his lectures. He cares very deeply about what he's teaching. Your grade is based off of 3 exams throughout the semester so study and pay attention. Some of the things he says are very out of pocket but hilarious! Please take his class.

Very respectful and kind when it comes to projects and feedback, has the great quality of an art professor who wants you to be happy and make the best work you can. Sometimes communication got fuzzy over what was homework/things to read on canvas. But overall super kind and gives great projects that can really help to fill out your portfolio

Overall she can be very strict on what she is looking for in a project, a lot of the struggles comes from her refusal to put grades on canvas and providing little to no explanations to why a certain grade was given, this leads to a lot of confusion on where you stand grade wise in the class. You have to work to figure out what exactly she wants

She has all the energy of an elementary school teacher but respects her students as adults. She gives extra credit on all her quizzes, which she does once a week, which are curved and the only "real" grades other than the final.

She is an amazing professor and it is clear that she loves what she is teaching. The class is an easy A if you go to class and take notes. She takes attendance randomly and is very understanding for missing class. One paper that you do in parts over the course and 2 exams with a final that is not cumulative.

if you take notes in class, you will be fine. one big project split up throughout semester, she makes it easy for us to understand. Makes class interesting through activities and discussion. Very easy to talk to and is wanting you to succeed.

Dr. Juengst is an amazing professor. There are textbooks for the class but she provides links to the free PDF version. Her lectures are great and are always posted online. Attendance isn't necessarily required BUT since the class is very hands on, you will not be successful if you skip. Overall, best instructor I've ever had.

Dr. Juengst is a fantastic professor and her ANTH1101 class is incredibly inspiring. Her lectures are great and the subject matter is important. She inspired me to add anthropology as a major and I am forever grateful that I had her as a professor. This class has a light workload and it is a great intro class. You won't regret taking it!

She is an amazing professor! She teaches by PowerPoints, but if you have any questions, she'll answer them. This class is impossible to fail. She does weekly discussions, but they're easy and they take no time at all to complete. Her testing methods are different, but fun and there was I believe only 2-3 test total. There is a final project!

He is a very kind, passionate professor. Work is pretty lengthy but fairly easy. I will say his classes for me were a one and done. I, and the rest of the class, sat there either doing work for other classes, sleeping, or playing games. His lectures were basically nothing to do with the work in class, but rather his experiences and interests. Weird

Dr. Murtha is very passionate about what he teaches. His lectures can be long-winded and hard to stay engaged but he has a lot of cool stuff to teach. Just one discussion post a week and readings as well as a few projects. This is an easy A and a great professor!

Dr. Murtha is the most inspirational professor I've had. I had him for a different ANTH class that's not listed. He's reminded me why I chose to go into anthropology. His lectures are always interesting, and he's by far the most understanding and down-to-earth instructor I've met in my 5 years here. Please take his classes if you can.

Dr. Murtha is very passionate about the topic. He brings a lot of his own work into lectures and discussions. There is a weekly discussion board that takes 10-15 mins tops. There is essentially no work other than a final project that is broken up throughout the semester to make it easier and that only takes a few hours tops. Very great prof!

He loves what he teaches and is super chill. you don't really have to go to class as long as you do other work which is easy he wants everyone to get a good grade. He is also really passionate about Anthropology and the research that he's done.

This is probably my favourite professor so far at this school. He is very passionate about his study and incorporates so much of his experience in his lectures that I am always in awe. He clearly loves history and anthropology and makes it so easy for students to incorporate their own passions into the class. Definitely reccomend.

There were weekly discussion posts, a research paper and a presentation, and overall, Dr. Murtha will work with you to make it possible. You can really tell that he cares about the students and his research and I really appreciated that. Also, I didn't do a single reading, but I made an A, so do what you will with that information...

This professor was really nice and polite, she is a great person. The only thing is that there aren't many assignments, and tests + exams are 60% of your grade, so if you do not do great on them, completing other work wont really help you. Could be an easy A as long as you really study!!!
The class is super simple and super straightforward. Although it is an online class, I've learned from this class than some face to face classes.

Lots of 1hr+ long videos she wants you to watch but you don't really have to watch them lol. you're supposed to be on zoom calls, but I think she had her dog in the room or something for most of them and you could hear it panting really loudly, which I personally hate. easy credits either way, passed with a 98.
A nice easy chill class
Took this course online, and it was very easy. Zooms were not mandatory. Had no set deadlines except on like 2 projects. Honestly, an easy A.

She's amazingly easy, if you do pay attention to her lectures they are actually pretty interesting but you don't need to pay attention to pass. Easiest A you'll ever get as long as you keep up with the assignments. nothing has a due date except exams. Which are online with no lockdown browser. It doesn't get any easier than this tbh.

Great professor and knew what she was talking about. 2-3 small and easy weekly assignments with 2 projects where you had to write papers, but they were not bad. I had her MWF, but after week 8~, she saw that we were "ahead" of the material and allowed us to do Friday async (from a vote).

The class was fine overall, and the curriculum was well-structured. However, Professor Mode is not that great at email communication. I have emailed her on different occasions, and in the end, I have to solve my issues. So if you email her, expect no response back.

Very easy online class, but due dates are super vague. Most assignments do not have a due date listed so even though attendance isn't graded, it's recommended just to know when stuff is due. Otherwise, just reading the slides, readings, and watching the videos is enough to complete the assignments.

optional async class last month. 2 papers- CULTURAL EVENT not part of ur culture & a book review from her list-ETHNOGRAPHY (100s). 3 exams (can all be found on Quizlet). HWs take 20-25 mins (if u skim)- reading articles, watching vids & doing a quiz. 1 hour if u sit through the entire video and answer questions after that. Late grader

ANTH 3090: Easy class self-paced she assigns due dates in the beginning then she kind of forgets about the class, there are assignments published but no due dates, but she provides the readings you'll need. Not super organized so if that's what you're looking for I wouldn't t recommend but easy A class nonetheless. Doesn't respond to emails.

Super easy non-business elective. We had 3 exams exactly what you learn or findable online. She had these cultural events  ( I attended a musical and went to the Greek Fair ) and 2 papers you write like 2 pages double spaced. Gives a 100 on both. 100% recommend for anyone wanting a easy elective to knock out.

SOOOOOOO easy if you're gonna take anthropology as an elective take it with her. Very easy the quizzes are easy and you only have two papers that took me like 30 mins to do, they are barely even essays. No reason you shouldn't end with an A
Straightforward class, lenient with due dates and quizzes.
Professor Mode is awesome! She gives a few fun assignments each week that are easy and fun to complete. Best class ever!
Low-stress class. If taken online you can more than likely finish the class in a month.

Very easy class. Never interacted w her personally. Very easy A. Everything you need is in Canvas. Have to go to two cultural events before the end of semester and write about them. Definitely take her class!

Professor Mode is a very kind and understanding professor. If you take her online class most of everything is online and if you need extra help on essays you can send them to her and she will tell you what to change to get a 100. One of the best professors I have ever had, and if you are taking ANTH 1101 ONLY take it with Professor Mode.

Easiest class ever (ANTH 1501). all tests online with no lockdown browser which is good because it often makes me more nervous than taking a in person test. 20% exam 1 20% exam 2 20%final exam, 20% assignments, 10% each for 2 cultural event essays. TBH if you even get a B in this class you sold the bag. takes super long to grade though
Mrs. Mode is one of the nicest teachers, her work is not too bad, and her lectures are fun.

Super chill class and professor! Only have 3 total exams for entire semester and you can use notes on all of them. Not a lot of assignments just a portfolio project that you work on throughout the entire semester.

She is most easygoing professor I have ever had. Her lectures are very easy to understand; there are only 3 tests for the entire course. Tests are taken on your own time and open notes. The final is in class but allows notes. No homework, she mainly focuses on projects. Attendance is mandatory (she does poll everywhere with location on).

Professor Blue is so engaging and makes the content entertaining. I always felt engaged and even excited to come to class. You aren't graded by a ton but stay on top of your projects, they come faster than you think. Pay attention, take notes, and plan projects out in advance and you will pass with flying colors.

Honestly the class was extremely boring and only lecture the whole time. Very monotone. The tests were easy and very few assignments so would retake again for another easy A. Felt as if she pushed her views on students at times and would call you out and make you explain your view if it were different to hers in a very uncomfortable fashion.

Nice professor that is very passionate about what she teaches. The lectures are kind of boring but informative about the topic. There are not very many assignments, and you usually have plenty of time to do them. Would take again.

Professor Murillo, is an awesome professor! I definitely recommend taking her, she's really laid back and understanding, an overall easy grade. We had group projects as assignments and had a lab along with the class. Attendance is via pollev, very easy to follow, and not a whole lot of assignments. Mostly in class, aside from the group work.

Professor Murillo's lectures were very "laid back" but not entirely boring. It was lecture's every class, except for every few weeks where we'd watch a video for group work. I really appreciated that group assignments were graded separately between group members, and is understanding with students.

Class was very easy. Attendance taken by Pollev. Lectures consists of them going over Powerpoint slides. Midterm was online. Final exam was in person but could use a 2 page cheat sheet. Questions were very easy and straightforward. Final project was easy and was split into a couple smaller assignments over a span of a couple weeks.

The whole class just consists of her going over a PowerPoint presentation We did have a mid term and we could use the lecture slides on it. That exam was online too. We had a big portfolio project that was divided into small hw assignments. We also had group reflections. Final exam was easy too, you can use a paper front and back on it.

Professor Murillo was such an awesome professor! Lectures were quick and simple while containing the most important information in the textbook. Textbook for this class is online and free. Their lectures go very in-depth, and you can tell how passionate they are. Midterm is open-note/book, and you get to use a note sheet on the final! They also do a review on the last day of class. Occasional attendance assignments and short group papers [1 paragraph/person]. They make it very easy to succeed in the class.

Blue is great. Had her ANTH 2141 (biological anthro) and it was sooo easy. Shes actually very nice and some days her lectures were super super short. LETS YOU USE NOTES on midterms and final which is soooo good. About 4 group papers were due throughout the semester on a video but throughout the group you really only had to write one paragraph.
She's a great teacher! Very lenient on grading and attendance, but the lectures are pretty long. She includes her notes with the lectures though!

Super easy class. Very chill professor. She is not strict on attendance. There are lots of video discussions to complete with groups but they are super easy. Not a very hard grader. Gives extra credit on exams so look out for that. Overall if you need an elective credit take her class. You will get an A if you do all her assignments.

very easy and fun class. most classes are just lectures (slides posted online), and allows for a cheat sheet on the final. only 2 exams, one final project, and you are assigned a semester-long group to write short reflections on a documentary. very caring for your situations and her research is quite inspiring. I would take her again in a heartbeat
Fun lectures and great content!

What a joke. Attendance is worth more than your (two) midterm grades, but her lectures are utter wastes of time. Easy A if you show up to class. She does poll everywheres multiple times during class and then grades one days worth of them on accuracy. Has readings due before each class but they are easy. Let's you use a cheat sheet on tests. Makes you talk to a partner a lot.

Is a really good professor, I would def recommend for 1501. The only thing that stopped me from getting an A was poll everywhere. Unorganized. 1 midterm with 7 essay questions, 1 project/presentation, and daily WRITTEN reading assignments. She is a really kind person who is passionate about what she is teaching. I really love her and want to take more of her classes in the future. She has a lot of experience in her field and helps you apply things you learn in class to real experiences. 10/10 Amazing teacher.

Unessay as the final and it was easier than you might think. The actual formal exams she gives are open ended and hard. She cares about her students though.

Peterson is a very caring professor; she appreciates those who share during class, and, in this class (ANTH 3161 Foundations of Anth Theory), we have very in-depth conversations. actually took ANTH 1511. Attendance is "mandatory," but I skipped all of them and just did the poll everywheres from my dorm. but DON'T SKIP SECTION--that's how you know what assignments are coming up and being absent will KILL ur grade. assignments are pretty chill, i never did any readings, just do good on the project at the end.
Easy class, just a few online quizzes and tests. Provides up to 11 extra credit points total in the semester and definitely wants her students to pass.

This class was amazing. She does not count attendance and is understanding. Least work class ever! Tests were fair and going to class was optional. Lots of opportunities to bring grade up. Chill teacher. Take her!

I LOVE HER DOWNNNN!!! Honestly, I wish i would've showed up to more of her lectures because they are so interesting and she makes the class entertaining and fun. Lowkey thought about changing my major after her class, 1000/10!

Professor Fuentes is the GOAT. She is so caring and understanding and her lectures are amazing. The topic is interesting, and you can tell she is passionate about it. Attendance isn't required but I recommend going to her lectures because they are great.

My favorite professor by a long shot. She was awesome. Very easy work and class in general. She is very passionate about what she teaches and it shows (in a very good way). She's super caring and makes sure any problems you have are solved.
She is super nice. All lectures are posted online so you don't need to go to class in person if you don't want to. Tests are multi-choice and there is little to no homework.

Her course is versatile to where you can learn at home, in person, or both! I liked her lectures and thought they were interesting. She gives plenty of extra credit and wants her students to pass. You do not have to show up to class, but it's recommended that you do. All tests were online. Take this class!
take her!!!! she doesn't make you attend class and every assignment is on canvas. I've gone to class once and just used the resources on canvas for the quizzes. very easy teacher

LOOVE Pr. Fuentes. I would take her again if I had the chance. In total all 3 exams are worth 80% of the grade which can sound scary but if you pay attention to the lecture videos she posts, you will be fine. Great class, helpful professor and TA. Use the resources they tell you about like the writing resource center!! very helpful, just go to class and ask if you need help very easy class.

I absolutely love Prof Fuentes. Great class just stay on top of work and try your best, professor is very understanding.

Great professor, My class was all online though she is good in person as well. For the all online portion be prepared to read and complete discussion assignments overall great interesting and informative class.

Professor Fuentes is amazing! Super understanding. If you pay attention on the lectures and take notes, you will be fine.
Didnt ever show up to class after the first month, got an A, pretty self explanatory. Very helpful and informative tho.

Dr Fuentes was a breath of fresh air. I had her for my 8 am and she was always very upbeat and ready to go, even when it was so early. She encourages students to ask questions and to challenge her. Very fun class to take. Dr. Fuentes is very caring and will take time to help you if needed.

Literally the epitome of the perfect professor. She literally wants to see her students succeed. Very passionate in Anthropology. No devices unless have letter from office of disability. Only grades were the tests and final exam. Johnson was a great professor. His class wasn't that hard as long as you showed up to lectures and paid attention. His final was also completely optional. Initially I was happy with my choice of this teach and this class. It was not difficult (its Anthropology) and there were no exams. Very vulgar in class as well.

I took this class online, but as a professor he was very good with covering the topic. There are no exams, and he is very enthusiastic about all the weekly assignments. If you ever had questions he would answer quickly. Overall was a great professor.

I had Professor Johnson for fall 2023 online. He was the best professor. responded quickly, was easy to reach, and assignments were fun. Mr. Johnson was a very good professor. He is very passionate and knowledgeable about the subject and is an easy grader. This class is an easy A if you submit all of the assignments.

These reviews are rather inaccurate. Me and my equivalent subordinates have struggled tremendously on this course for no reason, while we found our core courses to be much easier. Do not recommend taking this course.

He's very respectful and approachable. He makes the class interesting and picks 'textbooks' that are newer and interesting. They also take time to communicate with students and make sure they understand what's going on during the zoom classes.
Readings and discussion posts each week but pretty engaging topics and good workload. End of semester project was easy and pretty fun.

True gem of a man. Class was book heavy, weekly responses which are not bad. Two projects due for the whole semester, one for each book. Very simple overall but fun and creative. Adam Johnson is truly a wonderful person, has a ton of great insights and the class is overall very chill and relaxed.

The assignments are the same each week, with one project due at the end of the semester. Readings and/or watching videos are not difficult. A discussion board every friday that is based on lots of reading, the rest is whatever minus an essay and other here and there things.
Great professor! clear assignments and easy amount of work. one weekly assignment due on Friday, best class ever. if i could take this class over and over again i would.
lots of reading each week, but the material is interesting, and the work is reasonable. kind and responsive to emails.

This course was excellent! Out of all the classes that I have taken, I still talk about how much I learned and actually retained in this course. All of the lectures are posted online. Overall, Adam was a great professor!

I took Professor Johnson's LBST class on Epidemics and Society and loved it. The work load was easy for a summer class and involved two discussion posts each week. He is SO great! Provides great material to read and as long as you put in some effort you will get good results!

Prof Gulledge seemed to forget that Anthroplogy 1101 was about 99% non-anthroplogy students and expected a lot of effort from us for a gen ed class. Super chill professor and they even provide the class textbook free of cost. There are short quizzes each class that help boost your grade. You get to choose your final project topic and the format. Gulledge is a very easy going professor. Most of their assignments and tests are available online, but beware of group projects and picking your group. This should be your go-to professor if you're wanting to take 1101.

Great professor overall, always had the lecture slides published, no attendance was mandatory, group projects were really easy just be aware of your group, you will be in the group the entire semester. Only 2 exams the whole course and were taken online.
Gulledge was super nice and gave great lectures. Before every class you take a quiz on the chapter you read the nights before. All tests and quizzes are open note and open book.
Amazing professor, my favorite of all time! I enjoyed every second in his class and every assignment really helped me!
Really nice, lecture heavy.

Professor Gulledge has been great so far this semester. They are not super confident in teaching just yet, but they are getting better as the semester goes on. Reading quizzes are most of the grades, but there are a few group assignments, exams, and a final project.

This class was super easy as long as you go to class to get the attendance points and then try on the photo essays. The final essay just combines your assignments from the year so do a good job from the start. Professor Eldridge was actually interesting to listen to and I thought the lectures were fun.

Great professor! She made this class very low-stress while still giving really good and interesting lectures. The films shown in class are very interesting as well. Dr. Eldridge is a wonderful person and instructor. She is a great professor and this wasn't a difficult class. Great professor and very easy online class, her canvas is organized and easy to complete assignments. Plenty of quizzes and tests but you get opportunities to re-take them. I would say it all just feels like busy work especially the photo challenges but overall good for credit and she is great at what she does!

This class was super easy and nice. The content is split up nicely and explained in a way that's easy to understand. You want to do your weekly assignments and show up to class because there were in-class activities that you only saw being there. Overall, a good class.
Not much to say she was a solid teacher but nothing crazy.

Very kind professor.Took her for a critical thinking course, attendance is mandatory since the class assignments are graded. The end of the year exam is a paper,that you build up throughout the semester. Grading is very simple, just do the assignments on time.

Pay attention to the readings and any quotes!

I took Professor Eldridge because I needed credit but ended up really enjoying anthropology because of her. Her lectures weren't to heavy, very easy to understand. She is very nice and cares about you. Also super laid back and the assignments are really straightforward forward and tests and quizzes are open notes which carry the majority of the grade. Free A

Professor Eldridge was amazing and this class is great if you don't want to stress out too much. Wish she was teaching more classes so I could have her again!
ANTH1101 was a fairly easy course and Dr. Eldridge was a very nice professor the class is a little boring and repetitive, but overall it is a good class to take!

Professor Eldridge is very nice and a good teacher. You have like one small quiz a week and your final is an easy paper you build throughout the semester. Hardly any homework and very easy. Definitely take her if you can.
Weekly lecture vids and quizzes, usually with two articles and a video. Exams are pretty easy but make sure you come to class because she gives out a lot of points.

This class is centered around a semester-long project that is broken up into smaller assignments, so as long as you submit everything relatively on time, you will not have any problems. Dr. Eldridge is very helpful and provides very valuable feedback, so you will be able to make the necessary changes to your project before it is too late.

Very kind and caring professor, you can email her whenever and get a response fairly quickly. Only one 75 min class a week and not really mandatory. Just chill and like 2-3 assignments a week that you can do in under an hour.

TLDR: take her class, def worth it.
I loved her. She made the class easy and enaging, I have to thank her more than myself for the brilliant class. I only got a C because I barely put in any efforts but still I loved her.
Hybrid class. Class lectures, assignments on canvas. Attendance not mandatory due to COVID. Easy assignments. Assignments not worth a lot of points so make sure you do them. Overall easy class.
Very easy class. I had the class mostly online and she made it so you really could learn if you wanted to, but you could still get through with an A even without learning anything.

This professor is really cool. He makes lectures interesting and the workload is very manageable. Definitely take his class if you can.

Had him for ANTH 2121 (only ANTH option on here was 1101) and he was amazing! Super fun guy and super easy class. There isn't much he grades you on, but you still learn a lot from his class. Definitely a professor you have to take if you get the chance!

Prof Watson is so lovely. Very easy to talk to, helpful, and tries to make her class engaging. She does expect a decent amount of reading, but it's all pretty easy to digest. Very very nice professor. Her class is the opposite. If you want an easy A class, this isn't it. I dropped it on the first day. Dr. Watson is great! I would 100% take her again if I could. Not super heavy course load just come to class and participate. Lectures are very interesting and class is never boring. She is also very understanding, and easy to reach online

Wonderful professor and very knowledgeable. Interesting lectures, lots of field examples/experience shared, and overall learned so much. Tests have study guides and are straight from text and lecture. Great semester!

Professor Light was one of my favorite professors! You can tell she really cares about her students and she made lectures very interesting. No grades for anything, the grades she gave by self-assessment, a lab in this class is little hard but I survived and had B in midterm and in final B as well, the final is also little had but it can be survived.

Dr. Light is a fantastic professor. Her lectures are interesting and she manages to cover sensitive material with a balance of respect and honesty. I would happily take any class she offers.

Terrible. Employs a self-grading system, and many group-oriented projects without opportunity for participation. Does not immediately give the grade she thinks you deserves. Waits until the end of semester for you to see grade!!! Be prepared to put hours into an assignment and get a 0 on it.
Shes super kind and makes sure you understand

Dr. Marks is a solid professor.  He does read off a script sometimes but I find his lectures pretty engaging.  He incorporates humor into his lectures which makes them more enjoyable. Graded by only couple of tests that were timed and really long and also the lab that comes along with the lectures. The lab was mostly us watching monkey documentaries and taking notes. Amazing professor, I honestly only took the course for easy credit hours but he really made me enjoy anthropology and appreciate it. Exams are online and super easy, would 100% recommend!

One of the easiest and most interesting classes I took. Professor Marks knows how to keep his students engaged during lectures, and the lab is also fun, although a little boring sometimes. Do not take this class unless it is your major. If you need a science with a lab do something else.. if you do take this class make sure you go and take notes

i got a B out of pure luck on tests, and a study group we made. Class was not interactive whatsoever and you'll only find it interesting if you like anthropology. Very knowledgeable in his field, and I learned a lot from this class. Unfortunately, the only grades (other than lab participation) in this class are exams, which makes it somewhat difficult to maintain a high grade.

such a good break from boring lectures. funny! he doesn't post the lecture notes or slides... so if you're sick/busy, have a friend that takes good notes. he goes fast, but most of the things that will be on the tests he says "this will be on the test!" if you take it with the lab, pick the wednesday one. sometimes too long for a mon or fri.

This professor is unreachable—she says to use Canvas but doesn't check it. Assignments only open a day before or after they're due, and with four weeks left, nothing is graded. Wonderful wonderful wonderful. Easy A. Would take again!
This was an easy class and the professor was amazing. Take this course if you can it's an effortless 3-credit course.
Professor Strickland was great, she gave few assignments and they were all easy to do and understand. Would definitely take her again.

He was alright. The only thing graded was the tests (and the lab if you take that too), and an optional extra credit assignment. Class is only lectures, but all tests are taken at home.

Professor Fuentes is very good. She is super nice and has a funny story for everything. I recommend her to anyone looking to take Anthropology. Be prepared for not a lot of work but very difficult tests. The tests were the only thing in the class that I did not like.

Be ready to read, write and watch long videos. Only take this class if you have time. With reading and lecturing, you could spend hours and hours doing them. By the way, I forgot about the movie review; you need to watch and write one page in a single space; in addition, not enough time for the quizzes and exams. Too much stress

She is a very funny professor, and quirky. Her class was relatively easy, but there was a substantial amount of group work. She seems very passionate about anth, and seemed to enjoy teaching. Sometimes the notes did not 100% align with the tests, so beware.
Professor was funny and quirky. Each class was lecture but she is passionate about anthropology which made the lectures fun. There is hw each night and a small group project every few weeks.

I liked the lectures and the class. There was a lot of group work but the assignments were simple enough, you could take matters into your own hands. Very fair grader, something that helped me succeed was making a table of contents for my lecture notes since all the tests were open note. NO talking during lecture, kinda felt like middle school :/

All in all, had a great experience with this class and the professor. The class wasn't terribly hard, and the professor brought in good vibes and even humor into lectures.If you have to or want to take this class, I highly suggest Professor Lam. 

P.S. Take advantage of extra credit opportunities and take good lecture notes!!

Professor Lam is amazing! Classes are mainly lectures (makes lectures very entertaining) and readings (nothing very long).  There is a lot of group work though. At the beginning of the semester you join a group and you will be doing some short essay responses and discussion boards together. I loved this class and I highly recommend Professor Lam.

A lot of group work but not at all overbearing. Professor Lam is amazing and her lectures are so fun. Truly felt like I learned a lot and she literally gives you every chance to pass the class with a lot of extra credit.  The readings she assigns are actually intriguing and pertain to each lesson.

She gives good lectures and incorporates humor into them.  She always seemed to be in a good mood and had a lot of enthusiasm about what we were doing in class.  Tests were open note so as long as you take good notes, they're not difficult.  She's very kind and cares about her students.
She is very funny and does amazing lectures. Discussion boards are interesting and tests are open book. Just make sure to take notes.
Extremely great professor. Will be taking her again! she cares about her class and gave grace periods.

She is very knowledgable about anthropology and is a really engaging lecturer.  If you can, please take her course.  She is also very understanding with any issues that may arise.  Her due dates are very structured so there are no unexpected assignments, however, she does not offer any late work.

Professor Hoenes is a teacher whose classes can be difficult for the unprepared, his standard class is readings with papers based on them. His final papers will be lengthy.

Something students can be unprepared for is that he approaches religion from a scholarly POV and not as a matter of fact.

He is very nuanced in his points and helpful.

Dr. Freidus is approachable and will do everything in her power to support her students. The class is discussion-based and the expectations for everything are clear. She is brilliant and brings in a lot of relevant and creative material to enhance learning. She's all out here for the students. Would recommend again and again!
Discussion based with weekly assignments. Not true academic in nature. Topics were random and her opinion is what matters most.

This online summer course consisted of 3 to 4 readings/videos, a discussion board for each, and two responses to other students per week There was also a large and comprehensive final exam, but it's completely open notes. She gave personalized feedback on some discussions, which I really appreciated. She also had a super lenient late work policy!
Super easy but very interesting class. there are only pre-class assignments and 4 unit essays.
I would die for her

Professor Weiss is awesome! Her lectures are interesting, and you don't have to buy a book, she posts articles and videos online in order to complete weekly discussion boards. There are a few larger assignments throughout the semester, but they're easy and she is a lenient grader. Midterm and final were both open note!
Mandatory reading of 2 books- both were cheap and easy to read. Weiss is so respectful and kind.
Class was really easy, open note quizzes and exams. Really passionate about her subject, however it can get pretty boring.

Very caring and flexible with students. There's one project that is a heavy hit to your grade if you do poorly, but it's an easy project that takes 30 min MAX for both phases. Responds to emails fast and very kind to each student.
Very interesting to listen to, teaches us relevant material that can be applied outside of class, and cares about his relationships with students.

Overall, great professor! Expect a lot of reading and writing—8 short papers (2-6 pages) and a final paper (8-10 pages). He's very helpful outside class, easy to reach via email/office hours, and provides detailed feedback. Grading is tough. Come to class ready to participate. Just ask for help if needed. Would definitely take again!

Very caring and welcoming to everyone. This professor is excellent at guiding students to analyze and ask deeper questions about films and the Bible. Will have to spend some time writing 3 papers throughout the semester and watching the films in your own time. Overall great professor.

Dr. Brintnall is a wonderful professor. He's fun to be in class with, he's a great lecturer. He is very kind and understanding, and you can just walk right up to him after class if you have questions or if you just want to talk, which you might just because he is so cool and so kind. I would take this class 100 times over, and I miss this class.
This course has way too much work and is very time consuming.
No, trust me.

This professor is impossible to communicate with, she gives you very snarky emails and comments on your work.

All she does is run it through a free AI checker.
I'm not using AI and she keeps saying I am.

As this is an online class, I thought it would be relatively easy, but I had the most work in this class. Chapter quiz every Wednesday, then a discussion post. I was accused of using AI multiple times, even though I didn't use it at all.  Overall, if you want an easy class, this is not it.

I enjoyed the course work but my GOD was she difficult to communicate with. Once when I've had a problem and reached out, she acted all dramatic without solving anything. She has also falsely accused me of using AI like most people on here. If you can, don't take her course, though I guess it wouldn't be the worst thing if you did.

Be prepared to write lots of discussion posts, she will definitely accuse you of AI, even though you didn't use it, she uses any AI tool for free on the internet. The reading was okay, the book was not bad, but you will definitely get tired of doing pointless assignments. She does give some extra credit.

Would rather die than take her again. She grades based on how she feels rather than by HER OWN rubric. Worst prof I've had. Class itself is on a subjective topic.

Honestly if you can avoid her do it. Class is easy, just makes it harder than it needs to be. She gives extra credit on every discussion board, and gives good feedback. Easy A, but the professor is genuinely unhinged. She randomly changes guidelines without telling anyone, acts unpredictably, and responds in ways that feel more like power trips than teaching. Do not take her if you have a choice. The classwork is easy, but she grades so tough. She will read every single word you type, so beware. She gave me a zero on a paper because she suspected AI use, which I didn't use. She also takes off major points for missing the smallest things...like including a word count at the end. RUN

She is simply annoying. This class is required for all majors, so she decides to give us insane amounts of pointless, time-wasting busy work. Even after the main course work of going through our book was done, she just created more assignments that wasted our time. She also gives no grace, period, and was kind of condescending when emailing.

With the amount of reading and writing that must be done for this class, I can definitely say it was a challenge. I'm also not a fan of the mandatory group work with screenshots of my face. annoying prof, my grandpa died and this woman couldn't give me 2 extra days to do an assignment. This class was the biggest headache. I was on top of things and will probably get an A, but she does not make it easy. I didn't even mind the reading, there was just too much work for a gen ed, and she isn't a gracious grader. Simply just a miserable class, ironic since it's about how to be happy.
This professor simply just doesn't care about her students or their well being. She talks about retiring because of the use of ai. However still teaches miserably.

don't take if you want an chill easy class, 500 word discussion board ,100 word reply, lockdown quiz every week, everything through first ai detector she finds. requires group work and screenshots of zoom meetings. if u really want to read the textbook and care to do the work you will be fine but i feel like she makes it unnecessarily hard

Professor Sinclair puts in effort and is responsive. BUT she makes Critical Thinking FAR too rigorous and detailed. This professor checks your online work using a random AI checker. (she uses the first website that pops up on google no joke)  Useless group projects that she forces onto you. She is very nice and accessible. Weekly readings and quizzes with discussion post. They aren't too hard but if you aren't a reader you'll probably have troubles with the course. I haven't gotten my final grade yet right now it's solid.
She is great teacher and brings up many interesting topics in the class. Also, she gives a lot of time for assignments.

My heart gets butterflies when I think about Prof. Shedd. We watched a lot of YouTube documentaries and had long class conversations. Pretty easy class, but the type of people who take this course are just insufferable. Not her fault at all but my eyes hurt from how often I was rolling them. She is a great professor. Her class is super chill and it's an easy A. There's easy prep work for class and just one paper and one test at the end of the semester. Absolutely wonderful professor. some assinments are due at 12:20 pm so that was odd,  but other then that it was a great class.

Professor Shedd is amazing! She gives back great feedback. Professor Shedd made the course material really interesting and was hilarious in class. Her final exam is pretty straightforward and any projects or papers she gives are fairly easy.

I loved this course! Although the workload is 2x as much work, it is completely do-able. I recommend this class and professor, she's hilarious and knowledgeable.

Professor. Shedd was a wonderful teacher for me. She's quick to respond to emails and our work was self paced. I really enjoyed the class and recommend it.

You write a hefty amount of papers in this class, but it's completely appropriate relative to the format. Get yourself a Grammarly account and go ham with it. A really entertaining class with great lectures that are really interesting. The are a few homework assignments, but nothing to difficult. She is an easy grader and her assignments are incredibly easy. She does go off topic a lot but answers all students questions. Pretty easy A if you attend class.
she slays so hard, she is not very consistent with grading and puts things in last minute but awesome and based professor

she was nice and gave good feedback. final exam was 100 questions, quizzes were alright.

Dr. Shedd is extraordinarily kind, and very easy to talk to. Her class was pleasant to be in, and I liked talking to her after class about random topics or if I had any questions. This class was so interesting! If you have the chance to take this class with Professor Shedd, do it!

As the semester goes on, the class becomes less about the religions of Native Americans and more focused on her rants about climate change and Duke Energy. Two extra cred opportunities. RELS1512 is definitely not a hard class. Show up, do the readings, and read the book she assigns due by October. Extremely anti-ai usage.

This class is fairly easy as long as you read the weekly chapters and take the reading notes. The readings are not long either. She is very passionate about what she teaches and has a great personality overall.

The only grades are based on book readings that have a weekly quiz. The lectures are a waste of time because she doesn't even know what she is teaching. Occasionally unclear assignments, but Katsanos held a respectable class and seemed to really care about students had to say. Attendance is very important since all of the assignment can only be turned in in person. Interesting lectures.

Very nice and social. Definitely a good class to take if you like class participation. Only grades are Friday quizzes and weekly reading notes. As long as you keep up with that you'll pass easily! Only reason I got a B is because of attendance but if you do good with that then it should be no problem

She was overall okay. I didn't do so good because it was a lot of notes and quizzes per week, and while taking other hard classes it was hard to balance. Overall it was fine, but if you could take it online or with another professor if you are taking difficult classes for the semester, I would.

A super easy class. Graded on attendance, notes on the reading, and weekly quizzes. The quizzes are all open note. You do have to read a lot and take 2 pages of notes a week which is kind of overwhelming but if you do your notes it is a super easy pass. She is very clearly passionate and knowledgable about the subject.

Not too difficult, just come to class, be ready to read because there are weekly tests every Friday. We had a 400 page book we were tested on at the end of the year but it really wasn't worth much. A bit of a tedious class but an easy A.

A very kind person, to start with. Weekly 10 question quiz, easy if you do the reading. Class is interactive you are not required to talk however. Lots of extra credit. The content is interesting and you can tell the professor cares. I couldn't praise this professor enough, highly recommend her class.

10 questions quizzes every week based on weekly reading. She's really nice and offers extra credit. I'd take her again, just make sure that you do the reading for her class, because the quizzes aren't the easiest.

Quiz every week based on (free) textbook reading that was at MINIMUM 40 pages long each and very definition and technical language heavy. Papers and final on the novel were easy but weekly quizzes were not. Even if you read, the quizzes are very hard. Lots of group work, too.

Professor Katsanos teaches about activism for climate change, with religious contexts later on. This was one of the best classes I have taken and I can't recommend it enough. The class is fun and involved if you would like it to be and it isn't too difficult to get an A if you try a little. There are weekly quizzes but they are very easy.

I took her async RELS class. Make sure you do the online work a couple of days before, because if your computer messes up, she won't re-open it (hence my B). Other than that, it is super easy. Never really talked to her. Attendance is mandatory, but she drops 2 attendance grades. Tests and all other assignments are online. TA was super nice.

Super disorganized, looks to you to lead class, goes off topic of class to speak on her own interests. Otherwise extremely easy, once a week 10 question quiz on a usually pretty short reading you can skim (or skip you'll be fine). Takes attendance every class and is part of your grade. Lots of awkward silence tho lol.

Always late and going to her office for 20+ minutes for a class less than an hour long. Extremely unprofessional and disorganized. Lectures are all over the place and lack fluidity. She is kind of funny, though, unless you do something she doesn't like. She tried to keep my final project and was annoyed when I wanted it back.
Her class is not bad at all. You read like one article and then do a short quiz and show up to class and that's literally it. Easiest A of all time. Can not recommend enough

Grading criteria is not clear at all. Expected us to understand Hebrew in the first week? Some readings were genuinely, visually, unintelligible. I was lucky to pass with a 70.

I have a 4.0 in my junior year, and had to withdraw from this class because I got C's on everything, even a discussion post. I would not waste my energy on this elective.

Lots of readings that aren't screen reader friendly and lots of information to process in this class. Short answer and multiple-choice tests/quizzes. Professor Thiede is very caring and wants students to succeed. Her lectures and communications are very encouraging. This is not an easy A class but it is interesting and enjoyable!

I'm pretty sure Dr. Thiede truly does care about her students and wants us to excel in the class, but this class is overall too difficult. We're only graded on 6 exams, 2 are short answer. I wish we had more homework or something where we can apply the immense amount of reading she gives. Just wanted a simple class before I graduated.
A ton of material to read only grades are quizzes at the end of each module.

Weekly discussion posts on padelt but responses are not required. 3 in-class writing assignmnets with respondus, a paper proposal, a final paper, and a labbing assignment which is a student-holding lecture. She is an easier grader on DQs but tougher on others. Go to office hours, always ask for clarification, participation and attendance required.

Dr. Thiede is one of the most caring, inspirational, and devout professors I have ever had the joy of working with. She makes it obvious every day how much she values her students and has so much respect for us. If I could take every single class with her, I would.

Its very lecture heavy and she expects you to participate in the discussions but the discussions are interesting. The only thing graded in that class is quizzes so your entire grade rides in you passing the quizzes. She is nice though and makes it known that she is always available to help.
The best thing to do when you need help in her class is to ask for it. That's the key to getting an A.

The modules and reading material is jam packed and no real outline . Tests and quizzes with a lot of information and then open ended questions, multiple choice and only a few true and false. Would not recommend.

She was an ok professor.  Her lectures were a little boring and most of our learning was done with the several readings she provided.  Her quiz questions were very specific sometimes which made it difficult unless you took very thorough notes.  Your grade is also very dependent on quizzes.

Dr Thiede is a seriously inspirational and caring professor. This woman is so smart she amazed me every class. You have 1 quiz a week and that is what your grade is based on. I took this course online and she grades everything too harsh and assumes literally everything is ai. Do not take this class if you're a strong writer because she will automatically give you a zero even if the work is your own.

I really enjoyed this class and the professor. She gives amazing feedback. She doesn't care if your work is perfect, she cares if you're really thinking through the material and engaging with it. I would absolutely recommend her and this class.

Dr. Maguire is honestly a great professor. She made learning about religion gripping and not a pain. There were readings every week, but they were easy as long as you didn't wait until the last minute. HIGHLY recommend taking Dr. Maguire!

If you have the chance to take this professor, DO IT! This is the second class I have taken with her and she is amazing. Her instructions and rubrics are very clear, and she takes her time to give great feedback. It is obvious how much she enjoys teaching, and she is without a doubt the best professor I have had thus far.
Loved her! She gave amazing feedback and took the time to make sure students understood everything. Easy grader too.
I honestly loved this class. Ms. Maguire is good at speaking and giving key information. The TAs were amazing at their jobs. Javan especially was very understanding and helpful.

Amazing. Smart. Approachable.

Dr. Maguire is so interesting and I love her! She definitely loves to converse both in and out of the classroom. You can tell she's really passionate about what she teaches. incredibly thought-provoking and a really enjoyable prof.
Really fun professor and engaging coursework and reading material!

She is a very kind and understanding professor. I took her class RELS 1512; it is a reading-heavy class, but the readings she assigns are easy, and every week there is a paper quiz. I miss taking her class. Great person and a great teacher.

I love Dr. K! I took her for a critical thinking and communication class and it was truly so engaging and fun. She is very witty and personable and is an easy grader as long as you show up and participate. I am taking her again next semester, I highly recommend her
Loved this class!
Very caring and kind professor! Taught the class well and makes it very easy to get an A.

Dr. K is awesome! This course was an open discussion between students with her aiding discussion with questions and additional information. The readings were interesting, but long. Professor McDaniel is a strange person. Her class is VERY easy and as long as you show up and do the homework, you'll end with an A. However, her personality and her "jokes" are off putting.

unless youre super interested in this stuff, it feels like a bunch of busy work with kinda unclear directions and tough grading. shes a nice prof, but this class bores me. lots of movies and long (1hr) videos throughout the semester

This class was truthfully so so boring. It was an easy A, but I dreaded waking up to sit through that class. The course material is just very uninteresting unless you're into the bible and ancient history.

Not a difficult class to pass. Such such such an amazing and inspirational professor. Could not recommend her more. Please take if you need any kind of Religious Studies credit or just as an elective!

Great Professor, Gives good lectures and explanations. Pay attention in class and study a mild amount outside of class and your golden!
