Amazing professor. I came into this class not knowing anything about baseball, but Dr. Barto teaches in a way that will make it very interesting. His lectures are engaging and interactive! If I could take another class with him, I definitely would.
Professor was fun and funny. Class was meh, the first half of the semester was bad for me because I hated baseball statistics but the second half was easy which made it kinda fun.

Professor bartos classes are fun and he makes the class fair and enjoyable. He is very clear in the set up- participation will be an important part of your grade and be sure to read the study guides for all quizzes and you should get an easy A or B.

If you know absolutely nothing about baseball, it might be a bit difficult because class consists a lot about baseball stats. His grading rubric is very clear and provided an outline for the whole semester on expect for every class period. As long as you read the chapters for the quizzes, attend class, and follow the rubric you'll do good!
I highly doubt there is a better LBST 2301 class being offered at UNCC. If Dr. Barto's class is available, take his. You won't regret it.

Prof.Barto was clearly very passionate about the topic (baseball) but not the critical thinking aspect quite so much. Second unit is almost entirely stat-based so non-baseball fans may struggle. The final project is a presentation, and the final paper is a t-chart. Just go to class, read the chapters assigned, and take the quizzes. You'll be fine.

Learned about baseball history for 8 weeks and played slow pitch softball for 8 weeks. Can go wrong, only two tests and are east as long as you read. Highly recommend to anyone even with no baseball experience or background.

Professor Barto is great! The lectures are fun and engaging! There are short readings for homework and quizzes each class (brief and straight forward). The second unit is solely about baseball stats, so it can be hard if you're not familiar with it. 3 tests, T-chart, oral presentation. If you get the chance to have this professor, take it!

This class is on the more difficult side because there is a lot of information to learn, however, if you enjoyed the labeling part of anatomy, you will be fine! He made class fun and more engaging! He does not round up on grading which he was clear about but he will give you extra credit on exams and those who show up to class. Loved this class!

One of the BEST professors for the Ex Science major. Had him for applied kinesiology. He is very transparent on what u need to know, how his exams are laid out, and good ways to study. He is very charismatic, interactive with his students, and overall an amazing professor. I would recommend him every time, test heavy though, with some assignments
Amazing professor, I had him for my Data Science Practicum, and he gave great feedback on all my work and everything. He is very nice and kind as well.
idk this dude but he is SKIBIDI TOILET RRRRIIIIIIIIZZZZZZZZZZ!

Donovan is a great professor. He does pop-up assignments for extra credit. You have plenty of opportunities for points because there are bonus questions on every test. If you're not a good test taker, you'll struggle. You need a consistent study schedule. Tests can be easy if you study. Overall, every test has the same concept.

Donovan is an amazing professor. He genuinely wants you to do well and gives you the resources and study tips to do so. Although attendance is not mandatory, he gives very useful tips on test strategies and applicable examples. He gives pop up assignments to students who show up and participate in class, so there's room to get some extra points.

Very nice guy & knows what he's talking about. He wants his students to do well- there are bonus questions on the test (answers given in class), extra credit assignments, & pop quizzes in class are open note. Your grade is basically made up of just tests unfortunately, but it's all just memorization and he tells you exactly what you need to know.

Dr. Donovan is a great teacher. The material in general is very heavy and the majority of it is just memorization (similarly to A&P Lab). Dr. Donovan is very funny and makes the class enjoyable, even if you don't love the content. The grades are based on 5 tests (including a final) and 12 pop up assignments (one is dropped).

Dr. Donovan is great! Applied is a hard class in general with a lot of information but he does a good job presenting the material and keeping you engaged. He has videos for each topic on canvas. The class is mostly graded on tests, but each test has at least one bonus question. Attendance isn't mandatory but he has 12 pop up assignments in class.

Dr. Donovan is an amazing professor. One of the best professors I've had here at UNCC. He is very funny and cracks jokes from time to time throughout his lectures. The class is very exam heavy, but he gives pop-up assignments which can help boost your grade if you always go to class.

Donovan is an amazing professor! He truly wants his students to succeed. The class is test heavy (5 exams total) with 12 pop-up assignments but they are easy as long as you go to class. Attendance is not required but it is so beneficial to attend lectures. I HIGHLY recommend him as this course has a lot of material.

I absolutely loved taking this course over the summer. This professor is the best I have had at UNCC. He cares and gets to know each of his students while insuring that every student has a good understanding of the material. Watch the lecture videos, take notes before class, + study everyday and you will do great on the exams. Lots of extra credit!

Seriously one of my favorite professors ever. Professor Donovan is not an easy professor but he provides everything that you need and more to excel in his classes. He is incredibly friendly, and very good at explaining difficult concepts. It is very important to attend all his lectures if you want to get a good grade (though they aren't mandatory)
pretty cool dude, i miss him every since taking king for anatomy 2
he is great! gives out study guides for every exam, also gives plenty of extra credit. will work with you to get your grade up!

Good professor, gave study guides that were very helpful for each exam, and gave a clear study guide for the final exam that focused on the questions that were on the exam. A lot of notes but gave extra credit and pop quizzes that were not hard as long as you followed along in class.

EXAM HEAVY. He had a couple of issues with miss wording questions on exams but would give credit where it was due. After the first exam he realized study guides should be given due to the amount of information we were required to learn. For the next semester he teaches he'll be more prepared.

I really enjoyed this class, it is very lecture heavy but it is a lecture class so it makes sense. Professor G is very understand and willing to work with you if you just reach out to him. He is very helpful if you are willing to put in work and ask him questions. You are only graded based on tests and pop quizzes.

Professor G makes this course interesting to follow and understand. His class is super lecture heavy you're going based on PowerPoint and that's all he does in class. However, beware that the only grading he does is exams and quizzes. If you fail your exams more than twice you're most likely gonna fail the course.

Professor Gerrard was great! Although there aren't many things to be graded on, as long as you complete each exam study guide and study ahead, you'll do fine on the test. Also, he gives opportunities for extra credit. The lectures are PowerPoint heavy but he does his best at explaining the concepts and providing examples.

Prof G did a great job teaching this lecture. Notes are easy and the study guides are similar to the tests. Although there isn't much to be graded on, he gives lots of opportunities to receive extra credit and points back on exams. As long as you do study guides and attend class, you will pass.
Never thought someone would make me not hate anatomy lectures, highly recommend

Very nice guy but reads straight off powerpoints for lectures. Attendance isn't mandatory but there are pop quizzes sometimes so you have to go. Your grade is only based off of 4 tests, 4-5 quizzes, and 1 extra credit assignment, so if you do poorly on a test you're kinda screwed. Material is hard and powerpoints don't really make sense.

He is a very nice guy and easy to get along with, but his class is graded soley on 4 exams, a few pop quizzes (meaning you have to go even though attendance is optional), and the final.  Tests are very hard and his study guides/in class lectures do not correlate to the exams making it difficult to do well

Enjoy the professor's personality but he is one of the worst professors at their job ever. He reads straight from the slides and rarely knows about the topic outside of what's clearly written on the slides. 4 tests and 5 pop quizzes are your entire grade with extra cred sprinkled in randomly. If there were more assignments it'd be fine.

The class itself is very difficult but Professor G is very nice and makes a study guide for each unit that really helped me understand the content. Your grade is based on 4 tests and random pop quizzes, so it is important that you study a lot if you want a good grade.
I have nothing against him you are graded on 4 tests and a handful of pop quizzes in the semester. But if you bomb one of those tests your gonna have a really hard time getting the grade back.

He is a nice guy but his class and teaching style sucks. Graded only on 4 tests and the final, attendance wasn't mandatory but he gives random pop quizzes so you have to go, and the test questions were random and inconsistent. He gives very little extra credit and overall very hard to do well in his class.

It was an average lecture, nothing too special about it. He is completely unresponsive to emails, even when asked about in person he wont follow up. The only grades in this class are the tests so beware of that, one fail and youre screwed for the semester. There isn't much bad to say but there isnt much good either.
Good sense of humor and is very nice. Lots of lectures and pop quizzes in class, tests are hard.

Don't take him if you value your mental health. Test is nothing like study guide. Lets you out of class without completing lecture. You can know every side of his powerpoint and still be lost on the test. Grade based off only 4 tests and final.

Take. His. Class. Trust. Professor Burnett explains accounting in a way that anybody can understand! I can honestly feel his passion for teaching during his lectures, I can really tell he wants every single one of his students to excel! Average amount of HW, tests are difficult, but if you attend class and study the notes you should be good!

Holy Cow, what a guy. Best professor at UNCC, Tests are easy enough if you study for them but can provide a bit of a challenge. Overall a fantastic teacher. Study in class notes hard most important for test, What is learned in class is exactly what is on test, no bull. Attend class because perfect attendance gets 5+extra credit. Keeps lectures good

Dr. Burnett is the best professor I've had at UNCC. He is super nice, and you can tell he really cares about the content and your success. ACCT-3323 is a harder course by nature, but his lectures and examples are designed to make the content super digestible, and he'll happily answer any remaining questions in great detail to help even more.

Dr. Burnett is a great professor and highly knowledgeable. His lectures are very informative, and he answers questions very well. His tests are difficult, but he gives plenty of resources to do well on them.

Dr. Burnett is amazing. He sets you up with everything to do well in this course. If you put in the effort you'll do well. Grading criteria is super clear and he's also helpful outside of class. Take him!

Dr. Burnett was by far the best accounting professor I have ever had. Don't get me wrong, the material is very challenging but Dr. Burnett does and amazing job of relaying the information in a way that is easy to understand and gives you a very clear criteria for grading. Take him!!

Professor Burnett makes the hard subject of intermediate accounting, understandable. Although, you have to stay on top of lectures and homeworks to do well in the class. The material is challenging and so are the exams. Professor is easily accessible outside of class with his office hours if you're struggling. Such a caring professor.
Burnett is easily the most engaging professor I have ever had. He cares a serious amount about students and their success. Exams are very very hard if you don't study. Worth taking

Dr. Burnett is one of the best professors I have had so far. He genuinely cares about his students and wants everyone to do well. His exams are very straight forward and he doesn't try to trick you. There isn't a ton of homework. If I see Burnett is teaching another class I need in the future, I would 100% take him again.

THIS WAS FOR ACCT 3323. He was a great professor who cares about students and makes an attempt to come at each topic from a relatable stance that will be understandable. Intermediate 1 will always be a hard class but Burnett will give you every opportunity to succeed if you want to take it.
Take him. The best professor at Charlotte.

Professor Charles is a very good professor and knows his stuff. He makes class very fun and interactive so you actually absorb the material. His test are open book and he spoon feeds you the final (just with different numbers) Pro tip: feed his ego and he is very lenient. Can be sassy at times depending on his mood.

Take professor Charles if you can! I took his class 5:30-8:15 which sucks but he made every class awesome. Great enthusiasm and cares about what he is teaching. With an extensive and credible history in Accounting he is the best teacher to have. Very good person to know going into the real world and looking for a job.

One of the best professors I've had. He is very enthusiastic and very transparent. He taught us everything that was going to be on the final, and was very lenient with homework. If you have the option TAKE HIM! Go to class, do your work, pay attention and it should be an EASY A!

I'm shocked Dr. Tanyi is not rated higher. He has a way of explaining things in a way that feels simple. Exams are most of your grade, but he gives so much exam prep material that you should be fine as long as you study. My only complaint is that he doesn't give extra credit or curve exams, but otherwise he was a great teacher.

Dr. Tanyi is literally the best accounting professor you will encounter. He never includes material in his exams that is not on the chapter PowerPoint, and the brief exercises he goes over in class are basically all of his free-response exam questions. He is diligent at teaching and really helpful to go to during office hours.

Professor Tanyi is tough. However, if you really put in study hours and go to his officer hours you will be fine. Make sure you study his PowerPoints and the Brief Exercises that he goes over in class. I do think he is good professor just know that it won't be easy.

Professor Tanyi is a great professor. To do well, you need to understand the concepts, study consistently, and really know the PowerPoints. He explains everything in depth and makes sure you grasp the logic behind accounting. Challenging class, but one of the best accounting teachers.

Professor Tanyi is tough but amazing. You really need to understand the material, work with classmates, and go to office hours and actually understand the material not memorize. He genuinely wants students to succeed, especially around exams, and goes out of his way to help. He was the reason for my success as well as group studying so good luck!

Professor Tanyi is a good and overhated professor on RMP. The test arent too challenging and some of the projects like the Excel projects are particularly tough (very hard Excel rip) but low-key you can use CHATGPT lol. Just be aware that the lectures are mandatory other than that he's a good teacher.

I am honestly amazed that Dr. Tanyi has such a low rating on here. He explains the material very well, and does a good job of preparing students for the tests. Homework is usually pretty easy, and there are also two Excel projects and three (easy) group projects throughout the semester. I definitely recommend going to his office hours!
Mandatory Attendance. No Exam Review or Study Guide. Exams are %75+ of your grade. ACCT3324 is already hard so one or two extra credit wouldn't hurt at all but he did not give any at all!

Dr. Tanyi truly cares about your success! He is funny and approachable during office hours! The material was a lot to learn and not easy. No rounding of final grade, no extra credit, and attendance is taken. You must do well on exams because they're like 70% of your final grade.

Do not let the reviews scare you, Dr. Tanyi is one of the best accounting professors we have. He responds quickly to emails, and his office hours are always welcoming. He is nice and funny and wants you to succeed in his class.

Tanyi didn't end up being as bad as the reviews said. I didn't get much out of his slides, but doing the in-class problems helped me understand a lot. He's pretty nice and doesn't make you feel dumb for saying the wrong thing. Main problem with him is how heavily he grades the tests. They're worth like 75-80% of your grade!

Dr. Tanyi was an amazing professor,
The material is hard and it takes time to learn.
Come to class and you will pass.
He is always available during office hours if you are finding it difficult to understand.
I highly reccomend taking Tanyi as he explains things in detail and sets you up for future success.

Very low homework and only two excel projects for the semester. The 3 midterm exams and final exam are pretty hard mostly because it's hard to know what you need to study for. Exams are weighted really heavily so if your goal is to make an A in this class it will be very difficult. I made A's on all my exams and still barely got an A at the end.

The class is extremely test heavy (90% of your grade is 3 tests and 1 final exam) Other 10% is HW/Projects. It's not clear what to review for exams. Lectures are just slide reading, and he does not provide any sort of study guide or realistic practice for the exams. Be ready to do a lot of your own research. His online class uses lockdown with cam.

Dr.Tanyi could do much better as a professor. His lectures are just him reading off of the slide and he sometimes has trouble explaining concepts to students. He never responds to emails, I have sent multiple throughout the semester and have maybe gotten a response to one of them. Dr.Tanyi also changes the due date of his assignments randomly.

I've had my share of good and bad professors at Charlotte. Tanyi is the worst professor I have had. The class I've taken is online and everything is graded by a computer. For some reason he has taken it off of canvas for your grade to be calculated. He does not know what he is talking about and switches times of when assignments are due regularly.

He doesn't do anything but read straight off of the slides in class. Your grade will really only be reflected by your test scores. He doesn't give exam reviews at all. You will also have to calculate your own grade throughout the semester because apparently it's too hard for him to just let you see the grade in Canvas.

Whole Grade is depending on your exam score, with him just going over the required material and does not help you prepare for the exam. Does not let you use TI-84 only basic calculators and he just has no teaching system implemented for his students to succeed.
He was slow to respond to any emails. He doesn't do exam reviews, and he doesn't care about students who are struggling. Don't take him, please.

Tanyi isn't a perfect professor but a lot of the comments are pretty harsh. He is as much of an accounting professor as they come, so he's going to read off the slides, not be too entertaining, but will absolutely give you all the information necessary to succeed. His exams and grading are fair, so success is dependent on the work you put in.

Dr. Sofsky is a genuinely great, caring professor who wants his students to succeed. He shares practical knowledge that's valuable for future accountants' careers. But his heavily-weighted exams are very difficult, and he flat does not provide enough time on them, no way around it. If you come in ready to work harder than ever, then you'll do okay.

Has no regard for students time and thinks his class is the only class we are taking. Difficult exams. Even if you do good he's going to take off points just cause you didn't spell it out for him and label. A lot of homework and a project over that. He's not a bad person but worst class in my two years at UNCC. Makes a hard class even harder.
Just a simple recommendation, "DO NOT TAKE SOFSKY".  He should not be teaching.

Test heavy & the tests are difficult. Takes off points for not giving explanations to every little part of work done on short answers. Would not consider him a great teacher, definitely seems to view his students as higher level/capable and does not explain things very simply. Also talks about stuff that is NOT on test OFTEN. VERY tough grader

Dr. Sofsky takes off points for not labeling numbers and providing explanations in journal entries in exam, provides extra credit in exam but the exams are hard and focus in speed. Overall, not an easy class, but using the videos he provides, PowerPoints, study guides, and timed questions it's easier, if you put in the work, he is a great professor

I would not recommend taking Sofsky.  He can't teach well, can't relate to his students and test are extremely difficult. Doesn't seem to care if you make a A or an F.  Do not take. Find another Accounting Professor.

His class is test heavy, and the tests are difficult. The study guides don't have examples, just a bullet point list of "Know how to do this". Attendance is graded, classes are mostly just lectures. In person paper tests. The homework and 1 project is not much of your grade. You have to do well on tests. Not impossible, just difficult.

Tests are hard and the guided notes rarely helped with exams. The guided notes were hard to fill out in my opinion because you had to infer or guess for majority of the blanks. Homework took up a lot of time but completing all the homework will help/save your grade

Dr. Sofsky is fun to talk to, but my god this class was hard.  He's so nitpicky about things that don't really matter, such as notes after journal entries and labelling our work entirely.  As a result, nobody finished exams on time, yet he blamed us for it.  Not a good professor, but still caring and enjoys what he does.

Sofsky is overall a solid professor. He puts emphasis on understanding the course material as opposed to simply memorizing it. Many people who complain about his course tend to be memorizers. There is nothing wrong with that inherently, but you simply will not get by if you hope to memorize journal entries. He can be a bit monotone at times.

I avoided Sofsky like the plague due to his reputation. However, he was one of the best professors I had in my time at Charlotte. He does a great job of explaining things clearly. He has really good study guides so you know exactly what to expect on each exam. All his exams are curved. He's so much nicer than people say. Don't be afraid!

I've had a different professor for intermediate 1 & 2 and Sofsky is the only one who wants to always act like the textbook is wrong and he is right. Such a nitpicker when it comes to grading exams, you could have the right answer and he will take points for not showing where a # came from. He thinks everyone wants to be a CPA...wrong!

I have really enjoyed Dr. Sofsky's class. You can definitely tell he really cares about his students and wants everyone to do well. This is a senior level class so it is not supposed to be easy. Study a lot for exams and be very clear when showing your work and he will give a TON of partial credit. I personally would definitely recommend taking him
Bureaucrat, yet he starts class early and holds students late. Lots of HW. Some would say conceited

Dr. Sofsky is arguably the best accounting professor at UNCC. Works harder than anyone when it comes to delivering lectures, communicating with you, grading, and providing feedback. He will prepare you to be a CPA and will do everything he can to help you learn and get a good grade. Listen in class, read the entire chapter, and practice problems.

Honestly, my opinion of Sofsky has changed over time. At first, I thought he was a good teacher, but now with more experience. Sofsky is an uncompromising, relentless, stubborn, apathetic, hardheaded person.  He makes his class way more difficult than higher-level accounting courses for no reason.  Good for knowledge, terrible for passing a class.
Do not take him. Exams worth more than 50% of your grade. Only cares about finishing the chapters on time. Does not give study guide at all. Not worth it.

As a person talking to him, he is a decent guy. However, test count for 70% of your grade, so test matter for everything. This is my biggest issue with him because I have never seen a test count for more than 50% of a grade. They are also not just multiple choice but written, so be aware of that.

Probably one of the rudest professors I have ever had, he's extremely rude and makes you feel stupid for asking questions, and says it's not his responsibility to answer emails... when it is. He did offer extra credit. His tone is very demeaning and belittling. Not very understanding.
Tough class but as long as you pay attention, do your hw, and attempt to understand then you can get a B or a C.  Sofsky does pretty good explaining almost everything.

Professor K is a very smart individual. For this class be prepared to study a lot, it is pretty test heavy, and you grade really is determined on your performance on those. He is a funny professor, but at times felt like the material we studied did not correlate to tests. He was really fair to us with grading, but can make things very complicated.

If you're debating between professor K and professor Osteen, take Osteen! Class isn't mandatory attendance, exams are online, and she gives out a lot of extra credit opportunities such as volunteering, attending accounting club meetings, surveys, and course evals.

Professor K teaches a harder course, accounting is like learning a different language so obviously it takes some effort to learn. he definitely does his best to teach. he has a ton of office hours and is super flexible. he cares if you show that you care.
I literally LOVED Prof K with my whole heart and I'm sad I can't take his class again. Def go to his office hours he is so so helpful!!!

Cares about his students and lectures are engaging.  I recommend attending office hours at least once.  Tests are a major portion of the class, but reviewing in class materials will cover all of the topics.

Professor K, although he tries to appeal to his students with his charisma he is lacking in dedication to being a teacher instead of just a professional. He makes it know his class is difficult, and makes it more so by his attitude and his inability to believe not only in his teaching but in themselves as future scholars and working professionals.

Teaching isn't easy to understand. There are 4 tests that are hard only one of them are easy. Don't try to email him he will not respond. The practice tests given out are nothing like the actual tests. He flaunts that this class is failed a lot. For what reason? No idea lol. Definitely find a group of people to study with regularly.

He's not a good professor he talks about his personal life more than he teaches. There's no extra credit in this class so if you're failing, don't even try to ask for extra credit, the content is hard, especially if you haven't heard anything about accounting before so it takes hours of studying to still not get a great score
Smart guy. 4 super hard exams+1 quiz weighted 75% of ur grade.

Professor K is a tough teacher teaching a tough class. However, he really does want you to succeed. If you participate in class and put forward the effort, he will be willing to help out. He is also super funny and his out of pocket examples surprisingly are helpful. Overall, I would take him again as he is a super caring and memorable professor.

Prof. K is a very good teacher. The class is very hard no matter who you have it with, and you are forced to move quick because there is a lot of material. The exams count for 70% of your final grade, so you need to average around an 85 on every exam to get an A- in the class. He offers tutoring and office hours, getting an A is hard, but possible.

Professor K is the best accounting professor I ever had at UNC Charlotte. This class is focus on soft skills in order to help you reach your goal in your accounting career. No exam. This is an easy A class.

Genuinely the worst and most unprofessional professor I've had at UNCC. His class requires your full schedule, so avoid taking it with other demanding courses and don't even try if you have a job. He expects you to come to his office hours and extra credit was on Wednesday nights. There are 3 random attendance checks and grades are exam heavy.

Professor K is a good professor, but the material can be hard and exams are pretty much most of your grade. Just pay attention in class and do the hw and practice exams and you will be good. He gives a lot of handouts which are helpful but usually only goes over it once during class.

Very knowledgable, but passive aggressive. Material is hard, and he does a good job explaining it, but theres no practice and he only goes over it once. Attendance taken 3 times randomly in the semester. 3 exams + final, and 2 projects. HW is light - only 2 small HW a week. Gives sample tests, but barely any EC. Must do good on tests to get an A.

Very impersonal, will always think youre cheating and will never give you the benefit of the doubt. Will talk more about his personal life and tie every topic into a story of his. Gives lots of handouts that you go over in class. The practice tests are nothing like the actual exams.
Professor K is great! Highly recommend him. This course was HW heavy especially for a one credit hour course but overall it is an easy A and Professor K understands that you have other classes.

Professor K was a great professor and does a great job of explaining complicated ideas. There are some things that are confusing but if you show up, be attentive and do his practice tests before the actual test, you will be fine

He is an AMAZING professor!!! He truly cares for his students and will be available to you if you need help. He teaches the content very well and will clarify any questions about the content in a way that is very understandable. I have nothing bad to say about him or his class. HIGHLY RECOMMEND!
Professor K was amazing, his lectures are very straightforward with notes that make it easy to follow and understand. If you follow along, go to class and do the homework you'll be fine.

5 tests plus a final, all online and open notes. Tests were easy, and lots of material to prepare. Class is not mandatory outside of in-class assignments, which he would go over and answer.  Lecture videos are due outside of class, and in class, he goes over homework. Class is very easy if you do the things expected outside of class.

Genuinely the worst professor I've had so far at UNCC. He requires you to listen to lectures outside of class and then goes over random practice problems during the actual lecture. I usually don't have an issue paying attention but I find it literally impossible to focus because of how dull and rambling his explanations are.

Native English speaker, genuinely cares about the class and well being of everyone. Goes over broad strokes, but requires some reading outside of class to not waste precious lecture time. Gives good life advice as well. Very down to earth person. Very difficult to fail this class if you show up and read at least a little bit of the textbook.

This is the worst professor I have had at UNCC. He goes so fast that you can not understand or take notes; he does not actually lecture, he just goes over the homework or in-class assignment. If you want to understand accounting, do not take this professor.
He's a decent professor, nice guy, but you have to teach yourself in this class since he goes over the material somewhat quickly. Overall good guy though.
Amazing guy, truly cares about his students. Thank you!

This professor was pretty good. You learn most of the material through connect although I would definitely take his class again if I had the opportunity. You will get as much from the class as you put into it.

I personally do not like Kearney's teaching style. I felt like he would have benefitted from a smaller class size, but he would just talk through problems and not write anything out. However, he posts every single HW problem solution + video explanation. Felt more like a self taught class w supplemental lecture. Nice man but I retained nothing.

Cares about his students and wants everyone to succeed. Material is all online in the textbook, but he goes over every single homework and quiz prior to the due date, so that each student is able to fully grasp each concept. Very understanding, difficult subject but he will work with you if you need extra help!

The best accounting professor at UNC Charlotte! He really cares about his students and is willing to do anything for his students to succeed in his class. When I took him, there were couple of really fun projects and tests that weren't that hard as long as you studied and attended all the lectures. On some tests, he would curve very generously.

Had a great time with this Professor. Accounting II can be pretty difficult at times, but this Professor does a great job at telling you what to expect/study for on his exams. He is also great at communicating with his students which is something that most professors are not great at these days. Would definitely take again.
The class is not that hard and the professor seems to actually care about the students. You have all the resources that you need to complete this class and he gives in depth reviews for the quizzes.
He is a great professor. He gives extra credit on exams as well as explains the homework and quizzes in class so you have less homework

Kearney is a great professor. Encourages questions and always puts the students first. Offers lots of extra credit, gives bonus points on every test and overall a nice guy. Gives answers to hw and quizzes in class. He runs through the slides pretty quickly, so I'd download them and take notes on the slides as he speaks, that helped me a lot.

She is such a nice professor. So understanding. Attendance is only taken on presentation days. I went to class on a rainy day once and she gave me and the few students who came that day extra credit. 100% take her. The work is so easy that I always do it the day that it is due.

She is an absolute fantastic professor. Very easy going, understanding and is willing to help you on anything from the course work to help with interviews. Work is VERY easy. Truly the best professor I have ever had. She is very kind, makes an effort to get to know her students, and actually cares. Attendance isn't required, the quizzes are open all semester and you get 3 chances-super simple. Loved this class, take it with her if you can!

I have had Dr. Knight for two classes, and she is wonderful! She is super sweet and certainly cares about her students. The material is not difficult, and she teaches it very well. Depending on the class, the textbook may be optional. Open-book tests and quizzes. Definitely recommend.

I love Dr. Knight! Super kind, caring and understanding. Her lectures, in-class activities and guest speakers made me want to show up to class. Professor Knight has been one of my favorite professors of all time. She is very understanding and caring. All of the 'exams' were open note and she explained everything so well!

Dr Knight is a caring professor who wants you to pass her class.  Attendance isn't required and she gives extensions on assignments so it's impossible not to pass with a B. Dr. Knight is a really nice professor. She's passionate about what she teaches. There are 2 group projects which are easy if you have a good group. Great professor, extremely easy assignments, even easier tests. This class is the perfect introductory business course, and she knows that there's no point in being a tough grader. PICK THIS PROFESSOR IF YOU CAN

Great professor, one issue is the lectures get super boring.

This professor is outstanding. Your entire grade comes from just three take‑home exams, which are much less stressful than in‑class tests ;). Prof. Newman was great in my opinion. Class can be slow but he attempted to make class interesting by telling his own experiences as a lawyer in the business world. The most boring lectures you will ever sit through. Totally worth it though. Only 4 grades (3 tests and attendance). Information is interesting just terrible delivery. Expect to sit through the entire 3 hour lecture because you rarely get out early.

Mr. Newman is a nice great professor that knows what he is talking about, however gets off topic very easily. Most of his classes are from 6:30-9:00, and he goes all the way till the end. Fantastic professor that uses real world examples from his own experiences to teach concepts. Easily the best professor I’ve had at UNCC.

Three exams the whole semester, he lectures 3 hours on the material and asks some questions at the end. Amazing class, I enjoyed the material and the simple lecture style of the course. Dr. Rolan cares a lot about her coursework. The class is graded mostly by group work throughout the entire semester, so you'd better hope you get assigned some good group mates. She's great all around. Kind, funny, and an expert in her field. The only down side to her class in my opinion is how much group work you have to do.  I personally hate group work but I got through it.  If you have to take marketing you want her to be your professor.

If you have the change to take Professor Rolan, take it. So far in my college journey i have yet to meet a professor that can make a 3 hour class feel like 1 hour. 

She is not overly strict or test heavy. Just make sure you at least listen to instructions about assignments. Very sweet and caring professor.
She is amazing! I would recommend her to anyone!!
The class is very easy. A big semester long project. Open notes test. But she definitely favors some students over the other.

Dr. Rolan is an amazing professor. Not only is she hilarious but she is also knowledgable about what she teaches. The GROUP PROJECT is the only thing I disliked about the class. Professor Rolan is super enthusiastic and knowledgeable about marketing.  Her class was engaging and entertaining. Rolan is honestly a good professor, so definitely take her if you can. Entertaining lectures, extra credit opportunities, and attendance is not mandatory. Professor Rolan was amazing. She cared about her students and made the class enjoyable. If you need help with something, email her. Homework was very light, but through Connect. Really fun professor and easy going. Enjoyed taking her class and she's hilarious. Exams are online and does not assign a lot of homework. Made this class fun.

Very kind and sweet. Easy A just shows up to class and do your assignments on time, and you'll be fine.

Wonderful Professor. Clearly cares about her students and wants them to succeed.

Kelly was really funny in her classes and didn't hesitate to make you feel welcome. There are a few group projects that were relatively fun and she cares about you in the sense that she wants you to succeed. Would recommend taking her class any day of the week.

Easy chill class you learn interesting stuff without feeling like its being shoved down your throat. Easy exams & assignment. Group assignments here and there that can be completed relatively fast. Definitely worth it to take her class!

Kelly Burich is awesome! She is still getting the online platforms down. A few tech issues but she owned her mistakes and allowed for make ups, gained my respect from this. Kelly is fantastic! She's very funny and easy to pay attention in class. 1 paper, a couple of group projects in class, and an easy A with participation.
Not patient at all!
I would prefer to choose another professor, as his teaching is heavily theory-based and lacks practical applications, which are essential for students' future careers.

Prof. Zhang is the best instructor I have had. He cares about students and always available to help in and after class. He responds to emails very fast. He is the best professor I have ever had. He explains everything so throughly. Love his class.

This summer, I took graduate-level Mgmt & Org Behavior with Dr. Reed, and it was a blast. All the concepts appealed to my love for studying organizations. Professor Reed makes sure that all his student's can succeed. He does anything to give extra credit and good grades to his students and his lectures are always clear and understanding. You do a lot of team work but it is easy to get 100's on all these which really helps your grade.

He is transparent and sets clear guidelines from the start, he also isn't reluctant to answer any uncertainties.

I had Dr. Reed for MGMT 3140 for the summer. Even though he used the Lockdown Browser for exams, you can get at least a 100% (There are bonus questions) if you study hard enough. I actually enjoyed going to his class, I only studied for the test and exams. Gives weekly homework but takes little to no time at all. His slides were always amazing and he teaches you real-life lessons in class. Takes attendance through Poll Everywhere. But really an amazing professor.

Great professor, made the content easy to learn. Very helpful and kind.

4 assignments a week, 1 being the mandatory in person assignment. exams are just like the homework modules and you get 3 attempts per question. assignments can be late but with 20% penalty. most assignments are not compatible with mac so you have to use the schools PC or rent a laptop from atkins.

Professor Rudd was very kind and you can tell that she cares about the class. I struggled with the lectures and "case studies" because she talked slowly. I am also from up north, so I struggle to understand some of the words she is saying. But if those things don't bother you, take this class.
Great professor! Lots of homework but as long as you complete the assignments then you will be successful in this course.

Prof. Rudd is one of the best professors I have ever had, study and do your homework, try your best and it's an easy A. You have three chances to do the homeworks and two chances for the exam. Highly highly recommend taking her.

Great professor, would take it again.

Overall good guy, just talks the entire class and is boring, but easy.

Dr. Amato was a knowledgable and caring guy, and he is passionate about economics. Our class was super unengaged, which upset him a bit at times, but I think he would've been a phenomenal lecturer if the class would've actually engaged back. Despite this, his examples still helped make the content understandable. Tests are remote, and open book.

Professor Amato is a caring instructor who makes microeconomics engaging. The class has mandatory attendance, but with Polleverywhere and the free textbook, it's manageable. Unstuck AI was super helpful for study prep - highly recommend giving it a try.

Dr Amato is amazing! He is hilarious in lectures and gives real world examples. Attendance is graded when opting out of the final, tests are online open book remote as well as homework. Definitely recommend!

I took Dr. Amato's micro class in the mid-2000s. I was inspired by his teaching and took all of his classes. He deeply cared about the course material and his students. Dr. Amato is the reason I later pursued a graduate degree and career in economics. One of the most interesting, inspiring, and caring professors from my college experience.

Microeconomics was super easy! He is a super nice professor too, very kind and caring of all. I took his class on zoom, and the first 15 minutes of class was a PollEverywhere, which was graded. But, you still got half credit for doing the question even if you got it wrong and they barely affect your grade. Take his class if you have the chance!

Professor Amato is a caring professor who always looks for the best in his students. Every day you take a Poll Ev for attendance and that's counted toward your overall grade. His grade totals are disabled so you have to calculate it yourself which can be tough. If you interact during lectures and stay on top of homework, it's a great class.

He is lecture heavy and likes to interact with students. Exams were completely online. The only thing I dislike is that you do not know what grade you have in his class until the end of the semester. FINAL EXAM IS OPTIONAL.
Professor Amato is great! One of the best professors for any class I have taken in college so far. Always do the homework and test prep and you will do great!

Truly a good professor. He is lecture heavy but he makes jokes and likes to interact. The material is pretty easy to understand if you read and listen. Exams were completely online and taken at home. The class was pretty easy but also very interesting. He is a really good professor who cares and is very knowledgeable.
Great lectures, easy homework, and fair tests.
One of the best professors in the MBA program.  I learned a lot.  Tests were hard but fair.

Dr. Amato is a very intelligent individual and a great person I am sure however, your grade within this course (MBAD 6112) will be based on only three tests and one group project. The tests also mimic written practice problems however, will be made significantly more difficult. It is a lecture heavy course and he is a tough tough grader.

He's a good professor. You can attend his class either in person or on zoom and attendance is taken every lecture via poll everywhere. There are no tests in the class, and each chapter has one HW assignment + a group or individual project that is relatively easy.

Class is a fairly easy B, but an A seems nearly impossible. Majority of grades are through group projects. I don't know if it could just be an impossible ta, but the group projects seem nearly impossible to do good on.

I'm not sure if this was my TA or the teacher himself, but the rubrics were very vague, and my group felt like it was impossible to get an A, like he's very nitpicky about things that aren't even on the rubric. The rest of the class is easy, but like 70% of your grade is projects, so it is something to consider.
Amazing professor, lots of group work and a few quizzes. Take him if you can!

A class that is VERY heavy in group projects. In the first project, he will assign groups, but after that, you are free to make a group. He allows the use of AI to help with what employers want from students, so that is a great plus for him. The polls everywhere are for grades, so definitely do them! Great guy, easy grader, and funny during class.
Easy A class. Genuinely wants to see his students succeed.
Had is class online zoom lectures and they were dreadfully boring but the class is so free its not even funny.
Real chill guy. The online course is straight forward and you take a few quizzes and just have group projects.

i took ECON3125 online. He put us in small groups and we had a total of 8 team task to complete that was based on the chapter that we just read. Homework was easy if you read the chapter and use common sense. I honestly learned so much and we really put our knowledge to the test!
He is so sweet! He offers a zoom option even when his class is in person, and is super responsive to emails.
Easy going Professor.  Low stress course with minimal amounts of work.

Dr. Metzgar was a good professor with funny jokes and good real-life examples. No exams, and encourages AI use but not in totality of course. In-person attendance wasn't mandatory. The TAs grade the assignments and it's sometimes hard to get a high grade on them. Make sure you use both the rubric and the assignment guide to do the assignments.

Professor Metzger understands the effect AI has had on learning within students and has changed his entire course to be AI-friendly. We do not have any tests in this class, but just bi-weekly projects and quizzes in the textbook to complete. Grading is easy and straight to the point; you should be good as long as you hit all the points!

Absolutely take this professor! He does not have any exams, which was nice. You have 7 quizzes (AI grades them) & 7 group tasks (TA grades them). Attendance is taken by PollEverywhere. He does have Zoom meetings if you don't want to go in person for class. Will answer any questions you have. 100% recommend!!

Very knowledgeable and passionate professor. Very easy course. The group work is easy but sometimes you get trapped with the worst group members possible if you have nobody you know in the class. AI grades your quizzes too but it is only slightly flawed. Overall, very hard to do bad in this course.

Take this class. NO EXAMS, just 7 "quizzes" and 7 team tasks (can do solo after the first one) are you're entire grade. His instructions are very clear. Attendance is technically graded but it is lightly weighted. He is very accesible if you have questions. He actually teaches instead of reading off a power point. Incredible professor

As I am sitting here in the second lecture of the semester, prof metzgar has already explained derivatives better than my calc professor and demand curves better than both my Econ professors. If you have trouble understanding things this is your guy. Everything is clearly laid out and seems like it will be smooth. I'll update this after the class.

Prof. Metzgar's class is a great option, with online and in-person options. Exams are challenging but doable if you utilize the practice materials and Unstuck ai for study prep. Overall, an engaging and manageable course.

Highly recommend. You have a zoom option for lectures or in-person. All tests are online and directly related to material discussed in class. He made this an easy course to succeed in and shows great care for his students.

He was a great professor. He gave our class the option for zoom or to be in class. There are poll questions every class but the lowest 4 get dropped. Chapter quizzes online, tests online, 3 homework assignments before each test. Lowest test and quiz is also dropped. I would take him if you can!

Econ is a hard class. I think professor Tseng did a pretty good job on explaining the concept to other student. As long as you put in the work, you will be successful in her class. Attendance are extra credit.

Professor Tseng will probably be my favorite of all time. Economics is not everyone's favorite, yet I never heard any complaints about coming to her lectures. She cracks jokes all the time, and interacts with the lecture material like she's a sports announcer. Genuinely the favorite part of my day was coming to her class!

I earned a high B, but not without stress. Professor Harris is witty and very knowledgeable and I do believe he is approachable, just not very good at teaching. If you value your GPA take this class with another professor.

awful professor. doesn't know how to lecture, the 40+ question chapter homework doesn't match what he teaches or what is on the test. He goes deep into the math theory of economics and then doesn't test on it. When asking questions, be prepared to get a snippy, condescending response. Overall disappointed I paid so much money to teach myself.

This is a typical online class. You do all your learning through cengage and there is homework due once a week. The assignments took me around 2 hours to finish and some can be difficult, be ready to learn through the textbook.

If taken online, you have 2-4 assignments each week. The "do no harm" grading technique is a little frustrating for harder topics. You pretty much just do your own thing and never interact with the professor. Mindtap grades assignments immediately. Can work ahead.

Very clear grading. 4 units, 4 tests. Homework is done on mindtap with the "Do no harm" grading method. This grading method is not good when doing homework on hard concepts. Each week there are 2-4 assignments due. Everything is posted so you can work ahead.

Nice guy, a lot of homework, and it is very repetitive. Really, it's an easy class just tons of work. There are a few exams. Extremely straightforward, sit down and work for 4 hours a week and you're good

Dr. Vosters is passionate and caring. She is genius and often talked over my head, but happy and willing to help. One complaint is that she is a very nit-picky grader, especially considering the class is 75% exams. I took as an elective and wouldn't take again bc of the level of difficulty, but if you really enjoy stats shes the professor for you.

Professor Vosters is an amazing person! Her passion for econ is unmatched and felt through her lectures and teaching methods. The course is setup student friendly with a clear format and clear grading structure. 3 exams and a final, but she will drop one exam so basically the final is optional if you like your grade after taking exam 3. Goodluck!

This class was by no means easy, but she structured it in a way that allowed the students to pass. She would give you credit if you showed an understanding of course topics even if you did not get questions correct. She wants her students to do well! Attendance is not mandatory, but if you don't go, then you won't have the notes to help you.

Cares so much about her students, really a great professor. I'd leave class every day confused but she's very helpful and also allows a cheat sheet for exams, finished with an A. There's a quiz and 'problem set' due every week, open note and shouldn't be too hard if you show up. Stata seems daunting but very easy to use for this course.

My favorite class at UNCC! I love the way she teaches- you can print out the slides before class and then she goes thru and writes/circles/adds notes on the slides and you follow along. There are 3 exams and 1 optional final (replaces an exam). She let us have a cheat sheet for the exams too. She is enthusiastic and cares for her students!
Excellent teacher with an excellent course structure. Her voice is super soft and makes you want to fall asleep, but otherwise she is great lol

ECON6112 is a tough class but Vosters is always willing to help if you reach out. Class is based on bi-weekly homework (completion credit), 3 tests, and a STATA project that is split up and pretty easy.

Did great on everything but feel that her tests were way harder than the material we were introduced to during the lecture. She went through a practice final exam, but it wasn't similar to the final in terms of type of questions we'd be asked, some questions we were told to emphasize on weren't on actual final.

This professor has to grow on you and you have to pay attention in class. There are weekly homeworks and 4 exams. If you go to class you should do fine. Exams are closed notes with no formula sheet so make sure you remember them. She is strict about being in class to earn points but overall it is a decent class.

Legit ran through the slides, doesn't really explain how to do anything. Spent hours in the lib this year studying bc she's terrible at explaining. 

Only take if you absolutely have to.
Professor Tseng is knowledgeable, but her lectures can be hard to follow. Use Unstuckstudy alongside the textbook to ace the exams and quizzes.

Dr Hui-Kuan Tseng was a solid teacher, she is very smart but there is a language barrier which is a good and bad thing. It good in a sense that she uses small words that make the teaching very easy to understand. The tests are very similar to the homework so its a good material to use for study guides. There are 4 tests which are easy if you attend

Great teacher and provides everything you need to know in lecture, homeworks, and study guides. She also posts slides. Your grade is highly based on 4 exams however it is easy to do well on the exams because of the resources she provides.  She has an accent but it is easy to understand after a while.

A very smart and knowledgable lady but not a good professor. If you struggle with math I heavily advise you to avoid this prof. Very thick accent and lectures/presentations are all over the place and do not make sense. In a lot of her exam reviews she posts questions without providing the answer/work to go along with it, not very helpful at all.
exams were much harder than they should have been and I wish there were more homework assignments to bring your grade up. she has a thick accent.

she has an accent so sometimes it's hard to understand her, test heavy class (last 2 exams are hard), attendance is extra credit but only brings your grade up 1%. 8:30 am class on tuesdays and thursdays so that sucked. exams are 90% of grade. take a different professor if you want an easy A

Only writing this because I got a 79.8 in the class and she refused to round up. She's not bad, just reads off the slides, but she does try to keep you involved so it's not that hard to keep attention on her. Attendance is extra credit, but 90% of the grades is are the exams, 10% homework, attendance is extra credit (roughly .2 point per day).

There are 4 exams (in class, no lockdown) and homework each week. Attendance is extra credit points. She is not a BAD professor.. but if you do not already have a solid feel for Economics, she is not the professor for you. I learned more via youtube/online. She's not very clear showing work, her power points will not help you outside of class.

Prof Tseng was funny and most lectures were easy to understanding. She gives extra credit w/ attendance and post everything online. Her accent is kinda strong but nothing too extreme. She's very clear about how she grades and isn't afraid to give her honest opinion. Hint: Quizlet will be your best friend.

She is good overall! She posts powerpoint lectures from class to canvas. Sometimes not all of the note answers or examples from class are on there. If you miss class too much, you won't understand how to do it. Attendance isn't mandatory but there is Poll Everywhere for extra credit. She usually lets out class early. Light HW but only open 2 days

When I show up to class she is phenomenal. Attendance is extra credit. She says at the start of the semester just memorizing the slides is not enough and you need to understand how to apply the topics. The class before the tests she goes over a review. She helps set you up to pass if you actually have some common sense and critical thinking skills

Tseng was a very nice & funny professor. The only assignments you have are 4 exams & HW each week. The exams were more difficult than they should have been. Not much study material either. No notes or cheat sheets on exam. If you struggle with ECON, find another professor. Micro is already difficult and her class/exams make it even more hard.

Prof. Tseng is really quite kind. She is caring, and funny. She also knows what she's talking about. I respect her for that. However, she is not the best teacher. I learned little to nothing from lectures and the slides only make sense within the context of class. There is no real study guide for tests. I would not recommend her as a professor.

Professor Tseng is a good professor. She is lecture heavy but cares about her students learning. She incorporates the PowerPoints into the lectures. The homework she gives is usually found on the Tests.

Tseng knows what she is talking about and without a doubt is a very smart person. However, not all smart people should be college professors. Tseng is one of those people. You can still do well but if you are not an A-B student, do not take her class. This is also my first RMP review due to my negative experience with her so please consider that.

If you want to struggle this is the best professor for you!! Some words to describe "Professor" Tseng, strict, self-righteous, incompetent to name a few. She will read directly off the power-point and not even show her work, yet is confused when the class average is CONSISTENTLY less than 60% and blames it on her students. AVOID AT ALL COSTS!!

She is very knowledgeable about what she teaches and is a very nice lady. She also gives attendance as extra credit at the end of the semester. However, her lectures are hard to follow and her PowerPoints make no sense outside of class. If you are not paying attention at all times during the lecture it will make no sense.

She's a great professor who really understands what she teaches. she gives great lectures and is really engaging and fun. All of the content is covered during the lectures and we have short homework quizzes very week. she takes attendance using poll everywhere but will also randomly take attendance in class so be ready for that.
stay away. to get an A, you need to spend tons of hours.

Dr. Gaggl is so intelligent and is a great guy. The content is difficult and you need to put work in to succeed just like anything else in life. Only thing is sometimes he can talk in circles so you need to pay extra attention.

Isnt the best professor but he makes it easy to pass as long as you put some effort in. Class averages on tests are 40's but if you do better than half of your peers you will easily get an A or B based on his grading scale. I got 70-80s on all my tests and they rounded to 90-100s. Tests are just like practice tests. All HW you get a 100 if you try

Great professor, very easy going and relaxed. Lectures are a little boring but he is really nice and understanding. If you do the problem sets you can just study those for the tests and they are basically identical. If you need to take Econ 4117 i highly recommend taking him for an easy A.

Professor McGregor's lectures are super chill and easy to follow — as long as you study the problem sets, you'll do great. He's a really nice and understanding guy, and I genuinely enjoyed both him and the class. Highly recommend!

Last round of reviews, Professor is retiring. Great professor, my favorite Economics one. Lectures were dry, but to the point. Exams are straight from problem set & quizzes which were easy. This course is tough, and Professor. McGregor did a great job explaining the material. He is an easy grader as well. Great professor, enjoy your retirement.

Great teacher, confessed on our last day that he was retiring. Sad to see him go. Problem sets for this class would get difficult but if you met with him/asked him about it, he would be amazing help. Only a small quiz every friday, problem sets and exams. Does not put in grades, pretty much never uses canvas. Go to class to understand the material
He's pretty dry as a professor. It's lecture/note taking heavy, but his exams are pretty much like his practice tests. Just study that, and you'll do fine! Take him!!

I was lost the whole semester very difficult class. I have no clue how to use stata and still don't know I recommend only taking if you have taken a class with stata. The teacher is very nice just seems like he expects us to have already learned a lot of this material. There is only 4 problem sets and 4 tests with a cumulative final.

Crimmins' class is no walk in the park. Lectures can be dry, but staying engaged and using resources like flashcards, whiteboards, and unstuck study can really help. It's tough, but doable with hard work.

Boring class, reads off of his slides in a monotone voice, doesn't really try to engage with students, exams are extremely difficult and the average is usually in the 50s or 60s. Please save yourself and take a different professor.

The class is awful. If able, choose a different professor canvas will be flooded with assignments every day, and each one is due the following day hindering your ability to complete them all in one go. lectures, are very confusing and unclear. when asked to elaborate, the material is still difficult to understand.

Don't let most of the comments scare you. This class is hard, but you just really have to apply yourself. For me personally, what he taught in class wasn't very helpful. What worked for me was literally making flashcards, using whiteboards for memorization of topic and understanding. Trust me if you apply yourself and study hard you will be fine.
the worst class ever and the professor is awful. take a different professor. and the tests are so hard.
def not an easy A. Don't take this class unless it's related to your major. If you want to take this class, take it with a different professor.

He is a nice guy but his class is really hard. The exams are worth your entire grade and they are really hard. The averages of the tests were in the 50s - 60s and he doesn't make the class entertaining. I don't mind economics but I absolutely hated it with him.

He is a really tough professor and doesn't do a great job teaching economics. His lectures are very boring and he doesn't really try to make the classes fun either. His tests are also extremely difficult and I felt like most of the test questions weren't even part of the material we learned.

I was really excited for this class but Crimmins made this class awful. He is a terrible professor and most people don't do well in the class. He doesn't answer questions that well either. Avoid taking him.
His tests are really hard and they count for like all of your grade. He also doesn't teach that well and isn't the nicest guy
there are 4 tests so you have to do well on all of them to get an A. it's a super hard class and his lectures are so boring. please avoid this professor

The textbook was very interesting, and that's good since textbook is basically your teacher. His slides are made by the textbook site. I would only go if I wanted a refresh on the topic, but it was basically what we read just out loud. The assignments are easy, but the tests are kind of harsh. He is nice, but also kind of rude on bad days I guess.

The subject itself was interesting. The professor... not so much. He had slides on canvas that he would read off of, not important to attend lectures but provides extra credit every time you do. Weekly assignments, four tests and interesting topics. Tests require real brain usage as you need to make connections for an answer. Easy but not weed-out.

He is very nice and doesn't require attendance. He does use it as extra credit though. His typical class average on a test is in the low 70s and he doesn't curve. 2 assignments due weekly and 4 tests. The class can sometimes feel like it drags on because it isn't very interesting but he tries his best to engage everyone.

At first, I thought this was going to be a chill class, and it was until the test. You have between 2 to 3 assignments each week. Then a test that covers about 3 chapters, from what we are learning. The assignments are pretty easy and light. But the test is difficult, sometimes they don't correlate with what you've learned.

Crimmins seemed cool, missed most of his lectures but overall the class is doable without them. The textbook is a pretty good resource to use, and the slides capture chapters well. The tests aren't as terrible as I've heard everyone say, completing the homework and doing some extra credit will keep you afloat. Overall, meh class, easy B.

MOST BORING CLASS EVER! Kevin put my entire class to sleep on the daily. He does not explain anything and gives so much busy work that honestly teaches you nothing. The textbook does not really teach what is going to be on the test. Good luck if you get stuck in this class.

Very good textbook provided! Probably one of the most detailed and example based textbooks, makes it easy to understand the chapter you are learning. Lectures slides are made by the textbook, no real need for them. Test are more complicated than assignments, doesnt necessarily match the assignments. Still doable but tests will hold you from an A.
The class is super boring as he simply reads off the slides, but if you review the slides before the test then you will do fine.

I honestly skipped his class. He reads off the power point which is posted to Canvas, plus he didn't require attendance  so I simply never went to class. However, the class is easy enough to still get an A in.

Class is a seminar type class where Professor Connaughton will interject to guide the discussion. Very knowledgeable professor with fun and witty commentary. If you participate in class you'll be good

Professor Connaughton's seminar is engaging and humorous. Participation is key to your grade—no one has scored a perfect 100%; the highest is 95%, which is achievable. Tests are take-home, so follow his instructions carefully. Plus, there's no final exam, allowing you to focus on assignments and class discussions throughout the semester.

Class is based on discussion of economics of sports related topics and a group project at the end. Professor "trys" not to put in his own opinion but heavily does. Wouldn't recommend but you have to take him for senior seminar.

There're 2 exams (MC & short-answer), 12 discussions, 1 presentation & paper. The professor is a bit of a nut but very funny. I would take a class with him again. His grading methods aren't clear and he never gave a rubric for assignments. For class Discussions just participate. The presentation is on the paper and he will give the topic.

He's nice and difficult to understand. I used the first week or two to get used to his lectures that were hard to follow, because of his accent. After a week or two I was able to understand him, and the content was definitely easier. Don't take him if you can't focus very well. I personally enjoyed it because I learned a lot and he seems to care.

Great professor! This is a difficult class, but Dr. Lin works out problems in class and provides solutions to quizzes and homework, so if you study those and the lecture notes then you will do just fine on the exams. He truly wants everyone to succeed, and he makes the content interesting!

Never had a professor where it's this difficult to just get the base information for the course out of them, ended up having to use Khan Academy and other sources to just keep up with what was in his lectures. His lectures and quiz keys have barely any information, and when you go to class he just reads off of them adding very little to help. Avoid
Dr Lin

Hwan Lin is one of the most understanding professors I've ever had. I wasn't able to get to an exam on time and he allowed to take a make-up with no problems. His class is easy if you study and pay attention.

The class is doable with the right approach. While the professor can be strict, you can still succeed by staying on top of the assignments and using resources like Unstuckstudy to supplement your study prep. Just be ready to put in the work to master the material.

The class is comprised of reading the text, doing the quizzes based on the readings, and then doing the tests online. I did very well in all the tests but the last test I took, she put a different grade for no reason. When I asked her about it through email, she completely ignored my message. So basically she is very inaccessible outside of class!!

Possibly the worst professor I have ever had. Canvas announcements and emails are extremely rude, and littered with grammar and spelling mistakes. 
Everything is done online through Pearson, which I actually liked, but the access code she gave us stopped working and students had to pay $100 to get back in. I dropped the class immediately.

i had an A+ the entire semester until I got sick and missed one test, taking my final grade at the end to a C. there are no makeups whatsoever, and if you reach out for help with grades expect to be ignored and instead patronized by her rude announcements on canvas.

Unlike most professors, Dr. Stivender doesn't feel the need to overcomplicate things in order to learn them. You have 3 tests, 4 homework assignments, and one partner project. She will walk you through everything so just trust her and come to class. I wish I could take all my econ classes with her, very caring.

The word that best describes Professor Stivender is "down-to-earth". Stivender makes an effort to teach what seems to be very complicated or challenging into a very simple course. There were three exams, four homework assignments, and a final project. Each exam was scary walking in, and relieving walking out. Just come to class, and you'll be okay.

Excellent professor. Very caring, very helpful, always responded quickly to emails. Very enthusiastic about economics and teaching and the material was very interesting. Also provided great study guides for exams.

Your grade is based on 3 tests, 4 homeworks, and a project. She tells you exactly what is on the test to study for. The homework Is just like problems done in class, and she will always help you if needed. Project is a group or individual project that does take time but is spread out through the semester.

Econometrics was a super hard class, but Dr. Depkin at least made it easier by testing us more on the intuition rather than math.  He also provided good examples relating to sports that made topics more interesting.  Would 100% recommend him, but beware that this was a hard class.

Econometrics is a hard class and Professor Depken is immensely understanding of how hard the class can be. Tests are open note/open internet. Focus is mainly more on stata and the intuition behind what we are doing and not on statistics/ calculus. Some math is involved but typically not tested on. bonus points given at the end as well.

Professor Camadan is OK. He cares about his students, answers any questions during lectures, & keeps a 1 hour office hours after his lectures. The downside is that he is a tough grader; the exams are worth 78% of your grade, so you have to ace them. There is extra credit, but it doesn't help. You have to buy the textbook to do the assignments.

Reads off of powerpoints. Tests make up almost 80% of your grade and you're given an hour to answer multifaceted questions. Miss 1 question and you're already pushing for a whole letter grade change. You'll have to brush up on your intermediate econ skills and teach yourself.
Incredible prof for ENGR1303, very forgiving, also very funny and easy to talk to. Taught very clearly and is more than willing to explain what you don't understand. Ask him about video games.
He is a great professor. He wants to get to know you very much.

ENGR1303- The teacher was very nice and caring, but the TA graded like I personally attacked him. Near the end of the semester he brings in this guy to teach you MATLAB, and omg he is so monotone and I just could not stand his voice. All in all, he teaches the easiest 130X class, but he really just reads off slides, so paying attention is optional.

ENGR 1303 — McDaniel was an amazing professor. He and the TA were very lenient with grading. This class is by far the easiest of the four 130x courses and I'd definitely recommend taking it through him.

I took McDaniel for 1303, and he isn't a professor—he's a life changer. I had bookstore issues for 3 weeks, and he told me not to worry about the work. He's the nicest person I've ever met. If my kids ever teach, I pray they carry even a fraction of the grace, empathy, and passion that McDaniel shows every single day.

He is a great teacher when it comes to applying the information into hands on activities. The grading is mainly done by the TA so making friends with them will help your grade A LOT. Abby was my TA and she was forgiving on grading and was awesome about help and feedback for any questions I had. His projects are super easy and would recommend him.

His lectures are very long and sometimes boring, but he does talk about interesting topics often. He's a very nice teacher who is always there for you and on your side. The class itself is a lot of work and required more time than all of my other classes combined. Take MAPS and you should get an A though.
He is fair with grading and is quick to get back to students.

Mr. McDaniel wants all of his students to succeed. 1201 is difficult but you should definitely get an A if you have McDaniel. He responds to emails quickly and will help with homework. He is also extremely fair when it comes to grading. If you have the chance, definitely pick him.
Probably the best 1201 professor.

Prof. McDaniel is clearly enthusiastic about engineering. He's happy to work with students to ensure their academic success and understanding. Lecture content itself is often dull but that's due to the class, not the prof. Grading is exacting but standards are very clear and included in every assignment. Be thorough and you'll be fine.

He is one of the best teachers I've ever had. He is very caring and wants his students to succeed. He definitely helps work with you if you don't understand something. I missed an entire week due to being sick and he made catching up super easy. Absolutely take him if you can! Some of the projects aren't fun, but all 1201 classes do the same ones.

Class is annoying, but Mr. McDaniel is super nice and understanding. He truly cares about his students and will help you with anything as best he can. My advice for the class is to get ahead. You can access most assignments early on and they won't really be explained in class so might as well do them early. Class gets stressful after fall break
