Great professor. Took this online rather than in-person to avoid public speaking xD
If you need a GPA booster, then take the course with this professor. Only two exams and easy quizzes. All quizzes and tests were open note and easy to find material.

This class is so easy and its how every LBST class should be. She puts out all of the quizzes at the beginning of the semester and they are either due mid-semester or at the end of the semester. This class is not super time consuming which is great considering the fact that it is an LBST. If you need an easy class to take, take this one.

Overall, Dr. Taheri is a good professor. Lectures weren't particularly engaging (although I had 3 hour class, so that's not really on her), but she was a great professor who was easy to work with and was very knowledgeable about marketing. The coursework isn't super difficult, and while there is one group project, it's totally manageable.
She's somewhat underrated because she only has one class, but she's nice, and her class is pretty easy.

I would absolutely recommend taking her! Easy A and class! Not many assignments (having at least 2-3 per week, really easy), group work during class, and a final group project with a paper. Quizzes are online and open notes (McGraw-Hill). Lectures are a little boring, but they're informative. Only negative is she doesn't respond to emails.

Pretty good professor. Knowledgeable and passionate about subject. The lectures can get very boring and she can sometimes complain if you do something else during the lectures other than pay attention, which is hard for multiple hours on end. Overall worth it though for an easy grade. Easy assignments, homework, tests, projects, etc.

Genuinely such a good professor, lectures are quite boring if I am being completely honest but the course load is super light. Two homework assignments a week that take about thirty minutes each. The test are not bad and are open note. She also offers extra credit assignments to add points to your test specifically. Very relaxed professor

Professor Taheri isn't bad, her lectures are just long and can be a little boring but she tries her best to keep you engaged. Very lenient and does want to see you succeed but is not really available outside of class time. There are a couple of assignments to complete in the week and exams but they are pretty average.

He's truly a great professor. I had him for MKTG3110 and I enjoyed his way of teaching so much that I took him again for MKTG3210 and will take him one last time next semester. He cares about you learning, really engages in class, and gives good feedback on assignments. You won't regret taking him!!
Actually cares about his students and them learning & retaining information.

Overall a good professor. Lots of group work including projects, in addition to individual papers as well. Quizzes were taken weekly and were based on the readings, but were easy as long as you did your reading for the week. Assignment instructions were sometimes confusing. Will work with you if you need support and gave good feedback.
Definitely the best marketing professor. His lectures are really chill (not so much that you'll fall asleep), and you can tell he knows what he's talking about. 100% would take him again!

Professor Jenkins is a great teacher whos enthusiastic about what he teaches. There are readings weekly, but it's only a chapter or two, and the reading is surprisingly interesting. Deals a lot with the psychological/behavioral processes that happen behind the scenes of purchases. Favorite class this semester.
Easy class. Nice professor. 3 case studies that are time consuming but doable. He grades them leniently.
Professor Jenkins was great, very respectful to his students and knowledgeable on the subject. Just wish participation and group work was a little more encouraged.

Professor Jenkins was a great professor, You have 3 case studies, 4 tests (lowest one dropped or optional final) and smartbooks before the test. The smartbooks are due right before each test so they are a great study tool. Class is interesting and he includes his students in his lectures (asks questions and is very funny.) He is great.

Dr. Jenkins is an entertaining, charismatic, and engaged professor who genuinely cares about the students in his class and wants them to succeed. The class itself is so easy that it borders on being fake, but Jenkins's lectures make it worth showing up to. Take this class for a nice easy A and some useful knowledge.

One of the best marketing professors at UNC Charlotte. He assigns readings every week and participation matters in class. You will have reading quizzes every week but as long as you read, you'll do great. He makes the class very engaging and you learn so much! I would take every marketing class with him if I could!

Material is overall easy. Took over 2 months to grade an important grade, but still gives in-person quizzes every week. Expects everyone to participate even in 100 student lectures, but dominates the conversation and doesnt give students a chance to earn participation points. It is apparent that he has other priorities outside this class.

Truly an amazing professor, while the 3 hour classes go the whole time, I have never had a long class I have enjoyed so much. You read chapters every week and have a quiz each week on them, but they are actually very interesting reads. Participation is important but he is a kind grader for assignments.

Professor J was a good professor. Exams are open notes and final is optional. 3 case studies which may take a while to get done but it's doable. I suggest studying for exams because not everything is memorization you have to be able to understand the concepts as well.

Mr. Jenkins is the best we got on this topic. He is awesome and truly a caring professor. He understands that his students have lives outside of class so the workload is as minimal as you can get. Easy textbook assignments, three case studies that take some time, but are interesting, and three exams open notebook (Final is optional).
Dr. Jenkins is amazing! This class teaches you a lot. Be prepared to read, but the readings are informative and interesting! Super easy A
Great Professor. Easy class

Professor Jenkins truly wants to see his students succeed in his class and in life. I took his class online during the Summer and it is very clear what you need to do to get a good grade. Actually enjoyed the class and learned a lot. Definitely recommend taking his class - Best Professor at UNCC!

I always love Dr. Jenkins' classes. The textbooks are actually 2 novels and he assigns a few chapters each week and it's actually interesting. There's one paper and one group presentation. there are reading quizzes (3-6 questions each) every Tuesday so make sure you read. No exams. He's the best Marketing prof we have so take him!
honestly such a nice guy and a great speaker the journals we have to read take a lot of time and you have to know the material to answer the questions but it is pretty simple just takes 2hrs min

The class consists of quizzes each week, lots of reading, two case studies, one group project/presentation, and one huge paper. Dr. Jenkins is funny and makes the class go by fast. The three lowest quiz grades are dropped. We have discussions about the readings after the quiz so do yourself a favor and read!!! You're graded on your participation.

100% recommend this professor. She can be a little disorganized but it is very easy to succeed in this class. Do all your assignments and you will get an A. She is a very easy grader and 10/10 recommend take this class.

Mrs. Collins is a great professor who truly cares about her students. I had her for two classes this semester and would definitely recommend her. She is very knowledgeable and supportive, she is a great professor but an even better person.

Suzanne Collins overall is a good professor. I've taken her for multiple classes and have gotten A's in all of them. The only negative thing I have to say is she can be a little unorganized and unpredictable because she has another job. Besides that her classes are simple and take the bare minimum to pass.

Professor Collins does not teach this course as a "business" or "marketing" class, but more as a "technology" class. (Her words, not mine) Not entirely a problem, but what's not mentioned in the (outdated) syllabus, is a 5-day Google AI intensive coding course where you will be DROWNING if you don't know how to code in Python. Be careful taking her

I had her three times, and I wish I could take her again! The material isn't difficult and is thought-provoking, but if you don't put in the work, you will struggle. At times, she is a little "all over the place," but it's only because she provides a lot of examples and answers peers questions. Flexible and amazing teacher who cares about students!

Professor Collins, MKTG 3110 class is a super easy class. Attendance matters because their is a lot of in-class assignments and a few presentations but other than that its a super easy class. Professor Collins is a little all over the place and sometimes it's hard to pay attention.

Professor Collins is a great professor, arguably the best I've had during my 4 years at UNCC. If you submit it and its wrong, you can resubmit for a better grade. You can use your notes on exams and she genuinely cares for her students. I really enjoyed her class and wish I could take her again.
She's gives out a lot of extra credit. Her exams aren't too hard. Her grading is very lenient.

Professor Collins is absolutely amazing. She doesn't bullshit around with her students. I took her for a 3 hour class and we were never in there longer than 1.5-2 hours. She is an extremely easy grader as long as you turn something in. She is very relaxed and easy going but can be quirky sometimes. Def recommend.

Professor Robinson was truly an amazing professor this semester! She always comes to class with a positive attitude and cares about the wellbeing of her students. Lots of group work and presentations for this course, but she's very clear with what she expects from assignments and her grading rubric. Would definitely take her again!

She is not a bad professor, and the class is not hard. The only reason I gave her a 3 is that she does have an attitude problem, especially if people do not participate. There is one main group project; we had a bit of an issue with the organization of the process. If she does not like something, she will catch an attitude with you.

Class was extremely easy and mostly common sense based, but the professor made this class unenjoyable. She is not willing to be flexible at all, so be ready to make this class your one and only priority. More than half of the time in each class was wasted with silly questions but attendance was mandatory.

Professor Robinson is an awesome professor. Class participation is weighted most heavy than test and quiz. As long as you attend to class regularly, you will do good in her class. She is also easy to talk to and make conversation with outside of class. I would take her 5/5.
Soooooo Cooooool. Soooooo funnnnnny. Soooooo niceeeeeeee. Soooooooo beautiful. Sooooooooo smarttttttttttttt
Such a kind soul. Her voice reminds me of classical music from Beethoven. She loves to talk about baseball due to her name

Dr. Robinson is a charismatic engaging professor. She has fun lectures where students participate but she also teaches. We had a few required attendance lectures but she told us in advance. One smartbook a week, a few exams and one group project.
Her name kinda funny due to the first African American Baseball player. Ask her if she good at baseball.

Her lectures were fun and she always wore a big smile. You can tell she loves her job and her students. The smartbooks were long and sometimes you had to do 2 of them, but the content was fine. The tests and quizzes were less definition heavy and had more practical questions. Study well

You can tell that Prof Robinson cares about her students. She consistently asks for feedback. Very open to adjusting the schedule and people in your group if you reach out. The tests are difficult, but if you show up and do the extra credit you will be fine. For the tests, study the slides closely, some questions came directly from the slides.
no clue why she finds it necessary to have 90 question homework assignments but if you take this class good luck with that

Professor Robinson was great! Very hard to do bad in the class. Weekly smartbook assignments, 3 test and 3 quizzes all on lockdown browser but very easy and she provides study guides. One group presentation. She loves to hear from students during her lectures!

This class is not difficult. Smartbook homework, lockdown quizzes and exams. Study the key terms for your chapters. We had 1 group assignment/presentation. She's very polite and the class is low stress. You will pass with a little effort.
She is very nice and knows that it is very hard to fail her class. Weekly smartbook assignments, 3 quizzes, 3 tests, and a group project. This is a very low-stress class. Take her if you can!

Professor Robinson is AWESOME! Very clear, simple and easy to understand. She does have a group project, but if the group has good communication it is easy. She like to make lectures interactive and student involved but in a good way! She is very helpful and supportive with class or 'life' needs.
Super caring and respectful teacher that will help you get an A regardless. Class is very easy if you follow along and study the textbook.
Professor Robinson is amazing! Very caring and understanding towards her students. It is clear she wants them all to succeed. If you have the chance to take a course with her I definitely would!

He can be a great professor and he will respond to your emails. But overall the course is poorly constructed with no precise outline of what he's looking for. Doing the assignments isn't enough, the answers have to be correct or you with a 0 or half the credit. The course is super confusing. He doesn't work with you for an improvement grade!

When I say he's a difficult teacher, I mean he's vague with the material and isn't a flexible nor understanding teacher. He accused over half the class of cheating and sets Respondus Lockdown Browser on STRICT (so if you have ADHD or avert your eyes from the screen just once, you're "cheating"). Not a good teacher since he can't teach.

Literally the worst prof at UNCC in my experience. Randomly changed everything about the class in the middle of the semester since he found out someone was cheating. Does not care about his students in any way shape or form. Barely answers emails but won't provide any additional resources or help if you ask for it. Take any other professor.

The course is so content heavy but it becomes a detriment to the students, especially when it comes to testing. I feel this professor made the course harder for all students to combat the couple that were cheating. Group assignment heavy but the work is simple. The professor is otherwise nice and easy to communicate with.

Task heavy course, it will require a minimum of 15 hours a week out of your business schedule. His instructions and how he grades you do not match; his questions are generally written "in general terms" but he grades hard because you did not answer the question(s) in a specific manner.  I learned very little, to busy with task no time to learn.

Honestly, this guy is really nice and wants you to succeed. He is a little boring when it comes to the lecture and you do need to study for the tests. He genuinely cares about feedback however and curved our tests, changed grades when we were upset, and listened to you if you needed to be absent.

The guy is nice but the "mimic socials" you have to do are basically a guessing game. Whenever you ask him a question about the simulation, his answer is always "the answers are always different because of the algorithm" and never gives feedback on how we are actually supposed to do the work. Tests don't cover information taught. He seems confused.

I actually enjoyed this class until it came time for the exams - yes, there are multiple, plus a group project/paper.  The exams were not a fair assessment of what was presented in lecture and most students did very poorly.  It's a shame because overall I think this professor is very nice and this class could be great.

I haven't finished the class yet but so far Ms. Fox has been a really great instructor. The class consists of a simulation, helping a business, and a couple exams with papers on each. She is very helpful and really cares about her students. This is my last and only class of the semester and it has been a great experience!

Cindy Fox is a great professor. B2B is a pretty easy class- tests are given in person on paper. As long as you go to class/review the slides you'll do fine on the tests. Very minimal HW assignments and we had two group projects that were fairly easy.

She wasn't bad as a teacher, she was just super confusing. She wants you to be concise and well structure but all of her directions are confusing and isn't structure well at all. She grades things late, walked for graduation and all of us who has her still doesn't know our grade at all. I also believe her marketing ideals are a tad bit out dated.

She isn't a bad professor, however, lectures can be boring, she can be a harsh grader, and exams are heavily weighted but she is really nice and tries to be understanding. Attendance is mandatory and you lose points if you don't attend. Overall a good experience but I would not take her again.

I was worried about her class due to her ratings but i'm not sure why she has such low reviews. Fox really does care about her students and wants them to succeed. It's the last class before graduation, obviously it's going to be challenging. As long as you actually pay attention to her guidelines and rubric for projects, you will get a good grade.

This teacher is always a hot topic LOL. I have had her for a few semesters now, and she is such an amazing person which is why I rated her so high. If you put in the effort and actually care about her and the class, you will be fine. Lowkey one of my favorite professors at UNCC.

After reading her reviews I was so afraid to take her classes. After having her 2x this semester I learned that the bad reviews are probably coming from students who didn't show up to class or participate. Ensure you choose your group wisely (group heavy) come to class, pay attention and participate you'll get an easy A. Great professor and helpful
Extremely disorganized. During the semester, syllabus, assignments, and tasks were changed due to the lack of understanding by the professor herself. She is kind, though. I will say that.
This professor was not well organized. Lacks consistency and clear direction

Asks the class a lot of questions and gets upset if we don't know/answer. We're more than halfway into the semester and there are 2 grades in Canvas rn. There's also a group project where you're expected to just know how to do in-depth data analysis even though he's only taught us concepts, not how to actually put them into practice.

Some test questions are worded incorrectly or have multiple correct answers with no lenience. Not many grades, if you do poorly on one there's no chance of getting a decent grade. No useful prep for tests. Easy to get a C in, just don't expect to do well under this professor (He's focused on research). Dean's List student barely got a B.

I took MKTG 3110 as an online class.  The lectures were tapped, but they were clear and contained a lot of content. The professor seemed to enjoy what he was eaching. There were end of module quizzes w/two exams (35% and 50%) as well as extract credit. Professor Golmohammadi is a great choice if you want a simple class without group projects.

Cool professor who enjoys what he teaches. Class is made up of 3 exams and "quizzes" taken in class which are usually just short assignments. Quizzes aren't announced ahead of time so be aware of that when deciding to miss class. Overall a really easy class as a lot of exam questions can be answered with common sense.

Ali is pretty cool. There's only a midterm and a final. Mostly lectures in class. There's a final group project and paper. There's also a final individual project where you make a website about yourself. He jokes sometimes and is approachable. The content isn't too difficult to understand.

Not the best, not the worst. He is horrible about interrupting and thinks only his responses are correct. 2 in-person, closed-note exams were pretty easy. Wants us to participate but it's hard when he doesn't like our answers. "Quizzes" were one-page responses to academic papers. Took attendance on Thursdays bc no one shows. Super boring lectures
Boring lectures but an easy class

Easiest class I have ever taken. Just show up to class, my final grade was 102. The only catch is the class is very boring. He's a nice dude, but his lectures go by so slow. If he opens the class to discussion, just try to engage to make it go by faster.

Nice guy, exams are similar to powerpoints. Study and you will do fine.  He also allots extra credit on each exam, whether it be adding extra points or giving extra credit questions. These other reviews are complaining for no reason, Ali teaches a basic marketing course just fine.

Three tests worth 85% of grade. Most boring lectures I have ever seen. You try to pay attention and he makes 7 minutes feel like half an hour. I would stay clear cause you don't learn anything. He reads off of boring slides. For a marketing course we should have been more engaged!!

Makes the class easy but it comes at a cost. Finals are next week and there's 7 grades for the whole semester, so you can't slip up. Boring lectures, adds material to exams that he's never mentioned before, doesn't emphasize what's important vs what's not, 0 extra cred. 

Not the worst ever but DEFINITELY don't take him as a first option

He is an easy professor but outside of that he does nothing right.  He isn't accessible.  He has absolutely 0 enthusiasm about what he teaches.  One lecture from him will drain everything out of you and you will lose any ambition to want to do good in there.  I have no positive remarks.

Dr. Tuders is hands down the best professor I've ever had. 

Grade is mostly project based, so ensure your group is on track throughout the semester. He just wants to see effort, doesn't have to be a perfect final product, and you'll get an A.

HANDS DOWN the best marketing professor at UNCC. Extremely caring, you have to participate but he wants you to succeed and will absolutely help you along the way. I took him for MKTG 3224 and I can say easily my favorite marketing class I have taken. Show up to class, participate, and you will do well. If I could rate 10 stars, I absolutely would.
Ton of experience. He cares

Dr. Tudors is amazing! I took him for MKTG 3224 and he really taught us a lot of real world applications. There are 4 projects for the whole semester and a few small, very easy assignments here and there. He really cares about teaching us things we can use in the real world. Easy A!

Best professor in the MBA hands down. Have taken him for both Human Behavior and Innovation and plan to take another class he will teach in the fall. His lectures are funny and applicable to the real world. He is extremely charismatic and helps you improve public speaking skills. Lots of group project work, but little to no busy work.
One of the most talented professors at UNCC. Extremely passionate about the subject material and a great mentor. I encourage everyone to take this class, even if they are not an MBA student.

Dr. Tuders is an amazing professor.  His Human Behavior in Organizations class is the most enjoyable college course I have taken.  Dr. Tuders gives valuable practical tools that can be instantly implemented into your life to improve yourself.  He cares about his students success and is accessible outside of class for help and clarification.

He is a little hard to understand at times, but the slide shows him all the information you need. I feel like he over-explains the slides and the class is often boring. It definitely did not need to be 3 hours long. The exams are in person, no lockdown is required. There is also a group project that you have to present at the end. Would take again.

Class consists of 3 exams, a sem. long Group project & paper and in-class assignments. Prof is a very generous grader and gives lots of extra credit. Exams are hard but come right from slides/textbook. Lectures are good. He cares about his students and is so nice, rewards you for putting in effort. Rounded my final grade a full 2 points up to an A!
Can be hard to understand at times, but is one of the most caring professors I have had! Genuinely wants you to do well, and will help you succeed with whatever you need. Definitely recommend!
Learned a lot from this course!

Her lectures are so quick that its hard to follow, and she is not very good at answering questions that students have. The final was worth 30% of our grade (first two were only worth 10) and it wasn't even cumulative. Had to curve 30 points because everyone did so poorly. So many trick questions and surprise materials on the final.

Super easy! Professor Angela is very knowledgeable. She replies promptly whenever you have any doubts. Only thing i hated in this course,For group project there will be a peer evaluation (which IMO is very unfair!). We did some fancy things for the project and our marks got deducted(although professor rated us high!) because peer reviewed us low!

She is a very engaging professor who operates her class in a very conversational manner.  Class is never more than an hour and her lecture is just a quick pass over some of the outline notes in the book. 
My issue with the class for me is how group project and tests are presented.  Difficult structure, questions, and poorly worded instructions.

She's the best and she knows what she's talking about due to her experiences in marketing in real life. Her lectures are more conversational which is nice because youll be able to grasp on to each concept. She truly cares about her students. Her quizzes and exams are sometimes in person with lockdown so study but her quizzes and exams aren't hard.

Great professor. You would have to work pretty hard to fail this class. Anything less than a B is completely on you. She gives loads of extra credit opportunities as well. Lots of reading and homework, but you will learn. Overall great class.

The only fault to this class was the group project. Otherwise a very straightforward, kind, available and accommodating professor. You will have a textbook/Smartbook activities and tests on Lockdown Browser (if you are online). I would recommend her!

One of the best teachers Ive had during my senior year. Laid back, and when the homework was really long she ended up just making it easier/shorter. Test are easy (quizlet), one group project which is easy, participation not required at all. She really understanding and cares about students opinions about the class.

I think Professor Robinson was really nice but I honestly wouldn't recommend taking her. Randomly adds lockdown on exams and on quizzes. I also think her exams are a little harder than they should have been for an intro class. The homework could be a little lengthy but very easy.
She was really good at condensing all the information. Lots of in class assignments, but you get to work with other people. She helps you with projects too. Cares a lot about her students.

Definitely the worst professor I've taken thus far and it's my last semester here lol. Her idea of an effective class is to lecture or give you a piece of paper and some markers and make a little poster. Does she think we're in middle school? Attendance is a grade, but it's only 5%. If you show up and your group members don't, oh well.
Could care less for her students genuinely makes her happy failing them no matter how hard they try.

Enjoyed this class so much. His lectures were entertaining, relevant, and well organized, even it got out of topic sometimes. His ppt slides were updated 5min before class to include up to date statistics and research. You better know what Blockchain is before going into this class tho! Best professor I've ever had!

Dr. Erevelles is a very difficult professor to follow.

What makes his course difficult is he has no structure or organization to what he is teaching. The information you cover is all over the place and doesn't align with the syllabus. Plus, he goes on tangents and almost never answers what you ask him without going completely off track.
His lectures are a bit crazy but always entertaining and interesting.  I learned a lot and felt that the grading was fair.

I took this class during the summer so it was a five week class. I can say I did not learn anything helpful or worth while but the class is an easy A or B. The prof lectures were long and a bunch of rambling about things that did not matter or correlate. Overall, assignment's are easy, only allowed to miss two days of class, plenty of extra credit.
Very knowledgeable guy. Learned a lot. I still think we could have touched on corporate marketing techniques to make the class more well rounded.

Bad communication and impossible to get in touch with. Her TA grades almost everything, but no feedback was given to improve. There were 3 exams throughout the class, with no open notes; wouldn't allow students to study from old class material either (quizzes, etc.). She has no business running an online class. Waste of money and time.
Unclear grading, confusing canvas page, lectures barely prepare you for exams, bad at answering emails, and always overseas during test days.
Take a different professor if possible.

Tom is a good professor; he's an older fella, so I understand the complaints about rambling and unengaged lectures. He does know what he is talking about, and if u need clarification, he will give it to you. Tests are poll ev and notes strictly. Show up get the information and review it and u will be fine.

He's a really nice guy and very knowledgeble. Someone who is ready to help you. He loves talking about Belfast, Ireland tho! Otherwise just pay attention to PollEV and study a bit before the test and you will be fine:)
Attendance not mandatory but he loves PollEV. Insanely boring lectures.

Not good. Lecturers are boring and slides are content heavy. Professor is very unengaging. Professor rambles too much. Will help if asked but being in class was of no help at all, cannot stress enough how dull and mundane lectures are.

Nice guy but incredibly boring lecturer. Reads straight from content heavy slides. Rambles constantly. Answers questions when asked but not without taking 5 minutes for a simple answer. Tends to ramble on tangents, hard to stay focused. Incredibly unengaging in teaching style. Unfortunately the only teacher for certain classes.

attendance isn't mandatory but does pollev for grades.  His lectures are kinda dull but the exams are legit the pollev and quizlet questions.  Really nice guy who cares about his students.  Always talked about internship opportunities before class
So sweet and very understanding. The best teacher I ever had. Good teacher and helps you when needed 10/10

Knowledgeable and respectful to his students! He's overall a good professor and knows what he is doing, and is also a lenient grader on the written exams. His main downfall is that the class itself and the lectures are rather dull, so it can be difficult not to zone out

he cares about your grade as much as you do.30% of your grade is attendance (poll everywhere grade) polls are taken almost every class. if ur a good listener, its worth it. hes sweet &patient, just dnt take advantage. He teaches for the real world and inspires his students to be involved on campus. 1 of the few people ive met tht loves their job.

Prof. Marshall is a caring professor who is concerned with the professional development of his students, in the financial services and insurance industry. Every class, he talks about career opportunities, gives LinkedIn advice, etc. His exams are based on the PollEv questions and the Case Study. Lectures can be dry and he tends to ramble

Might as well be Joe Biden teaching the class... reads straight from power points and then has no clue what he even said. He repeats the same material at times and does not tell the students what to expect on the exams. You won't do good in this class if you don't teach yourself everything and memorize all of the polls. He should retire immediately

Really nice and sweet guy but class can be pretty tough. Several PollEv questions every class which are graded. Lectures are sorta slow and boring. Three tests with maybe half the questions borrowed from polls and a group project. Project can be overwhelming so get his help before it's too late. Useful stuff though, wish I paid more attention.

Professor Marshall is a great professor. He is dedicated to ensuring that all students understand the material and succeed his class. If you attend his office hours, he will help you out with anything you're having trouble with, i.e., learning material, assignments, and projects. Overall, a really great and wise professor.

Mr. Marshall is extremely helpful. His class is challenging but if you go to his office hours he will help you. He does poll everywhere everyday and uses the questions on the exam so study the poll everywhere and his PowerPoints it is pretty straightforward and not too hard.

Mr. Marshal is one of the best professors UNCC has. But his lectures can be slow even a little boring and it is not an easy A type of class. This is a class where u actually have to put in work but it's not difficult. His exam questions come straight from his PowerPoints. If you pay attention in class, take notes, and study you will be fine.

Pretty quiet professor that takes time in class to show you how to plug stuff into the calculator so the problems are easier. She gives a 110% grade scope, which allows for a forgiving grading. Watch out for quizzes after each class; they count for grades, and they can creep up on you if you don't show up to class. Overall, I'd take the class again

Accent is pretty tough to understand sometimes. Not ideal especially when talking about confusing financial theory topics. Material to study for the exam is pretty straightforward. (Homework and slides). If you study that you're fine for the exam. 8% extra credit assignment is nice.

Very kind and knowledgable, you can tell she wants students to succeed. Attendance isn't mandatory but its helpful to go, she takes attendance quizzes but they barely affect your grade. Classes are also helpful because she teaches questions/concepts that are on each test. Also you get a cheat sheet for each test. Best professor to take tbh.

This class was very chill, and the prof. teaches in an easily-understandable manner. Tests directly come from in-class and homework problems, making them easy to prep for reliably. Attendance isn't "mandatory," but show up because there are quizzes at the end of most lectures that give you bonus points. Could not ask for a better class.
She makes this class very easy to pass and is a great teacher. Even though she goes through lecture notes, she really prepares you for exams. She also allows you to use a cheatsheet on the exam.
Took Finn 3120 for credit, easiest class ever!

Knows her information but often keeps her mouth right up on the microphone which can be a little annoying. Very nice and willing to answer questions. Daily quizzes either on Canvas or PollEverywhere that require a code given in class. 1 page cheat sheets allowed for exams. NEED BA II Plus calculator. Would recommend

Very clear in his instructional methods, and the workload is very reasonable. Very flexible, agreeable person that teaches practical skills for teachers, rather than just theoretical things with no application. Highly recommend.

After reading the other reviews for Dr. Fisher, I'd have to disagree with them. He was very clear on exactly what to do for assignments and what the expectations were. easiest class in the world.

He is a very personable guy who puts his heart into helping students not fail. He is very strict with phones and other electronics not distracting from the class.
Easy class, great professor. Just do the work and its an easy A.

Byker is a nice guy.  Class is a little boring, u smack together like 4 lesson plans throughout the whole semester. He gives comments, u make revisions and then u send back. u dont learn much but its ok, you kind of teach yourself

This is the most blah class, and I don't know another way to describe it. I liked Byker a lot. He was helpful and gave good feedback. He provides examples for every assignment, which helps. Dr. Byker was truly an amazing professor; he knows exactly what he is teaching and has an extensive amount of experience. Very helpful when it comes to improvements for papers and a confidence boost. Overall great experience 10/10.

He is such a supportive teacher and makes you feel the best about yourself. A little assignment heavy but the work shouldn't take you more than 20-25 mins. I honestly loved his class. The assignments were easy, and he was very helpful. I 100% recommend it!
I literally love Dr. Byker.  He is such a great teacher and I love his stories.

Amazing teacher. As a freshman at UNCC, Dr. Byker was an amazing way to start my college career. He even had some activities to introduce freshmen to the campus. He's very involved in his work and what he teaches. Couldn't recommend more!

Love this professor! Very light-hearted and cares about his students. Definitely an easy A! A lot of the work can be done in class! Besides the group presentation and paper, a lot of the work is participation!
One of my favorite classes I have taken at Charlotte this far! He makes me excited to become a teacher and is always excited and ready for class! A must take professor at Charlotte! Learned so much!
Dr. Byker is a must have teacher while in the Cato College of Education. He is caring and respectful. The classroom environment he creates makes one feel safe and excited to one day be a teacher.

Dr. Taylor is a sweet lady, but her guidelines are far from clear on her assignments, and she gets annoyed when you ask her for help. CHFD 2412 is classwork heavy course and the Dr. Taylor, while she seems passionate, does not lead riveting lectures. Dr.Myers is a very kind person, who truly does care about his students. But he is very rude, and will interrupt anyone when they're speaking. Especially if you do not think the same way he does.

Dr. Myers is great and passionate about what he teaches! The opportunities to go visit schools were incredible and I enjoyed every part of his class, including the Inquiry Project. Now EDUC 1511, was great with Dr. Myers. He is excited about working with future teachers and it shows. Dr. Myers was difficult to contact.

Dr. Myers is great. I actually took him for MDSK3100. The readings and documentaries are great. We had some great class discussions. He clearly cares about his students and is there for you. He has a great personality.

It would be nice if this teacher didn't have assignments that was just writing upon writing upon writing, just to do a 3-5 minute video (ignoring how comfortable people are to do that) just to make it a heavy grade and for it to be public to the entire class AND have to record yourself responding to others. I really enjoyed her course and I feel I learned a lot. She's a professor who actually cares for her students to succeed and do good. Also created a great environment, I would 100 percent take this course again.

Hatch is a good teacher, I enjoyed her class. I thought we'd meet in person but most of the time we met online or were asynchronous, since that's how she wanted to structure the class. I loved Mrs. Hatch, and I am going to miss her as a teacher. This class was mainly online via Zoom with about 2-3 in-person meetings. This class was great, although you are expected to actively participate regularly. She prided herself on making her class a safe space, which she did do. She was an easy grader, as long as you showed up and tried your best. You do have to be vulnerable which throws people off, but if you're open to it, this is a great class.
She's really nice, the class honestly isn't that hard. She does expect a lot of participation. She's a really easy grader though. If you show up and pay attention and speak up, you'll do great.
Great professor who wants to help you succeed. It's a pretty easy elective course but there is definitely some interesting topics covered as well. Offers a little extra credit.

Super nice professor that's understanding and easy to work with. There are not many assignments in this course, so you have wiggle room for getting stuff done. It's mostly just reading comprehension quizzes from the textbook. Just don't forget about the clinical choice board assignment.

This professor is one of the best you could get. Most classes are fun discussion sessions. Assignments have a lot of wigglre room. Project heavy but, the projects are creative and very open ended. Amazing professor!

Amazing professor. She cares a lot about her students and is lenient with extensions. Interactive class. Great and quick feedback on assignments. Plenty of group work (easy stuff). 10/10 would recommend.

In EDUC 1511, you really just need to show her you care and are paying attention and she will love you. The readings are long, but honestly interesting because it is on current events in education. Lots of group work but its simple assignments.

I took her Education in America class and it was reasonably easy. The readings are not long and she gives you time in class to prepare for discussions. Would recommend taking her for your themes class! Very easy A, just do the work that is given!

Professor Coffey's class is unorganized sometimes but the lessons are easy to understand. She has the TA do a lot of the grading so the criteria is not hard. Dr. Coffey is a wonderful professor. She truly cares about her students and her class is very easy. Show up to class and do the work and you will pass!

She is very kind but the class was a bit of a mess. The canvas page was unorganized and requirements were vague. All assignment information appears to be generated by A.I. She is really a great professor, and she has a wonderful class. The downside is that she is very unorganized, she tries to make the class very active. Very unorganized and lacks clear communication at times, but she's a very kind lady.

Dr. Coffey was an amazing professor and I would take her again in a heartbeat. Her canvas page is very structured and clear, she grades at a good rate, and her feedback is very specific and clear. She is also very caring and very easy to work with.

Dr. Coffey is fantastic! This class has 15 hours for clinicals, mandatory attendance, lots of textbook reading and group work. Very nice, caring, organized class, cares a lot about student voices and lots of group discussion. Take her for anything you can!!!!
Literally the sweetest guy ever. He truly cares about all of his students, and you can go to him about anything. Anyone would be lucky to take his class! :)

Very genuine and very caring. He mostly lectures, but hardly gives much work. He cares a lot about the students. If you need an extension or need to miss a day, just email him. He has some good jokes from time to time. One of my favorites.

She is very nice, but holy guacamole, she is BORING. She loses her train of thought often and stands staring into the abyss. get ready for ur brain to melt.  Its like shes forced to present off a random slide show of a topic shes never heard of each day. Not sure what is going on but she seems extremely frazzled and disorganized eacg class.  also expect a random 5 page essay due every few weeks.

Dr. Cash is a super kind person and a great professor. Her class was very lecture heavy which made her class a little dull but she was super helpful and was always willing to meet your needs. Super sweet person, not the best professor. Seems unprepared for class and explains content poorly. Powerpoints do not align with psychology. She pauses every few minutes to collect her thoughts. Lots of busywork but also some helpful assignments. Majority of class is spent doing virtually nothing.

EDUC 1511: Class is easy just a lot of work sometimes. Assignments due Sunday so you have a whole week to do it, don't wait until the last minute, time consuming. EDUC1511 - As long as you do the work, there should be no problem passing the class. I had no troubles throughout this class. Assignments were due weekly every Sunday. The work is a little tedious, but easy A if you're looking for it.

FOR EDUC 1511 (could not select anything else but 3120). Professor Cash's class was fairly easy and self paced. All of our assignments were due on Sundays so that made it easy for me to work out a schedule. As long as you do the work, you should be fine.

I would so take her again. Love Dr. Cash, she is so caring and you can tell she really cares about her students. I learned a lot in her class and feel more prepared going into the education field because of taking this class. Great professor, great class, take this class if you can!!!

Dr. Graham is an amazing professor who works extremely hard to teach an increasingly "controversial" class. She expects quality work that reflects effort and understanding. 0/10 would never recommend this professor. She singles people out and picks on them in class. She gives busy work every class that is super pointless. She really made my learning environment very uncomfortable.

If you go to class and do your homework you will pass. Dr. Dack is strict on attendance but it makes sense because if you miss one class you miss a lot. This class just feels pointless and repetitive. Doesn't make you prepared for being a teacher. Would not take again

Such an amazing professor, I am grateful to have been  in his class. assignments were clear and grading was fair. understanding and has real concern for his students. cant wait to take another class with him

She is AWESOME! Semester went by so fast. She likes to interact with students, so make sure to raise your hand and participate. Overall would recommend the class and the professor.

Worst professor at UNCC. He is lazy and reads off the powerpoint, and gets off topic. No homework but 3 tests which are worth 60% of your grade and he grades them incorrectly. Dr. Carrothers is a great professor, just really boring lectures. He sometimes tells stories, but mostly just reads slides. Canvas is a mess, but honestly super easy class and he will help you out if you ask!
Great professor. Lectures a lot but provides a little bit of humor. Exams are easy and online. Can be boring sometimes but it is a boring concept.

Dr. J is the man, loved having him. He is very friendly. This is a class where you don't need to do much work. Lots of extra credit opportunities. 


Lectures can get a little off topic, won't always be relevant to the course material.

Don't do it. Just don't. He doesn't teach anything, doesn't seem to really know anything about the subject matter, and as a bonus he's insanely boring to listen to. Just rambles on endlessly. I don't know why all of Prof. Carrothers reviews are so bad. His Canvas isn't great and his exam question wording can be weird, but even so he's very chill and it's not hard to pass with an A. Unorganized and impossible to get ahold of over email, his instructions for assignments are very unclear and awful rubrics. I have no idea how he was hired as a professor.

Don't take this professor unless you want to waste your time. This is the most confused professor. Everything is unclear. he doesn't know how to use canvas. There is no transparency in the way he grades. He is a good person but terrible educator.

Does not grade ANYTHING until the end of the semester, literally nothing. Has no idea how to use canvas and is not clear on due dates or outlines for assignments. Class is graded on 3 exams, & a cumulative quiz grade. Exams are open ended, & will take you a day or two, but they aren't too bad. Only true challenge is the exams. Open ended exams where if you show effort and knowledge on the topic, you will do fine. They are long though so clear a day or two to get an exam done.
Weekly quizzes on canvas and pop quizzes in class. 4 tests and she counts attendance. She cares about your education

Professor Sly is a great teacher to take for this course. She is always willing to help you out and she makes sure you understand everything before the exams. If you asked questions during the exam she will help you out. If you need this class, take her!
Don't recommend her at all.. Do not take

If you want to waste time and regret even going to college then this professor is right to you. The class was more of a TedTalk that you are forced to see instead of an engaging and open classroom. Professor Vasudev is a relatively difficult professor to take. He uses the lecture time to the fullest degree and there is no homework except for module quizzes. Exams are worth 75% of your grade. The fact that he removes modules from the canvas page with the excuse of just make sure you take notes before then neglecting the fact that if you do not complete a module before he removes it you will not be able to access anything else in the future including exam review and formula sheets.

Went to a total of 3 classes within the first two weeks of the semester. Never went again. I probably would've done better if I had gone to class...ended with an A-
now he makes you take most exam in perosn so dont listen to the last rate my professor if you have him in person the exam will be in person other than the final.

Very important to go to class, as most material on tests is from lectures in class. Assignments are easy with a quiz, and packback do every week. A few deep dive packbacks are due, but very easily graded. Offered 3 points on the final grade for 75% completion on course evaluations.

Amazing professor, very passionate about the class. Homework was just discussion boards which were extremely easy. Exams are online no lockdown browser, extremely easy exams if you actually read and pay attention. Loved this professor

Lectures are long and can tend to doze off but as long as you pay attention and make quizlets your fine for tests. Discussion questions and essays are actually pretty captivating and aren't super hard. Attendance isn't mandatory at all but If you study the textbook and make notes you should be totally fine.
Overall not a bad class or professor. All exams were online and pretty easy. Attendance is not mandatory as he just talks the whole time, but he does not post slides so keep that in mind.

Prof. Houck is easy to talk to. Only annoying thing were the Packbacks. 1-2 per week w/ a reading quiz or 2. Essays graded with AI. 

Lectures are kinda boring, but seriously GO TO HIS CLASSES because the stuff he says are on the test. Also-- read the book, that's on tests too. I got by without reading the other stuff he assigns :p

lectures are long, all work is online including exams, weekly Packbacks graded (never close still get full credit), 3 deep dive essays (grading is not too harsh), chapter quizzes (online, super easy, about 10 questions, time limit close on deadline and don't open again) very easy A

This is an easy class for the gen ed requirement. All the tests + final are online, do with that as you will. As long as you know basic-intermediate levels of history, you don't really need to attend as you will know the stuff already. His lecture's are SOOO boring omg. Like I physically cannot. I was done by day one. He doesn't project/use a mic. Dr. Houck is a great professor. His lectures are interesting and include on-going political events, but doesn't push on your own beliefs. Very long very boring lectures. Puts his own political beliefs into his lectures. Three essays over the semester. Weekly discussion posts and reading quizzes. Online tests. I wouldn't take him again even though the class is easy because of how boring it is.

Professor Houcks will talk for the whole class and you should take notes he provides on the slide because he does not have his lecture slides in Canvas. There isn't much work other than some chapter quizzes and weekly discussions. He seems pretty chill and will hold exams online.
Professor Houck is a great professor who genuinely cares about his students. He offers extra credit opportunities and is very accessible outside of class, making it easy to get help when needed.

Pretty good professor. Lenient with late work, but this class is test heavy (3 tests worth 20% each) and requires a lot of reading. Lectures can tend to get a bit boring, but an interesting class regardless!

Houck is obviously very passionate about his subject, but has a tendency to ramble during lectures. His assignments are mostly weekly discussions and he's not that tough a grader, so the exams are what will likely make or break your entire grade as they are each worth 20%. So MAKE SURE TO STUDY and don't just focus on what's on his study guides.

Love Professor Houck in general! He's a great professor and easily accessible outside of class. Just be fully prepared to read a lot. He doesn't give 100% on anything and he made that clear in the beginning of the semester. His grading can be tough and based off of opinion. GO TO CLASS. Due dates can be tight but he is flexible with extensions

Dr. Houck is great, he's the main reason I majored in INTL. He goes way out of his way to help and to be accessible outside class, and his classes are always interesting and entertaining. Dr. Houck is a caring professor. I have ideas that differ w/some of his & he shows respect. His quizzes are hard, so I had to know the material. Work hard & you'll do well!

Dr. Houck Is an amazing professor. His lectures do tend to get boring but they are very informative. He doesn't give too much HW, just a couple of discussion boards, infographic, and quizzes. There were 2 tests and 1 final which were all taken online. Take notes during lectures because these do appear on tests
Extremely kind and understanding. Grades for completion on homework assignments. Easy exams.

Mr. Wray is an amazing teacher. His work is pretty straightforward and just come to class, or if you can't make it, just communicate. He is very understanding and loves to help his students. I would recommend him no matter what and just do the work on time
The greatest professor of all time, enjoyed every minute in this class, very easy class.

Professor Wray makes WRDS1103 engaging and approachable. He explains assignments clearly, gives constructive feedback, and keeps lectures light with humor and occasional tangents. His grading is fair, workload manageable, and he provides a supportive, interactive environment. Highly recommended for anyone seeking a positive intro writing class.
Really good professor every assignemnt is participation so if you do the assignment ur good.

I loved his class! I enjoyed going to his class. There were not a lot of lectures more activity based that ended with group discussion regarding the different perspectives. There was not a lot of homework, but were 2-3 written assignments that required some time to complete. Fun, chill person. RECOMMEND!

Mr. Wray loves his job and his passion for writing and communication is very strong. Although his attendance policy and slightly strict he does allow up to 5 days which isn't bad. His class is very doable and the assignments do not take long. He does not give a lot of assignments and his teaching style is very good.

Overall I liked Prof Wray. He does "lecture" a lot but they often feel like him yapping about the same stuff over and over. He's super nice though and very funny. Would def take him again. All grades are participation and he gives real feedback. A few papers but again just completion grades. He genuinely cares for his students and wants to connect
Had his class for my freshman year, and although it was an 8 am class, it was always an easy lecture and easy to get through. He's very understanding and can be funny.

Does this man need more praise?? If he is teaching, take him. He loves his job, and you can tell.

He is such an incredible man, he truly enjoyed teaching the class which was heavily reflected in his lectures which were fun and interesting. I recommend him to all my friends and wish that every professor was like him.
Professor Wray is amazing. He is hilarious, understanding, and clearly explains all of his expectations. I highly recommend him!
He really does understand its a freshman writing class that no one wants to be in but he makes it as exciting as he can.
I took him fall 2023 his class was very easy if you just did the assignments he did not overload on homework or essays. He is a good genuine person that respects you! Highly recommend.

Great prof! Easy grader, gives great feedback. Lots of in-class group work, something due almost every class but it was never too much. He is a great professor and makes the class simple. He is relatable and understands our positions. The workload is medium but he makes life easy and is lenient in grading.

I had Wray for WRDS 1104. He truly is passionate about what he teaches and wants his students to succeed. Really easy to do well in this class if you put in the effort. He always gives good feedback and engages with his students.

I loved every moment of this class with Professor Wray because he graded so leniently and was chill. He constantly welcomed our opinions, gave us the freedom to choose ideas for our portfolios. He always complimented my writing skills. PLEASE TAKE HIM!!!

It would be dishonorable to say "easy A", but it's a very achievable A if you put in the work.

I found his class chill and relaxed. Most of the work consists of discussion forms and essays. There are not many assignments though but he is a very easy grader as long as you do the assignment. He always try to find the good things in your easy and build off of that. Each assignment builds on the one before so don't miss an assignment!

Prof Wray is a great instructor that clearly explains every aspect of the class and every assignment. Doing the work in this class and fully participating is his goal so just make sure you do that. He focuses more on taking risks in writing without being afraid, so go out of your comfort zone with the assignments and you will still get an A.
BEST PROFESSOR!!!

Amazing professor, Easiest class I've ever taken and I would easily take this class over and over again because its an amazing way to socialize and get to know a group of people that you wouldn't usually make. I LOVEEED the White Elephant we had! and I hope your bathroom is nice.

George is a great professor teaching life skills. He is more of a friend than a professor to his classes and goes above and beyond to help you. So grateful I had him to start my college experience. George was the best advisor I've had at UNCC. He helped me pick the concentration and minor that was the best fit for me. Thank you so much.
Cannot recommend enough! George was very insightful and was the highlight of my first semester! Gave lasting advice and was beyond understanding! If you get the chance absolutely take his class!!
George is absolutely awesome and was the highlight of my semester! Definitely take his class if you can!!

Super easy class, most classes are just group conversations. Attendence matters but George is one of the most involved and caring teachers I have ever met. He truly wants to see every student do well. Class is fun it was all freshman and a smaller class so you met alot of people. Assignments were super easy.

GEORGE WAS AMAZING!! I just finished his class for the fall semester and I absolutely loved it. I learned a lot about myself and I believe I was able to grow as a student. George is a very kind man and he has a huge heart for his students!! 10000000/10 would absolutely recommend.
This class was very easy, and the assignments weren't hard. The one thing is to make sure you keep up attendance.

Very nice man. He gave us all gifts on the first day of class, threw us a whole Christmas party and played white elephant with us while making gingerbread houses. He made sure your registration for the next semester was done and gave good feedback. Even that was a celebration. He cares for every student and gives us movie watching assignments.

I loved this class so much. Professor Dellinger was one of the best teachers I've ever had and he cares so much about his students. She was an amazing professor! She has weekly quizzes but will give you all the questions the week before so you never come in blindy. Her lectures are really great and you will learn a lot. Particpating in her class never felt difficult.

I loved having Professor Valenta. She is kind, well-spoken, and her lectures are always informative and engaging. Overall, she is an amazing professor who teaches a genuinely enjoyable course.
Dr.Valenta was incredibly kind and understanding to any issue in the class. Course work was incredibly easy.

Dr. Valenta is a GREAT professor, and person, she's kind, and truly cares for her students. Her lectures are also very interesting, I was always excited for class, 11/10 recommend!
Show up to class and take notes or listen and you'll be fine.
One homework assignment due a week. 3 total tests which she gives study guides that help. You have one letter and one presentation which were very easy to do. Definitely would take her again.

Dr. Valenta is a decent professor; certainly not the worst Political Science professor I've had at Charlotte. Typically we had to write a paper at the end of every chapter. The exams aren't too bad as she usually pulled the material from the slides.  The final paper wasn't too bad, and her lectures were pretty engaging.

If you do your work you will do well. All she cares about is effort and not using AI.

Really easy class, usually there will be a discussion about a social problem where you just have to give your opinion and then respond to two people and a quiz due every week, sometimes an activity but they don't take long to do. If you're looking for an easy A elective take this class.
Loved her, the only thing is that she can be somewhat of a strict grader. She just wants to see that you really care and have done your research.

Easy A. Each week had a quick multiple choice quiz (with questions straight from the textbook) and one of a couple different types of assignments, usually a one page paper or bulleted list about something. Content of the course is pretty interesting too

Every week you have a quiz and discussion/activity. You won't pass the quiz if you don't read the textbook. No late work accepted but overall a super easy class if you just make sure you read the book, take the quiz and do the related assignment!
I took this online. We had 1 Quiz and maybe a 1 page paper every week. These assignments were really easy so don't be afraid. Exams are on documentaries which are interesting.

Save yourself take an alternate professor!

Wouldn't take this professor again. Only 4 exams which were hard. He is very lecture heavy so attendance wasn't required.

He knew what he was talking about and was really passionate about sociology. There are only4 main grades, which are test, so you have to do good on the test to pass the class. You get 4 grades for the class... The 4 tests. Most boring lectures you will ever sit through. Long readings each week. Just don't do it.
An incredibly tough grader for an lbst class. Very specific with what hes looking for, and if you interpret something differently youre wrong

I would not take this class again. His lectures were the most boring thing to sit through and he made us all buy the textbook to not use it. Tests are online and open note but those are the only grades in the grade book. He does random discussion boards that he says are required but they don't even count towards your grade.

Rutledge is a nice man who reads strictly from his power points. There is so much information. His tests are online with no lockdown browser, but don't let it fool you, they are hard. My course only had 4 test grades. There was extra credit at the end of the course.
Professor is nice and all, but with so few assignments and she grades them harshly its easy for your grade to fall. Also my attendance grade was lower than it should be.

Professor Zuniga was very good for her 1511 class. Attendance was mandatory but the class itself wasn't too rigorous. If you want a good gen ed that is actually interesting but not super difficult, take her class.
Good class, interesting if you care enough to pay attention and pretty easy to pass if you just want the grade. Michelle is awesome and very knowledgeable!
Excellent by all standards and very respectful

Dr. Zuniga is the best professor I have ever had. She is kind, supportive, and always accessible. Even in tough situations, she stays calm and polite. Her knowledge and teaching style are truly inspiring. I still miss her class and feel lucky to have learned from her.

Dr. Zuñiga was a great professor and I enjoyed her class. The lectures were interesting, and she seems to care about students learning something versus just burying them in work, which I appreciate. Attendance is 25%, so show up. Half of the class meetings mid-October on will be guest speakers on Zoom. Overall an enjoyable, non-stressful course.
Dr. Williams was a great professor. I had him on Zoom, but he still was able to be engaging and hilarious. We had few assignments, but participation in class was important.

Dr. Williams is a really nice guy and definitely cares about his students. He loves to talk about what we did over the weekend and talk about current events which makes the classroom a super comfortable setting. He is a really easy grader, just put in a bit of effort and you'll get an easy A

Super nice teacher and has really detailed group discussions in class. The homework assignments are super easy as long as you go to class. There is a final paper of 10-12 pages that is graded really easily. As long as you put effort into the class you will pass.

This is a super easy and interesting writing intensive class if you want to learn more about the environment and how environmental planning works. Weekly discussion posts that take less than a minute and aren't graded hard at all. A group project, and final project that is also graded very easily. Just complete assignments and you will have a 100%

Professor Williams was very knowledgeable in this area. His class was easy, very lightwork- after every class we submit a 1-page summary to a prompt about the topic we learned in class. Very interesting lectures.  Easy A
Dr. Ewers is a fantastic and fascinating professor. I enjoyed the class and learned some interesting things. Good class, better professor. :) :D

His class can feel a little boring, but he is a very great teacher, and he is not mean at all. Just do his weekly reading questions, they're like quizzes, only like 12 questions, then your exam and final exam.
Great professor and a very nice person. lectures were entertaining with real world current examples of class topics.

Dr. Ewers is passionate, genuine, and knowledgeable. He makes himself extremely available for office hours, and he's a lovely guy to talk to. Pay attention to examples in class, and focus on how everything fits together, understand them, and you'll do just fine. I miss your class!
Amazing professor. Very entertaining great lectures very chill class. Easy A if you show up and do the work. My favorite professor I've had.
Awesome, tries his best to engage with students. Very nice and makes learning easier.

Dr. Michael Ewers is the GOAT. His course, “Geographic Theory and Practice,” was incredibly engaging and intellectually stimulating. He brings clarity to complex ideas, encourages critical thinking, and creates an environment where every student feels valued.

Take this class!! Super easy themes course. You don't need to go to class even though attendance is for a grade (PollEverywhere), just answer them from your dorm. Light class - 3 exams. Exam 3 is during finals week, but is not cumulative. 2 small hw each week. He gives you a lot of the exam questions in class and on Canvas. SO much extra credit.
Lectures are interesting, only two easy homework assignments a week, and no final exam. overall definitely recommend for an easy interesting class

If you need a 1501 class, take this one. Interesting lectures; Dr. Ewers is a chill, funny professor. Do your assignments on time and it is an easy A. Exams are easy to study for as everything is on canvas.

Attendance is MANDATORY even though lectures are uploaded and exams take home. Will not budge on circumstances outside your control and makes you jump through hoops just to get assignment graded properly. Lied about class time of 8AM being outside his control when in reality he chose the meeting time for this class and GEOG2165.

I had Ewers for LBST 2102 (global connections)! His class is super easy! The homework consists of a current event log and a discussion each week but they are both super quick and easy to do. There is one book that is required but it is about $10-$15. He also uses a lot of homework and poll everywhere questions on the exams!

I came into college like "Dang it I have to complete gen ed requirements". I took lbst 2102 with him and it was one of my favorite classes to go to. The lectures are very interesting and even though attendance is not pushed, it is very fulfilling to go to class. The homework is not too time absorbing as well as it is questions on simple readings.

Took for LBST 2102. Easy class, optional attendance. 2 assignments a week (quiz and discussion) based on the textbook and videos/articles/podcasts on Canvas. Exams are multiple-choice and pretty easy. I didn't go to class but I still managed to get A's on the exams, a lot of this class is common sense. I heard he offers extra credit if you show up.

Ewers is very caring, kind, and his grading is pretty clear. He has very little assignments to do each week, and he sometimes gives extra credit for showing up to class. He has you get a textbook, however, you can slip by without reading it, because his lectures offer a pretty good explanation of the content. I wouldn't mind taking his class again.

He is such a great professor, so caring and kind. He tries to memorize students names and get to know you. He does make you read a lot but it is relevant and good to know information. 10/10 professor!!!

He is very kind and passionate about what he teaches, but I think he believes all his students feel the same as he does. So his tests are so hard. His lectures are always interesting and he is very passionate about the subject. To do well in this class though you have to make sure to follow along the lectures and pay attention to the concepts rather than definitions. For tests he also allows a page of notes which is very useful. Good professor overall but student effort is required to excel.
All he did was talk and then we do an assignment, no quizzes but a lot of extra credit.

This professor is rated highly due to his classes usually being easy in terms of content. Their is no good way to prepare for his tests as they are one of a kind. He makes assignments due at 5 PM SOMETIMES. I am sadly taking another one of his classes and have missed multiple assignments due to the high school like due dates will try to avoid.

Mr Armour is nice but his class is ridiculously hard for a 1000 lvl class.
