Prof Dancy was excellent at explaining law concepts, and you could tell it's something she's passionate about. She's a pretty light grader, and gives many hints as to what will be on the midterm and final. If you study what she mentions, you're golden.

Professor Dancy offered literally, and I do mean literally, no outside resources, no study guides, and her lectures were all ripped straight from the textbook. In class "exercises" were, again, just what's in the book. None of the assignments came back with any real substantive feedback, good or bad. A passive-aggressive communicator, slow grader.

If you have to take 153 take it with Dane. I was terrified coming into this class having heard a lot of complaints about how hard this class is but Dane is amazing! There aren't enough characters here to fully express my appreciation for this class. I absolutely loved it and I wish I could retake it. Dane is awesome! Take 153 with him if possible!!

Amazing professor! Wish I could take another class from him. There are some homework assignments and in-class tests/quizzes, but nothing he doesn't prepare you for. Class is very engaging, and I learned so many practical things from his lectures. He cold-calls, but only because he is curious about your opinions. Great connections! Highly recommend!

Prof Huffman is the kindest prof I've had so far, and its clear he cares about journalism, teaching, and his students. The class itself was very easy, and Prof Huffman provides detailed feedback. There weren't many classes on actual writing, but he was always available for questions. Great person!

Take his class he is absolutely amazing and one of the nicest people ever. He will cold call but not in a bad way and the his lectures are great. He has a ton of amazing connections and you will learn a lot.

If you are looking to take Mejo 153 take it with Dane!!! He is the best professor I have ever had and I am so upset that I can't take this class again with him. There is little homework, outside of some readings and for the tests he goes over all of the material that is going to be on them in class. Take him!

The best professor I've ever had. Will cold call, but that makes you pay a lot more attention and actually learn in the class. Gives great feedback and is super accessible outside of class. Genuinely cares about each and every student beyond the classroom. Take 153 with him if you can.

I cannot recommend Dane enough! I had him for MEJO 153, and it was a wonderful introduction to Hussman. He went out of his way from the very first day to know each student well, including their background and hometown! He shared inspiring anecdotes and his own field experience. He was also understanding, compassionate, and provided great feedback.

I love Dane so much, he's extremely caring about his students and does his best to accomodate to our needs. The class is very lecture heavy, so make sure you go to class even though attendance isn't mandatory. I was scared of taking 153 but he made it very enjoyable. DO NOT TAKE IT WITH ANYONE ELSE!!! Dane is the GOAT

The most amazing person this campus has seen. He truly cares about the students and the impact he has on us. For all required classes, there is some dry material. However, Dane included interesting content throughout the class to keep us engaged. Four papers and three tests - gives good feedback
Great professor, as long as you engage in class and do the work you can get an A.

This professor is so amazing. I'm neither a journalism major nor have ever been exceptional with writing, but I was so excited to attend his class. He remembers details about each student and makes speaking in class very comfortable. I am so sad this this class is over and I wish he taught other classes.

Professor Huffman was a great professor! He is a former Carolina student, which made the class interesting and helpful. The only critique I have is that the grading rubric is not clear, but he does give feedback throughout the writing process.

I am not a journalist. As an Ad/PR major, I was dreading MEJO153, but Professor Huffman made it a class that I looked forward to. His lectures are more like big conversations and he loves to talk with his students, get feedback, and share his own stories from being a TBJ journalist. Take this professor, especially if you are a journalism major!

Professor Huffman is the best professor I have ever had at UNC. He is so compassionate and intelligent! If you have the chance to take him then you definitely should. I cannot rave enough about this Professor he has truly changed my life for the better! This class can be overly difficult if you don't take it with the right person.

Seriously one of the best professors I've ever had at UNC. He treats you as an equal and keeps class interesting and fun. He's not a super easy grader but he's fair, and very understanding that life sometimes gets in the way of class. Definitely take his class if you can.

Peter is by far one of the best professors I've had in Hussman so far! Such a sweet and caring guy that really wants to see you succeed. He can be a bit hard to understand sometimes, but as long as you put in the effort to go to class and pay attention, you will be fine!
You have to teach yourself, but he records everything and will try to answer questions in class.

He's fine but try to get another 121 teacher if you can. He has no clear grading criteria at all and will take off points differently for each student depending on how he's feeling...I tried to talk to him about a grading concern I had and he responded with very rude emails. Definitely have to teach yourself all the coding and video editing too.

Peter can be hard to reach outside of class sometimes. While other times he is quick to respond. I guess it depends on his mood. Extremely easy grader, but the instructions are very unclear and confusing. Doesn't really teach. But honestly, as long as u put in a little bit of effort on the assignments, you'll get an A.
Take MEJO 121 with Doyle! He is so kind and helpful. This class is a lot of hard material to learn, but he does a great job teaching it and helping each individual student.

Take this class with Peter Doyle! He was so kind and approachable, as well as very accessible outside of class. He is always willing to help if you have any questions. I wish I was able to take more classes with him, he is the sweetest guy ever and has very interesting experience!

Professor Doyle is very approachable and knows his material very well! Be sure to pay attention in class and put time into doing your work well — the quality of your work will clearly show in your grade. Some of the material (especially HTML) is hard, but Professor Doyle is happy to give you help if you need it. Take MEJO-121 with him!

Professor Doyle is the kindest guy ever! There were points where it felt like we had a lot of projects due at once, but he gives them out far in advance. He's very accessible and understanding of literally everything. This class really touches on every type of digital media and he gives great feedback without hurting your grade. Take his class!!

If you are interested in anything related to editing, filming, and MEJO, take this class with Professor Doyle! He is incredibly sweet, understanding, and helpful. I seriously have no complaints about him. If you are feeling unwell or away, he lets you join the class via Zoom. He is also a rather understanding grader.

Easy class, but Prof. Doyle teaches very fast and not always clearly, so would not recommend him if you aren't able to teach yourself the programs. Very nice, typically let out class early. Cares about his students and wants them to learn. Doesn't give an exact rubric, but follow the instructions and what he says in class and you will succeed.

He was a pretty good professor and let us join class on zoom, which was lovely. He sometimes didn't give us great lessons and class got boring. He also graded a little harshly and inconsistently, which frustrated me. Had to ask for a few regrades (but usually got them). Grading scale is a 95 for an A, but he doesn't give above a 95 super easily.

Professor Doyle is so nice and one of my favorite at UNC!! He is so caring and will give you extensions if you need them. He also lets you join on zoom if you need to. All project based, and they are not too hard if you try on them!! Love him

Doyle made taught the programs well and set realistic expectations for an intro class. He goes over everything you need to know how to do in class and posts videos to rewatch. Took attendance, but I don't think it was factored into grade, just the couple straightforward assignments. You do have to buy kinda a lot of equipment. Peter's a great guy

This is an introductory class so don't stress about the new, different programs. The coding with html and css was easily the most difficult aspect of the class, varying teacher to teacher. Be aware - classes are lecture heavy with little hands-on practice during class. Professor Doyle is a very experienced teacher and excited to teach y'all.
Professor Doyle is friendly, considerate, and helpful!

I liked this class and Professor Doyle. He talks very fast during lectures but records them so you can watch them after class. It is a project-heavy class, but Professor Doyle tries to make it as fun as possible. If you are not comfortable with Premier Pro or Word Press, he is very helpful.
Professor Doyle wasn't super clear with the rubric for assignments and not a very engaging lecturer. Overall I gained lots of skills from this class but wish my grade reflected it.

Professor Doyle is extremely kind and he is very professional and  experienced. I strongly recommend students who majors in mejo to take this course. Although 95 is A, he will give you some curve. All the projects are interesting and not heavy.

Professor Doyle is so kind, easily accessible, and VERY experienced. The class is project-based (5 + the final) with no rubrics, but he is not a tough grader by any means. He's also super open to discussing project errors. The only complaint is that he doesn't explain HTML/CSS very well, but a few youtube videos filled in the blanks. Easy A.

Peter Doyle is very kind and was flexible with office hours. His grading criteria is not always clear which isn't ideal for a project based class but he is not a harsh grader. I learned a lot of digital skills in this class. This is a fun and enjoyable class especially if you are interested in video, coding, or photoshop.
Do NOT take this class with Steven King. He is absolutely not reachable outside of class time.
Such a caring professor. I never felt worried about my grade or unsupported. Sometimes the assignments could get confusing since they are tech-savvy but nothing he wasn't willing to help with.

Steven ROCKS. Genuinely nicest guy. Brought us snacks and drinks on multiple occasions. It's no rigorous compsci class, but he knows what he's doing/talking about if you just ask. He will take the time to explain anything to you. Wants you to succeed inside and outside the classroom. Super fun and chill course overall.

Professor King gives engaging and important lectures for all aspects of life, not just the coursework he is teaching. He is extremely accessible, kind, and caring to students for his class and all of their academic and personal success. Everyone should take a class with him.

Steven is the best! Amazing teacher and great mentor. He is the absolute best teacher i've had at UNC and have taken mejo 583 and 588 with him. He grades very graciously, if you show up and complete the assignments and you'll get an easy A. I recommend him to everyone I know!
I don't know why there is a single bad review of Steven. He is amazing and a super cool guy. Take his class and you will love it.
Great person and teacher. Hard and technical class. The videos outside of class were helpful. I liked the hybrid class model. He is slow returning grades and does not reply to emails quickly.

Prof. King is a really bad professor. He doesn't seem to put a lot of effort in this class. Most lecturing is done by student presentations and there are some brief old tutorials. If you actually want to learn VR, AR, 360 videos, etc., go somewhere else. If you just want an easy pass for your 500-level requirement, this will do.

The professor didn't seem to care about this class, using old recorded tutorials, dismissing class early, forgetting to grade until the last week of class and deciding to ignore the syllabus and teach the contents there. Such a chaotic class. The only good thing is that if you don't mind having to teach yourself everything, it's an easy pass.
There were guest speakers and we did group projects along with learning different ways to make short films and interviews.
Such a fun class. I didn't know that much about editing, but after his class I learned a lot with different editing software.
do not take his class.

Easiest class I have ever taken. I enjoyed taking this class. Even though I already had experience with editing and film videos for fun, anyone can definitely take this class, as long as they are open to learning new things. Mr. Eddy is very caring, approachable, and wishes the best for us.
Fun class. learned how to do a lot of things in the digital space.
really enjoyed this class and learned a lot about filming and writing.
Mr. Eddy was there when I had questions about certain topics outside of class. He made learning enjoyable and had some interesting guest speakers.
Fun class. Learned how to conduct interviews, film short films and code.
regret taking his class lmao
The class is a mix of lecture, group work and guests. I enjoyed the class
eh class. don't take it as an elective. not worth it
Boring. not learning much

This class was a bit different from my other classes, but in a good way. His class is combo of lectures, group projects and guests to speak to the class along with the main project. I learned a lot from his class.

There are so many other professors you should take for MEJO 121. Not much structure. Didn't take much from the class. He was the worst professor I've ever had and I had him my first semester sophomore year.
Thoroughly enjoyed this class. Professor Eddy really enjoys teaching. It shows in his lectures. There is some hard work in this class and group projects.

I learned a great deal in Prof Eddy's class. He cared for all his students. There is a ton of group project which makes class fun. There were a few guest speakers from different industries that added to the class. I highly recommend his class.
Class was ok. a bit boring and very technical. Not a formal class since he's not a formal teacher but if you put in a lot of work you might be able to receive an A.

His teaching style was often disorganized and course expectations/grading criteria weren't communicated clearly. Assignments required a significant amount of work, sometimes without sufficient guidance or clarification. Lots of guest speakers. Overall, the instructor did not seem very flexible or understanding when students raised concerns.

Prof Eddy was great, very accessible, and helpful with questions. There is no rubric for any assignments, which made it sometimes difficult to understand feedback and grades. The class is boring because its a prereq, but Prof Eddy did provide good advice about the real world and had educational guest lectures.
Such a sweetheart!! Genuinely loved and cared for all his students, I had to ask for a 24-hour extension a couple of times, and he was willing to give me one for as long as I needed!

I was nervous taking this class because of previous ratings, but Professor Spencer is clearly passionate about law and knows the material well. Some topics can be unclear at first, but he is accommodating and willing to help. The readings and tests are challenging, but ask questions, do the extra credit, and you can do well.

His class was difficult at first but he gives you exactly what you need for the exams on a slideshow. Attendance not mandatory after threeish weeks but would recommend going for good grade, and lectures are interesting enough. He's also super flexible and willing to work with students, great teacher overall.
Loved how he taught. Very funny and good at explaining complex material. Tests are at first difficult, but he helps to prepare the students well for the exam.

This isn't an easy class, but if you put the effort in and pay attention during lectures you'll be totally fine. Professor Spencer is really good about answering questions and providing any explanations if you need, which makes it a lot easier to do well. He does cold call at the beginning of the semester but isn't hard on you if you're wrong.

The first month of the class is HARD! The tests are difficult, and he does cold calls for the start of the semester. BUT, he gives a ton of extra credit and gives a solid idea of what law school is like. Also, is super funny. Take his class!

I would 100% recommend taking MEJO 341 with Professor Spencer - SPECIFICALLY if you have an interest in law school. While his tests are more difficult than other sections of 341, they prepare you to be able to digest court cases and rulings in the future. Dry sense of humor and intimidating at first, but was super accommodating and responsive.

I like Professor Spencer's humor, and I do feel that he wants his students to succeed; he provides extra credit and hints at exam content. However, as a shy student with anxiety, I regret taking Media Law with him; he cold-calls and interrogates for the first half of the semester. Also, the tests are all hypothetical, so they're very hard. Beware.
He knows alot but doesn't communicate it very well, and you can tell that by the amount of students failing his exams.

Extremely difficult for absolutely no reason and just isn't good at explaining anything. Treats us like law students when this is just a required class in Hussman. Maybe when half the class is failing it's an issue

A bunch of people told me to take media law with him, and I wish I hadn't listened to them. This class is extremely reading heavy, the midterms are some of the more difficult tests I have taken in hussman, and he cold calls people every class, so if you don't know the material like the back of your hand prepare to be humiliated.
He doesn't communicate the content the best and it can be difficult to understand. Tests are really hard. Not a fan

While I like Professor Spencer and enjoyed the class I felt like at times his knowledge of the course content meant that he wasn't the best at communicating what it meant. Law can be very difficult to understand and he didn't always make it easier. I enjoyed class but I don't know if I would recommend taking it with him.

341 is a hard class: super heavy content and a lot of technical information. However, he made it bearable. It can be pretty interesting, but work hard to do well on exams. At-home quizzes & a project (do the group option). Will stop to answer any question in class and explains it thoroughly. He gets a bad rep bc the class is hard, but he was great.

Professor Spencer is super funny and I like him as a person, but his exams are so insanely hard. If you want to do well in media law do not take his class. I would spend hoursss studying for his exams and get a low B at best. His class is super hard!

This class is hard, but Prof. Spencer makes it as manageable as possible for the sheer amount of content. Studying for the exams was a beast, but if you put in the work you should do fine. He makes lectures entertaining and banters with students to keep spirits high. Again, just a lot of confusing content to go through.

Professor Spencer is nice and seeks to explain the course, but sometimes the lectures can feel very long. The material for this course is pretty heavy and to do well, you will likely have to do a lot of reading. Most students don't do well on the first test. Spencer knows that this is hard though and he may or may not try to give out extra credit.

Nice enough guy, but grades unnecessarily harshly. I think he actively avoids giving anyone A's on assignments. Assignments are primarily group assignments working with different research methods, which are fine, but lectures are super boring.

He's a great guy, but for some reason, this semester his grading felt super unfair. Everything was group work, and other groups got worse grades than us. I never received above a B, and my group put in a lot of work. Maybe he's trying to be stricter, but he's funny and a chill guy.

I loved Professor Lee! Great funny guy with a sense of humor which kept class interesting. Pop quizzes but he hints at when they will be and they aren't hard. A couple of writing assignments and a final group project, but a great class.

Lee is super fun and chill, very caring and clearly wants all students to do well. The class grade is entirely groupwork except 1-2 assignments and midterm which was very fair. If you put in good effort you will do well, highly recommend taking 379 with him.

Very nice and funny. Almost all the grades are from group projects except the midterm and one other paper. I would not say this is the easiest class in the MEJO dept. but super insightful and interesting! I would suggest taking this course.

Prof Mack is a nice person. The class is hard at first, everyone fails in the beginning, but you get the groove eventually. I did not like how our grades were locked the entire semester so we could never see where we were standing. Other than that, take this if you're journalism, not Ad/PR. She has done great real work in the field.

Genuinely if you do the work you will do well. Do the readings and put in the work. At first, you will get bad grades but it genuinely helps you become a better reporter. Prof Mack cares so much and wants you to succeed. She is amazing, if you want to learn take the class with her. If you want an easy A then you are in the wrong field.

This class was really tough in the beginning, but it did get better. Professor Mack is engaging and passionate about journalism. There are multiple weekly assignments, quizzes, and three exams. It's focused to journalism students.
Professor Mack is a nice person who just doesn't have time to be a professor. Her students seem to be low on her list of priorities. She's angry at the world and at UNC.

Literally take it with any other professor. Not sure how she has a 4.6 on here when her class is legit an ECON101 dupe with 8 high-effort assignments every week only available Monday-Friday. Prepare to lose -7348926 points on minor errors every assignment and sift through a super disorganized Canvas. So difficult... there's easier professors.
Professor Mack's professional abilities, teaching style and ability to convey the material clearly were all fine.

Professor Mack is a well-seasoned journalist who truly enjoys teaching this class - even though it's the basics. She lets students excel beyond the beginner level. My section was able to get published in a local publication - real-world reporting and recognition which is out of the ordinary for 153! Such a cool person.

Professor Mack is laid back and flexible, but there is a lot of work and her expectations are high. Don't take her advanced class unless you are serious about journalism. There are partnerships with professional news organizations
She is one of the best at Hussman.  Professor Mack is passionate and you'll leave the class with a lot of skills and a lot of confidence.

Professor Mac, as she is known, is someone that's still in the the real world of journalism. She is still an active investigative journalist. So she will be bringing real world rules to the grading; like when I forgot to put my name on my paper or I incorrectly spelled a source's name. Tough, but also inspiring once you get the point of it all.
There is a lot of work.
Professor Mack is the best! She is inspirational and passionate. It's nice to have journalists teaching journalism.

Professor Erin is just the best. She's a real journalist who cares about her students and helping them do good journalism. Some of my classmates acted like they were the professor and were very disrespectful, but Erin handled things well. She helped me become a better writer and reporter, and I am so grateful.

Professor Mack wasn't my favorite professor per se, and her class was a lot of work. However, I think she's an excellent option for MEJO 153. She definitely cares a lot about her students, and she has a ton of real-world journalism experience.

Professor Mack is really passionate and caring about her students both academically and otherwise. There are a ton of weekly quizzes that boost your grade and the assignments are all relatively straightforward. Sometimes class was randomly put on Zoom last minute though. Overall, would highly recommend!

Professor McIntyre was amazing! I loved her class and she was an amazing introduction into the Hussman School. The grading in 153 is sometimes a little strict because of the rubric that all 153 classes follow, but once you get the hang of AP style it gets better. I highly recommend taking her class.

Erin is the best professor at UNC. She was so inspirational! There is a lot of homework and assignments, grading is tough the first week but gets SO MUCH EASIER as time goes on. She really wants to see her students succeed, you WONT end with a bad grade and get a lot of extra credit. Her students become her friends! I love her!

LOVE Erin! She is very knowledgable in her field. Took her for MEJO153 so there's not much she could do to make it easier but she did what she could. MEJO153 is a very harshly graded class, but Erin is super cool and would definitely take her again.

Very fun class. Every lecture was entertaining and chill, really giving you a sense at what Hussman is like. Just pay attention, since most of the class is graded on your final, which is super easy if you just take a little bit of notes.
Relatively fun class, at least for those interested in advertising. Gary is very knowledgeable and did a really good job at teaching the foundations of the advertising world.
Professor Kayye was inspirational and was a funny professor. He made class interesting and fun. Class was always interesting. There were some projects, but they were really fun.

Great professor who clearly cares about what he's teaching. You don't have to take any notes or attend lectures to pass. The final for his portion of the class is super straightforward. There is one or two group projects for his part of the class which aren't bad at all but the rubric is a little vague and he barely gives out 100s for the projects.

His section of MEJO137 is very interesting. The lectures consisted of advertisement analysis and insight from Gary, and the 2 creative assignments are group projects (which are with the same groups for the PR section), but they aren't hard. Final is take home. Great guy, just didn't take that much away from the class, still had fun!

GREAT CLASS! Great professor! Literally just show up and you'll do great, the one downside is that the final exam is 80% of your grade, which caused me to go from a 100 in the class to an 80 after taking the exam. Overall, learned a lot in class and super glad I took it.
Hilarious and the easiest class i have ever taken. Online exam too

Gary is AMAZING! You honestly don't need to go to the lecture to pass, but I recommend going anyway because it's fun and so chill. Expectations for the group assignments are very vague, but also on purpose, so you get to be more creative. The final was the easiest thing I've taken at UNC so far.

Lectures were super entertaining. He teaches the content by showing some of his favorite advertisements, and breaking down what works well in them. Two group projects that only took about an hour each. Easy, but productive class.

All the reviews are true: Gary is amazing! He is well-respected in his field, and he knows what he is talking about. As a journalism major, it felt like such a privilege to learn about the industry through his lectures. I only had two assignments and the final the whole semester; barely worried about work and was excited for each class session.

I would absolutely take this class, especially if you are a journalism major and curious about whether or not you'd want to take the advertisement/PR track. He genuinely wants his students to succeed. There's two creative assignments and one final. Other than working on those assignments, there's no homework!
❤️❤️ Gary is the goat 🐐. His students love him for a reason. Take him while at Carolina no matter what your major is.

LOVE THIS PROFESSOR! If you can take this course, take it at Carolina. Gary was one of the most compassionate, funny, and engaging professors at this university. Grading was not harsh, he tells you what is on his tests. Even if you aren't a MEJO major, take this class!
FIRE CLASS EVEN MORE FIRE PROFESSOR. God I loved Gary (and VK too) super caring individuals who want to make you learn about Ad and PR while still having fun. Highly recommend this class for easy A.
I LOVED class with Gary. It was always so fun and interesting, and he assigned great projects that I actually wanted to do. I hope to take more classes with him in the future.

Gary's class is so enjoyable and interesting! He makes it super fun and he is hilarious. There is very little assignments and it's an easy A! I would highly suggest his class to anyone and hope to take more classes with him in the future!

I am three days away from my last class from Gary. I have had him for four of my eight semesters at Carolina and my only regret is that I didn't intern with him. I think he is the best teacher at UNC. By far.
Such a great professor! He is very creative and good at telling stories. Group projects and one quiz/exam. Attendance/textbooks not mandatory.

This is the best class I have taken at Carolina so far. We now switched to public relations and I hope the new professor is as good as professor Kayye. I am only a first year but he is the best professor I've had so far. I hope to take him for future classes.
BEST class at Carolina. His is casual but knows how to tell stories and entertain. I never missed a class and just aced his exam.
Professor V.K. brought great energy to every lecture. Her slides had a lot of information, tests were made to be friendly. The project difficulty depends on your team, but her grading is lenient.

VK is one of the best professors I've had at UNC. She truly cares about her students and offers a hands-on approach. The challenges in her classes, 332 and 533, are well worth it, leaving me grateful for the experience.
533 is one of the best classes to take at Hussman. VK is a 10/10. She loves and cares about her students so much.
The best professor at UNC and the best class at UNC. She is so caring and so engaged with her students. This class gave me a great addition to my portfolio, and I wish I could take it again.

BEST CLASS EVER! If you have any interest in PR/Law or even just Public Speaking take 533, VK is so encouraging and its such a rewarding challenge of a class. Hardest class I've taken at UNC but also the most fun!

Straightforward class, one big group project that allowed us to apply what we learned, and we got to pick our groups or join a random one. 100 point quiz, 150 point project, 200 point final, 25 for research (filling out surveys), and 25 for attendance. These numbers get put together with the advertising section as well for the total grade.
Just an OK professor.
Professor Fields was kind and funny. Slideshow presentations were a bit difficult to read. We had a group project with plenty of time in class to get it done.

Easy Mejo class with a quiz, exam, and one final PR portfolio project with same groups as AD section. Lectures were required and not that engaging, mainly based off posted slides. Quiz and final were similar and on Quizlet. Final project had clear rubric and she posted an example outline to follow. Didn't read the textbook at all.

I've had VK 3 times over the course of my time at Carolina and has been the most rewarding professor i've had. Her 137 course is completely different from her other two in where she grades in a tougher manner and expects a lot more from you, but it is 100% worth it. Provides strong portfolio materials and takes you out of your comfort zone.

Valerie knows what she is talking about, but the lectures are not that interesting. The creative assignment is done with the same groups are the advertising section, so just keep that in mind. Study for the quiz and final on quizlet. Reading the textbook isn't necessary.
Shes okay but the quiz and test was lowkey hard

VK is definitely an expert in her field! Her lectures are a bit dry but I also don't have much interest in PR so it might be that. The exam & quiz were easy, just straight from her notes. There's a pretty heavy group project, but as long as you're with a good group, it should be a breeze (also get to choose your own group).

V.K. is well respected in her field and very knowledgeable. The lectures could be boring at times, but taking detailed notes wasn't necessary. The best way to study for the midterm and final is Quizlet. Lots of people have made practice tests already.

She is a great person and the class is very easy. The lectures were very bland, powerpoint oriented, and just a big change of pace from Gary. I tried to take notes but could not keep up with how much unnecessary stuff was incorporated in the slides.
Easy class!

VK seems like a nice person, but her lectures are quite boring, and I didn't feel like I learned a lot during her section of the class. Take her class if you want an easy A, but don't expect to gain deep knowledge about PR.
Valerie kept class fun and interesting, and I enjoyed her lectures. I didn't love the criteria of the final project but it wasn't difficult.

Valerie is an angel! She is so kind and so smart. Her lectures are really interesting and she is just an overall awesome person. Very little work and tests. I hope to take more classes with her in the future. One of my favorite professors at UNC.

VK is very knowledgeable! The quiz & final exam were pretty easy it takes 15 min max. Tries to keep the lectures engaging with the room with case studies & PR activities. don't buy the textbook. The content you need is on the slides so pay attention to those. Group project where you work on a campaign but pretty easy, just follow the rubric!
Everything he covers is super applicable for your future. His energy is so fun, as he really tries to be funny and engaging. The final is a big part, so make sure to take some notes.

great professor of ALL TIME (GOAT fr). brings new clients that give you real-world client experiences. The most chill professor you would have. Great to make a connection with and put in your effort because he WILL help you!! You do have to do group work, tho...
AMAZING PROFESSOR!! Great class!

I LOVED Livis. He was so kind, and he was very receptive to any questions you had. I thought he was a very cool guy and I want to take another one of his classes next semesters! Warning for the class as a whole, the final ended up being 80% of your grade, but it was not very difficult you go to class and pay attention you're set!!

Livis is so chill. Even though this class was a massive lecture, he cares and listens to every student: he is invested in your success. Had two assignments and the final for the whole semester: all easy. A lot of guest speakers came to talk, so you get to have insight from every corner of the industry.

Livis is so awesome!!! He makes the lectures super engaging and entertaining with loads of references. He brought in some amazing guest speakers and really tries to help his students get as many connections as possible to help in our job search! Highly recommend to any senior looking for an easy, entertaining class that helps in the job search.

Livis is awesome! He requires a textbook but you can get by without it. Partially lectures but mostly the group project since its a capstone course. Great connection if you want to work in sports marketing.

AMAZING!!! You have to take a course with Livis. He wants to see his students succeed and is so understanding and caring. He's super helpful and if you're a graduating senior definitely take MEJO 544 with him.
Best professor in the Hussman School. That's all that needs to be said. Take any of his classes and you'll quickly see why.

Dr B is one of my favorite Professors at UNC. She is so funny and makes class enjoyable. A good majority of this class is conversation based, but she makes it really entertaining and adds fun anecdotes. The final is a social media page, and it is really easy and straightforward.

One of my favorite professors I've had at Hussman!!! She is so funny and really cares about her students. Final project is a series of social media posts about a research topic and is not hard as long as you don't wait to the last minute. Take her for MEJO 153, you will not regret it.
If you're looking to take Mejo 153 take it with professor Benninger. She is super down to earth and genuinely cares about her students and wants to see them succeed. Literally goated.

If you are looking for a more hardcore journalist perspective that 153 is typically notorious for, this may not be the class for you. The class was comprised of a variety of smaller assignments that included interviews and answering questions from the textbook, and was extremely manageable. If you want to complete 153 with an A, take Benninger.
Dr. B is a great professor! She is such an engaging lecturer, using personal anecdotes to add personality to classes. All of the assignments were fun and low-stakes, with clear grading criteria.

If you need to take 153, take it with Dr. B! Not a ton of work and no tests/quizzes. The final project is a social media research project but you get to choose your topic and as long as you don't wait until the last minute you will be fine. She's awesome!

Dr. B was definitely one of the best professors I have had at UNC! She always keeps her lecturing super concise and engaging. She brings a lot of real-world and personal experiences to her class and would start every class by talking about news and sports going on in the world. I would 100% take her for MEJO-153 if you can!
If you pay attention in class you will get an A.

I am obsessed with this woman. What a sweetheart. Just a lovely human who clearly loves her job and wants us to learn. She is the best professor to take 153 with. Class with enjoyable and fun every day.

Dr. B is the best professor to take Mejo 153 with! She is super funny and genuinely cares about her students. We only took one test (mini quiz) the whole semester and our final was a social media project of our choice. She does not try to trick students at all. Big class discussions were a regular thing though, so have something to share.

Awesome teacher. She's funny, personable, and professional. Take her class for MEJO 153. She makes a hard class easy and manageable. We would start every class with a discussion on college football and the news world. A perfect teacher for MEJO 153.

Absolutely loved this class especially as a MEJO major. It is one of the few classes that gave me something to take with me and add to my portfolio. We had great guest speakers who are big in the industry come in answer questions and give us briefs and feedback on our projects. Dr. Tyson is very nice and understanding and gives good career advice

She's great! One of my fav classes and I recommend it if you're interested in agency work. The class was collaborative and she worked closely with us, she was always open to feedback & responsive. The brief → campaign → presentation format felt real world & helpful. Only critique: her feedback sometimes changed day to day, but she's great overall.

Tyson is a great professor with experience in the field. The class is mainly focused on making advertising campaigns, and she has great examples including from her professional experience. She gives detailed feedback, but some of the turnarounds are pretty quick which can be stressful. 
I definitely recommend taking her class!

Fantastic professor who truly cares about her students, I have a lot of respect for her both from her career and her capability as an instructor. She will give you opportunities to prove yourself, and for students who put in the effort and respect for the work, she will give her respect in return. Would love to have had her in more classes

Professor Tyson was a fantastic professor and I learned so much through her class. I wish I could take another course with her. 100% would recommend this class to anyone that loves being creative and hands on learning.

I loved prof. Tyson! We had a lot of group creative assignments, and we got to learn a lot from her feedback. She is also super interesting and inspirational, you can tell she knows a lot about the industry. Also, she is a fairly generous grader and is understanding. You will have a manageable amount of work, and learn a lot. I enjoyed her class.

QUICK turnarounds. Incredibly frustrating. Unclear, contradicting feedback (she'll say your draft looks great one day, bad the next). Project oriented class, so pick good groups lol. Disorganized, not very structured. She grades okay, but the stress and workload of the class is not worth it in my opinion.

The professor was kind and approachable. However, the class was often confusing, with lectures repeating information without clarifying assignments. Instructions felt vague, while grading was tough. There were also some challenges with technology in a UX-focused course.

Not very good with technology. Class is mostly lectures but attendance is required. Each absence after two unexcused absences is 5 points off your final grade. The requirements for the assignments are very vague. You will have a lot of work but be unsure exactly what to do. Feedback from grades is likely AI generated and not very helpful.

She is nice and tries hard, but- 0 instruction, you are 100% confused on what she means, overload of unnecessary info, never know where to go or look, or what she's talking about. Ok, now imagine you are not a lawyer - now make an 18-page assignment final in 2 weeks, writing about every single piece, and then present it in under 3 minutes.

Nice lady, not fit to teach UX. Rambles on & on for 1 hr, only giving you 15 minutes to work. Never knew what we were doing in this class. Will say an assignment is perfect, then give out a 90 & not explain where the other 10 points went. Final was WAYYYY too time-consuming & we never got to see the OG program we were redesigning. VERY frustrating.

Professor Ruel is the sweetest!! Sometimes her grading is a little confusing but she is very knowledgeable about the field. I appreciate how you can actually include the things you make for her in your portfolio. Professor Ruel is one of my favorites!

Nice person but not fit to teach this.

The project criteria is not complete and the feedback is vague. You are also given more work than the other MEJO 121 classes available.

Mrs. Ruel is NOT tech savvy/ doesn't know the Adobe suite. She is knowledgeable in graphics but she cannot teach you how to translate these skills to your video work.

Grading criteria was unclear, but as long as you gave the assignments some thought and an hour of work, an A is easy. I don't feel like I learned a lot but I did learn how to use Figma and AI use was highly encouraged in the course. Also attendance was counted (miss more than 3 classes and participation grade goes down). Easyish A and caring prof.

Great person but a bad professor. Lectures are long and boring and offer little useful information. She cannot use Premiere and does not offer any useful guidance regarding CSS/HTML. Grading criteria are vague and feedback is general and unhelpful. I assure you that you will have a better time if you find another professor for MEJO121.

Laura Ruel is a caring and kind professor. However, her expectations are highly unclear, and for an entry level course her grading is far too strict. Overall, this class was far more stressful than it needed to be.

Sometimes I can't tell if she actually knows what she's talking about. She seems very knowledgeable about the theories of UX design (accessibility, eye tracking, why it's important, etc.) but hardly teaches us anything about actual visual or technical design. Notably, AI use was actively encouraged for our assignments.
Run

Took her mejo 121 class for Maymester and though I learned a lot, I feel like despite putting in my best efforts it was never clear enough how to complete assignments to receive an A and so I never did great on the assignments which is unfair since I am not a mind reader or a professional videographer/website builder

Very nice and understanding, but not much actual teaching. Assignments are confusing and most of the technical skills you'll have to learn on your own. Very harsh grader, sometimes unfair. Her feedback isn't helpful and it's unclear what she's expecting of you. Overall hard course to navigate, especially as a beginner's class.

Very kind and caring towards her students, but we did not have a great experience with her this semester. As a beginners course, there was little to no teaching on her end on how to use/begin using Adobe, which is what the entire course is about. SO FRUSTRATING! Generic feedback and grades harshly, even if you got help from her with the project.

The Maymester term of MEJO 121 is a very condensed class and it can feel like an unmanageable amount of work at times. Professor Ruel tends to be a little strict and can be a tough grader, but she was always kind and never unreasonable in her expectations. She's also very well-versed on the subject and gives great feedback.
She's so awesome. just take her

The people who have not enjoyed Professor Dixon are too nit picky or not participatory in class. She is incredibly encouraging while being straight forward. She has a great amount of industry experience and her classes in my experience have proivded good experience I can put on a resume. Big fan.

I feel like I didn't learn a ton, but made at least a few good portfolio pieces. Jules is incredibly caring and loves every student, so it's a pretty easy A. Class is also moved to Zoom/canceled a lot which is a nice bonus. Very good professor overall, she really does love the class

Very kind and sweet professor, but you won't learn a lot from her. She talks a lot about her own experiences and it's kinda just a class where we talk about whats happening in the world, but this IS the class to network, build connections within Hussman, and get the easiest A of your entire life. She is truly the nicest prof ever though

I love Jules!! Each of her classes is definitely fun, and I truly did look forward to showing up every day. That said, I don't know how much I have learned from her...? I know lots about her personality, personal life, the people she knows, etc... but the bulk of my Hussman knowledge has definitely come from other professors. But fun & low-stress!

Celeb & Entertainment PR was my fav class I've taken at UNC by far. We had fun mock real-world PR scenarios, discussed celeb PR drama in the news, heard from amazing guest speakers, and learned about a ton of different career paths in PR and how to get there! You can tell how much she values her students and the UNC community. Strongly recommend!
My rating says it all. Disappointing at best.
Terrible, terrible, terrible. This is the best thing I can say about Dean Dixon. I learned nothing about PR and everything about her.

Very nice person, very bad at teaching. She took the entire semester to return our midterm and final grades. Does not care about attendance, everybody got an A. Grading was not clear, and I felt like I hadn't learned anything about PR.

This was the best 390 class I ever took. We did a lot of fun assignments based on the current events that were happening, like the VMA's and much more. This was entertainment and celebrity management. She also gave us opportunities to have real world scenarios, like a mock up meeting with a head client where we would talk to her.

PR writing was so fun. We got to practice a lot of writing that you would use in PR, such as boiler plates, press releases, and much more. We always had fun writing assignments, and she gave us plenty of time to do it. our class was smaller so it was more intimate and she got to know everyone better. HIGHLY reccomend any class with Jules.

I lOVED this course. Both professors are laid back and fun. They want you to learn but also dont put a lot of pressure on you. They are really uplifting and make the environment safe and help you build confidence. The final and midterm are both open note and have extra credit. I would 100 percent take this class for an easy A and to learn a lot

Dean Dixon-Green was an incredible professor. She created a very engaged classroom environment. She cares deeply about the success of her students. She is very passionate about the work she has done and did tell stories about it, but it was always connected to the in-class work we did. It never felt braggy to me. I cannot recommend her enough!!

this is an interesting class as its two different classes. first there is advertising and then there is the pr section. Dixon taught the pr section. she spent the entire time talking about herself and I learned absolutely nothing. I didn't even receive my mid-term grade until after the semester was over. he TA did all the work for her.

Nice person. Terrible professor. Class is all about her and what she's done. Not inspiring. She is a nice person and the kind of person I would like to be friends with but I would never take a class from her again.

I enjoyed Prof. Dixon's class for the most part. Her quizzes were free-response and a bit harder to take than Kaye's. Having her after Kaye is a bit of a disappointment I won't lie. She is a bit braggy but also cares about getting to know her students. Her lectures weren't as engaging as I hoped. She was just kinda meh.

I adore Julie Dixon as a person; she is so kind and a very inspiring person with lots of experience in PR. I do agree with some of the other ratings that talk about her focusing a lot on herself and her experiences, but honestly I didn't mind hearing about it because I thought she was interesting. She may not be for everyone, but I love her.

Jules is a great professor. She cares about her students and making sure that they have the connections and resources they need. She is the sweetest professor ever and her lectures are about engaging, relevant topics.

Professor Dixon truly exemplifies what it means to be an amazing professor. Beyond the content she teaches, she cares about her students and creates a classroom atmosphere of confidence, support and friendship. The work load is not bad and you will mostly work on group projects, so if you come to class, you will succeed!
Loved her!! This class was super easy and interesting. She brings so much to the classroom with all her real life experiences.

Professor Bechtel provided many opportunities to ask for help or suggestions while completing assignments, plus plenty of good feedback once they were complete. I would absolutely take another class with him as he very obviously truly cares about the students and wants to help prepare them for their future careers.

All but one assignment is done in class, and they're all very straightforward. A few group assignments here and there. A great class for all journalists. Andy is kind, direct and knowledgable, and he cares about his students. One of my all-time favorite j-school professors!

Andy Bechtel made this class incredible. He cared so much and is such a wonderful guy. He gave amazing feedback on assignments and ample time to complete all assignments. Taught all of the content very well. This class was not stressful for me but I learned a lot. I am a better writer after taking his class. 20/10 recommend him!!

Prof. Bechtel makes this class quite easy. He grades the assignments generously and leaves great feedback. The exams are not very stressful and are a small part of the grade compared to the assignments. This class definitely made me a better writer with minimal stress. Would highly recommend.
Take his class! Especially for 153, he was such a great and compassionate guy, and made everything easy to understand. One of my favorite instructors I have has thus far.

Super nice guy and couldn't have a boring class if his life depended on it. He is a very clear instructor and is very understanding and accommodating. Class is made up of mini assignments twice a week and three big projects, and all are very easy as long as you pay attention. Genuinely wants his students to learn and is accessible outside of class.

Scott Geier, oh Scott Geier. I love this class and given the opportunity I would take it over again. His assignments are fun and interesting and he genuinely cares for his students outside of class. I've gone to his office hours to just discuss career options and random things. He very rarely gives 100s though, but he is open to working with you.

Scott is very smart in regards to MEJO, has passion,and cares about student success beyond class.121 is not a difficult course within itself, if you were to take him I would just be wary of his grading. I essentially only got an A because I went to office hours for every assignments. His grading is harsh, but atleast he's open to working with you.

TAKE SCOTT. As a student who hates coding and digital media creation more than anything, this was my favorite class of the semester. He goes a little fast, but the skills I developed with AI in this class that he taught us are incomparable, and he's super amazing in office hours! TAKE HIM TAKE HIM

Scott is hands down one of the best professors I've ever had at UNC! His lectures are engaging and his personality was bomb. As someone with zero prior coding experience, he made coding non-intimidating and genuinely something I now love doing. 100% would recommend to any design or interface-interested student.

TAKE HIS CLASS! He is a 100/10. Such an interesting course, and I learned so much. Really accessible outside of class, clear grading criteria, and minimal homework outside your actual project. His lectures are funny and engaging. Takes time to get to know you and actually helped me figure out a career path I'm very interested in! Love Uncle Scott!

Amazing person, amazing professor. I left the course feeling like an entirely different individual from how much I learned. He isn't an easy A, and I had to work really hard all semester, but he pushed me to become better and I'm so glad I took 121 with him. He is so knowledgeable on everything and really cares about his students. My favorite prof!

If you're not a mejo major don't take this class. Scott is really cool and nice but doesn't have clear grading criteria. A lot of course is based on creativity which is great for some and not others. He deeply cares a lot about the material and wants students to succeed, but this is by no means an easy course.

Scott is the most caring professor I have ever had. From day one, you can tell he loves teaching. He made coding fun, which is rare, and he gives great feedback on assignments. Best of all, he is always available for office hours if you get stuck on a line of code.

Uncle Scott is a wonderful professor. I would even go as far to say my favorite professor at the Hussman School. I credit him with the reason why I want to do Ui/Ux development as a future career. He was so willing to teach us the basics and class lessons were very helpful. I strongly encourage you to take a class with him.

Probably the coolest professor I've had at UNC. If you have the chance to take Uncle Scott please do so. I didn't know much about coding and UI design but learned a lot from this course. Some websites were difficult to create but schedule office hours and you'll be just fine. It's a 1:45-minute class but it just feels like a friend teaching you.

Scott is so funny; he makes a lot of funny dad jokes. The class is not hard, but you need to be creative and put in effort, he has his own standards when it comes to how things are being graded. Scott always pushes his students to produce excellent work rather than just completing the assignments. Good preparation class for MEJO students.

This is a really great class. Coding was definitely the toughest part, but Professor Geier was super helpful and takes you through it step-by-step in class. No one in my class had coded before but we got through it lol. You'll learn a ton about user experience and interactivity. You definitely need to attend class to learn and do well.

Really enjoyed the class with Scott. Was not excited to take MEJO 121 but Scott makes it really enjoyable and works individual with students with as many questions as they have. I didn't find that he was a harsh grader and was pretty fair. I am by no means an expert in anything Digital Storytelling related but I never received lower than a B.

Dr.Geier made MEJO 121 very enjoyable. Since there are so many new applications and programs introduced, it would be easy to get lost in this class. However, Dr.Geier walks through assignments slowly and posted grading criteria online. He gives very helpful feedback and homework is assigned well in advance so it never felt like things were rushed.

Scott Geier is a straight up awesome guy. He gives great feedback, and honestly inspired me to take video more seriously. He's very laid back, and he also very clearly knows what he's talking about. If you have to take 121, definitely take it with him. If you've never made a video or a website before, he will make sure you can succeed.

Professor Geier is a pretty tough grader. You have to read his mind to receive an A. He is interesting and a good lecturer. Although, he expects a lot for an entry level class. He wouldn't round my final grade of an 89.6 to a 90.

Has high expectations but I couldn't say enough good things about this professor! If you put in the work you will get the grade deserved.  Truly CARES and wants what is best for his students.  I wouldn't say i'm tech savvy but this class made me so much more confident and comfortable in my abilities.  This dude rocks.

Scott was a great Prof. He gives good feedback, is available for questions out of class, & creates a good classroom energy. He has clear notes and guidelines to refer to & clearly knows what he's talking about. Definitely would recommend for 121.
Scott made the class interesting and easy to follow. He was super accommodating for us and provided decent feedback. Genuinely enjoyed going to class. Definitely one of the better MEJO 121 profs.
Quirky but sweet. If you take the time to connect with her, she is genuinely very helpful and wants you to do well. A complex character, but stick with her.

Do not listen to the bad reviews, I LOVED Professor Peterson! I learned so much in this class, and she is willing to help you with anything you need. Show her you're trying, and you will do well in the class. There are readings almost every night, and class stems from them. She values participation, so if you do the readings, you should be fine!

professor peterson is genuinely one of the best profs i've had at UNC, she engages students in her lectures and really cares that we learn and understand. theres 2 essays and one final, thats it. if you try at all you'll be fine. i learned so much from her, 1000% take her class, hussman is lucky to have her!

Don't listen to these other comments, Prof. Peterson is amazing! She genuinely cares so much about her students and helping them learn and get better, especially if you participate. She gives really good feedback, and her lectures are really entertaining as she's kind of quirky. No final, just a paper. Would definitely take one of her classes again

She is an amazing professor. Do not be afraid of the reviews that she has, she was one of the most caring professors I have had. There is 2 essays, 1 final essay and participation is important. The readings are important, as the essays build off the readings. I would take a class with professor peterson again. She is extremely enthusiastic!!

141 was a very interesting class! Assignments are few and far between, so be willing to put in the work. Be aware, however, that Professor Peterson can get very upset over certain things and will interpret your writing very literally. Comments can be harsh (sometimes a bit rude), and grading criteria are not always clear or consistent.

Prof Peterson is a tough professor but wants her students to succeed. She will help you if you put in the work — doing readings, going to office hours, etc… Attendance is mandatory but she makes class pretty interesting. Spent a lot of time talking about philosophy so that's something to know if philosophy isn't your thing

Dr. Peterson is well rounded and knowledgeable about the subject. She has a distinct teaching method which no other professors at UNC use, therefore, there isn't any help from others if something is confusing. There are only a few grades, and she's a very tough grader and harsh commenter, so there's little room for recovery in her class.

I loved Professor Peterson's class! She always made lectures interesting and fun. She used current and clear examples for everything discussed and encouraged participation. Not assignment-heavy. She is a tough grader, but she gives lots of time to work on papers and gives excellent feedback to prepare you for the next. Loved this course.

I was in a class with 12 girls and Peterson did not know my name or really care to but thats the only bad thing i would say about her. She grades pretty easy and the only exams are take home essays that have pretty interesting prompts. Her lectures are interesting and she gives really good examples but we have to take notes on paper.
Actually awful. She practically yells at students. Does not allow computers for note taking. She is a very strict grader and an overall boring lecturer. I wish I had known not to take from her.
She's a tough grader and your overall grade is determined by ~3 assignments, but she is genuinely willing to work with you if you put in the effort. Very knowledgable as well!

Peterson was very strict with assignments and common mistakes. She treated the class as if it were the be-all, end-all, with only 3 assignments determining your grade. This is frustrating given her tough grading. Despite positive comments on essays, she often gave low grades. Taking her class was frustrating and my grade doesn't reflect my efforts.

I LOVE Professor Peterson. Yes, she can be strict with attendance, but she always accommodates when reasonable and I thought she graded fair. Her lectures are also super entertaining, and it is obvious that she really cares about her students. The workload is pretty light too and there are only a few major assignments.

- She's an okay lecturer
- No electronics policy, use of a device will likely result in an absence regardless of participation
- Zero flexibility on attendance, if you are later than 10 minutes you will be counted absent (each absence more than three will take off a letter grade, so this is very bad.)

pick a different prof because this class was more stressful than 500 level MEJO classes. She is an incredibly harsh grader/criticicism, vague rubrics. At the start of the semester she said she was willing to use humiliation tactics on students who did not participate. Pessimistic about topic which mades students uninspired for MEJO careers.

Do not take her class. She is extremely tough and very strict. If you have a basic grammar mistake in your paper that will enrage her and bring your grades down. Most assignments only count for completion, which brings your grade to 3 assignments, 2 of which are huge papers. Get ready to read and get called out in class if you didn't do it.

Do not take this class with her, there are better options. It is LDOC and she hasn't entered any grades in the gradebook so I currently have an "N/A" in her class. Lectures are boring and pointless, she reads each slide word for word and struggles to keep the class engaged. Gets angry when people don't raise their hand to answer questions.
Nice and accessible outside of class but unorganized when it comes to lectures.

the class is divided into podcast production teams, a social media team, and web design team. she is a bit unorganized and doesn't post assignment instructions or rubrics for the semester long project so grading is ambigious. but she is caring otherwise and a genuinely sweet person.

The basketball players take this class if that tells you anything. Its a semester long group project that isn't graded too harshly. You have chapters to read each week but they are pretty easy and you can BS them. McDonald is a caring professor but can be hard to reach. I would take it again.

All the other parts of the class is good. However, the grade distribution of assignments is off-balanced. The two papers each weighs 20% of the grade, the 19 forum exercises throughout the semester also only weighs 20%, and the final and only exam of the semester weighs 40% of the grade. And 95 is an A.
Lee is such a dedicated professor. He is super nice and makes classes tailored to trending topics. Would recommend!

Lee is an awesome person who cares for his students, but this course just makes zero sense. The content is all over the place and the exams are so poorly structured that half the class fails them and he has to curve them.

Professor Meredith is a nice guy, but his exams are unfairly difficult. It sometimes doesn't matter how much reading you do or how many notes you take. His exams question about hyper-specific notes from his lectures, often just in the speaker notes of his presentations and not even mentioned in his lectures. I don't recommend this class.

This is a very easy class, but one of the most painful I have had to take. Professor Meredith is super nice, but the class is strictly a lecture the entire semester and after the first few weeks you get tired. You could not come to class and still get an A but he grades attendance which really sucks. Also there is no policy at all in this class.

Super nice professor; you'll leave the class feeling like it has prepared you for the real world. However, the class is heavily graded by one paper and two exams weighing 25% each, making it extremely difficult to raise your grade once you get a single 85 or smth. Some of the contents of the test are very specific, be prepared for that.

The class was solely based on guest lectures, the professor never gave lectures himself. Assignment/exam instructions are unclear and feedback is never given to improve your work in the future. Personally would not recommend for non-MEJO students.

Professor Meredith was great and super compassionate about the topic of leadership. Very lecture heavy, and I would suggest doing the readings to have a clear understanding of what's going on. Midterm and Final exam and then three papers. It doesn't sound like a lot, but it piles on throughout the semester.

Horrible at facilitating participation and would basically just repeat whatever the reading said, less a few points he would disagree with (this entire class is just anecdotes from managers). Unclear grading, bad feedback, and iffy on discussing LGBTQ+ matters. Not hard, just not worth it. Just find the syllabus and read the books instead of taking

I took my capstone class with him, and he was such a kind and caring professor. The lectures tend to be pretty dry, but participation is encouraged, and assignments are very straight-forward. You have to pay attention and attend class to get an A in this course since a 95 is an A, but it's a very manageable capstone.

Always got great, valuable feedback on my projects. Lectures can be tedious, but are beneficial. Quizzes are a bit hard, and textbook reading is necessary to do well. Ultimately, I learned and grew so much. You get to choose what kind of stories to pursue, so you get to learn about areas you're interested in!

Lee is very kind and a great professor! He really encourages participation (20% of grade) and grades the rest on 3 papers, midterm, and final. Exams are kinda tricky, but papers are easily graded. The topics are really interesting, and learning about leadership is great for any major, not just journalism. Highly recommend!!

Prof Meredith is pretty solid. Very approachable. 424 has 2 short papers about a selected reading and then 1 longer research paper. HW is mostly book/textbook reading. Overall, not a hard class and Meredith makes it pretty flexible and adaptable to the changes in media management.

She is a super sweet professor. She is easy to have a conversation with. My only complaint is it is nearly impossible to make anything higher than 90. I have gotten maybe 2 grades over 90, and heard this is common for other students. We don't do much in class, but from what we do it is an interesting and engaging class.
great professor, like actually amazing, take a class with her

Dr. Boynton is so sweet and funny! The content can be a little boring at times, but she always managed to make us smile during class. Daily in-class group assignments were pretty easy and useful. Sometimes, she can be a tough grader, but she genuinely cares about her students and loves her job.
She clearly cares about her students and makes each class discussion interesting. Also good at giving feedback on accuracy graded assignments

Lois is so funny and gives entertaining lectures. Cares about her students and is accessible outside of class! Can be a tough grader at times but she cares about her students succeeding, especially in a 100 level class.

Dr. B was a great professor who truly cared for her students. I thoroughly enjoyed her course and learned a great deal about the world of public relations. I would recommend this course for anyone who is interested in doing the same.
Dr. Boynton was amazing! She is funny and gives great feedback on assignments. She is willing to work with you and has clear grading criteria.

She is such a sweetie and so funny! She makes the lectures so fun and teaches the content well. There are a lot of small assignments, but I like that because it balances grades. Most are usually just short discussions. Take this class with her!!

I loved her as a professor and I wish I could've taken more classes with her. Truly caring and gives clear instructions and useful feedback. She is always there to help, she even sent me resources for my papers on random days when I didn't even ask for it, shows you how much she thinks of her students and is cheering for their success.

I love Lois. She is my favorite professor I've taken at UNC (141 & 531) and I consider her a friend. She is a tough grader and I tend to hover around an A- in her classes as a result, but 531 is my favorite class of the semester. I always feel welcomed by her and look forward to learning from her. I highly recommend taking her before you graduate.

I absolutely love Dr. B. I had her for 141 and again for 531. I think she is an amazing professor who truly cares about her students and wants them engaged, however, she is a super tough grader. It's really hard to get higher than an A- on any assignment just through the nature of her grading. I love Dr. B and can't recommend her enough!

Professor Boynton is nice, but her lectures are so dry and the homework feels tedious a lot of the time. I was less than a tenth of a point away from an A- in the class but she did not round up, which is incredibly frustrating. If you want to avoid a situation like that, don't take her.

Nice lady. BUT class feels so long and she is a tough grader. you cant miss a single class or discussion post or it will ruin ur grade. It is a required class, so you have to take it but honestly not bad,, just is a lot of work. Lots of homework, like 5 quizzes, a midterm and final.
Class is very lecture heavy and you HAVE to attend. It seems like a lot of busy work.

Professor B is great and really cares about her students. I learned a lot in this class and would take another class with her. The only negative is that sometimes she is a hard grader when you aren't expecting it, so be careful. About 6 reading quizzes, 1 big project and 3 exams total. Extra credit available and she made the final open-book.

Dr. Boynton made this class interesting. She is very relatable and loves to talk about random things. She is the sweetest and even gives out candy when we have tests. She really does want you to succeed and she is amazing.
Professor Boynton really cares about her students and tries to make her lectures fun and engaging

Some of my friends were in other sections of this class with other professors, and I definitely had the best deal in this class. Dr. B made it so easy and fun to learn about ethics, and she was one of the most caring professors I've ever had. Would recommend literally any class you can take with her.

Dr. B is a Gem! She's such a kind and caring professor and really wants to build relationships with her students. She made ethics as interesting as she could given how mundane the material can be. Tests were not hard as long as you paid attention in class and the quizzes were straight out of the book! FYI: dont bother buying the newest textbook...

Marshele truly has been my favorite professor I have had at UNC. MEJO 332 was a lot of work, yes, but super rewarding. I really appreciated all of the feedback Marshele would give; it really felt like she wanted me to succeed. This class is very much AP style heavy, so be prepared to be majorly docked points if you make a mistake.

Marshele really cares about her students and wants them to succeed. You can expect to have one writing assignment per week but they don't take longer than an hour or two to complete. I can definitely say I learned so much from this class and have gained skills that will be applicable working in the PR industry.

I learned a lot about PR writing from Professor Carter! She is SUPER kind and always willing to help. This course is designed to have a lot of assignments- don't take that lightheartedly- it is time consuming but very worth it.
One of the best professors and most caring professors I've had at Carolina. This is not an easy A class, but Professor Carter provides so much support, so it is definitely doable.

Professor Carter cares a lot about students and puts a lot of effort into lectures. The class was remote, so it was hard to engage at times, but she tried her best to make them engaging. The work at times feels tedious but doable.

Prof Carter is one of the best teachers I have ever had. She is always there to help and you learn so much from her throughout her class. She cares about her students so much and is one of the kindest people ever. She brings great experience and enthusiasm to the class. 10/10 teacher and class!

Dr. Tuck genuinely cares about helping you understand media law, and his lectures and tests show that. Graded based on participation, a midterm and final that are a mix of multiple choice and one written answer. Always made class a safe space to participate and answered any questions, super accommodating.

Great guy. Lectures were very engaging, and even though there is a broad scope of material covered, he very obviously wants you to succeed. He loves to engage with students, but will never force it. Participation is part of your final grade, but if you email him in advance, he does not seem to mind. 10/10 recommend.

Can't recommend enough! Ryan has so much experience and really cares about both student learning and well-being. I learned so much in this class but never felt overwhelmed about grades, and that is purely because of the way the class is structured and taught. Ryan made every topic interesting with his humor and creative examples.

Genuinely the best, most kind Hussman professor I have ever had the pleasure to take a class with. I wish he offered more classes that I could take with him. The class was super easy if you just paid the most minuscule shred of attention during the lectures.

Take Media Law with him!! Amazing, extremely caring professor who loves his students and loves what he does. What could be a dry class that you only take because it's required, Ryan makes very engaging and fun. Open note midterm and final, but the only thing with this class is that there are very few grades (pretty much only the midterm and final).

If you are going to take 350 journalism focus, then you HAVE TO take it with Ryan Tuck. He is super understanding, a great communicator, and he genuinely cares about everyone and their mental health. He would also play music while walking into class (Laufey, Weezer, Hamilton?!). Genuinely, the most caring person ever. 10/10 would take again!!!

Learned so much. Felt so seen. Was willing to meet me where I was and help me get where I needed to be. Very clear and articulate about expectations and consistent in upbeat morale throughout the entire course. Provided all supplementary links and articles. Set the tone and participated in discussions so direction was organic.

Not to glaze, but Professor Tuck is truly a gem of a professor. I always appreciated his humbleness and humanity, despite his impressive credentials. The way he prioritizes his family and personal sanity is truly admirable. A professor who truly cares for and weighs student well-being alongside professional development is few and far between.

Professor Tuck is one of my favorite professors. He is caring and accommodating. The class grade is based on two tests and participation, but as long as you go to class and do the textbook reading, you can succeed. He started the semester saying that he could convince us to go to law school and after this class, that's my plan!! Take his class.

Prof. Tuck is one of those people that was born to teach -- he's exceptionally knowledgeable but he makes it clear he's looking for everyone to succeed. Grading was generous and lectures were surprisingly interesting, which is largely thanks to his humor and tangents. Couldn't recommend enough.

I wanted to attend college in the first place to learn from professors like Ryan. I will never forget the advice, experience and wisdom he brought to lectures–from media law to everyday life. We were graded on a midterm, final and participation. Grading was generous and because of this, I could focus on the class instead of only on my grade.

Very easy and interesting for a class that is supposed to be a hard pre-req. Entire grade is two tests and participation, but they are open note and online. There is no homework, only textbook readings. I did not open the textbook once. I just took good notes in class and I was totally prepared for the tests. Engaging and funny lectures.

Prof. Tuck is tremendously caring, kind and intelligent. He made a tough topics come alive with humor and wit. Grading was VERY fair and exams were open note/open book. Attendance is mandatory and he encouraged participation but did not pressure people to talk. Cannot recommend his class enough.
